https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19901

该论文提出R2A在线视觉语言导航适应框架，通过成功-失败记忆（SFM）持续存储并检索历史导航经验，结合先验锚定适应（PAA）强化成功轨迹、抑制失败轨迹，在无需源域数据或专家监督的情况下实现稳定的策略适应。

现有基于反馈的在线视觉语言导航（VLN）方法主要从当前回合的结果中学习，导致先前获得的反馈未被充分利用。受人类情景记忆的启发，我们提出了R2A，一个持续复用成功与失败导航经验进行策略学习的在线VLN适应框架。具体而言，成功-失败记忆（SFM）保留带有已获反馈的成功和失败导航回合，并根据传入指令检索与任务相关的经验，使历史反馈能够指导后续导航。先验锚定适应（PAA）通过以冻结的预训练策略为参照，强化成功轨迹并抑制失败轨迹来从这些经验中学习，同时对行为漂移进行正则化。这些模块共同实现了持续的反馈复用和稳定的策略适应，且无需源域数据或专家监督。广泛的[实验验证了该方法的效性]。

arXiv:2611.19901v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Existing feedback-based methods for online vision-and-language navigation (VLN) primarily learn from current episode outcomes, leaving previously acquired feedback underutilized. Inspired by human episodic memory, we propose R2A, an online VLN adaptation framework that continually reuses successful and failed navigation experiences for policy learning. Specifically, Success-Failure Memory (SFM) retains successful and failed navigation episodes with acquired feedback and retrieves task-relevant experiences based on incoming instructions, enabling historical feedback to guide subsequent navigation. Prior-Anchored Adaptation (PAA) learns from these experiences by reinforcing successful trajectories and suppressing failed ones relative to a frozen pretrained policy, while regularizing behavioral drift. Together, these modules enable continual feedback reuse and stable policy adaptation without source-domain data or expert supervision. Exte

item.title: 本文首次定义并实证揭示了LLM智能体中的“风险回退”现象——即工具失败后改用替代工具时可能跨越行动边界造成严重危害，通过覆盖八个领域和55个真实CVE的304个场景实证研究发现主流模型的风险场景边界违反率高达96.8%，且现有缓解措施均无法有效应对，并提出了修复方案。
item.description:
恢复过了头：理解并修复LLM智能体中的风险回退行为

Recovery Gone Too Far: Understanding and Repairing Risky Fallback in LLM Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19886

本文首次定义并实证揭示了LLM智能体中的“风险回退”现象——即工具失败后改用替代工具时可能跨越行动边界造成严重危害，通过覆盖八个领域和55个真实CVE的304个场景实证研究发现主流模型的风险场景边界违反率高达96.8%，且现有缓解措施均无法有效应对，并提出了修复方案。

大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过工具与环境进行交互，包括读取代码仓库、运行构建和推送代码。当工具因普通错误（如速率限制或超时）而失败时，智能体可以回退到替代工具并依然完成任务。然而，同一种回退在一种环境中可以完成任务，在另一种环境中却可能跨越行动边界。例如，在推送被拒绝后，强制推送在一个仓库中只会替换智能体自己的提交，而在另一个仓库中它还会删除其他作者的提交。我们将这种回退称为“风险回退”。为了理解这一现象，我们对横跨八个领域、涵盖55个真实CVE的304个场景进行了实证研究。我们评估的四种主流模型都表现出风险回退行为，在风险场景中行动边界违反率高达96.8%。我们进一步评估了三种主流缓解措施，发现没有任何一种（能够有效防范此类风险）……

arXiv:2611.19886v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents interact with their environments through tools, reading repositories, running builds, and pushing code. When a tool fails with an ordinary error, such as a rate limit or a timeout, the agent can fall back to a substitute tool and still complete the task. However, the same fallback that completes a task in one environment can cross an action boundary in another. For example, after a push is rejected, a forced push in one repository replaces only the agent's own commits, while in a different repository it also removes another author's commits. We call such a fallback a risky fallback. To understand this phenomenon, we conduct an empirical study on 304 scenarios that span eight domains and cover 55 real CVEs. All four mainstream models we evaluate exhibit risky fallback, with action-boundary violations in up to 96.8% of risky scenarios. We further evaluate three mainstream mitigations and find that none o

item.title: 本综述系统梳理了大语言模型在无线通信优化问题（如功率控制、带宽分配、任务卸载和智能表面配置）中的应用，提出了功能分类法并分析了提示工程方法。
item.description:
基于大语言模型的无线通信优化：综述

Large Language Model-based Optimization for Wireless Communication: A Survey

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19876

本综述系统梳理了大语言模型在无线通信优化问题（如功率控制、带宽分配、任务卸载和智能表面配置）中的应用，提出了功能分类法并分析了提示工程方法。

现代无线通信框架日益增长的复杂性和动态性使得实时优化对于高效资源分配变得至关重要。传统优化和机器学习技术在异构、时变环境中往往难以实现泛化、适应性、稳定性和可扩展性。大语言模型（LLMs）近来已成为强大的工具，能够基于结构化提示进行推理并实时生成情境感知的决策，而无需针对特定领域进行重新训练。本综述全面回顾了应用于无线通信问题（如功率控制、带宽分配、任务卸载和智能表面配置）的LLM驱动优化技术。我们引入了一种基于功能的LLM使能无线资源管理策略分类法，并分析了近期文献中采用的提示工程方法。

arXiv:2611.19876v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The growing complexity and dynamism of modern wireless communication frameworks have made real-time optimization essential for efficient resource allocation. Traditional optimization and machine-learning techniques often struggle with generalization, adaptability, stability, and scalability in heterogeneous, time-varying environments. Large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as powerful tools capable of reasoning over structured prompts and generating context-aware decisions in real time without domain-specific retraining. This survey provides a comprehensive review of LLM-driven optimization techniques applied to wireless communication problems such as power control, bandwidth allocation, task offloading, and intelligent surface configuration. We introduce a functional taxonomy of LLM-enabled wireless resource management strategies and analyze the prompt engineering methodologies employed in recent literature. Furthermore, w

item.title: 该论文提出以程序执行结果为核心训练信号的方法，将编译错误与测试反馈融入监督微调、C++修复课程和组相对强化学习中，并借助执行验证器生成结构化奖励，使 GLM-4.7-Flash 在 C++ 编程任务上的两轮成功率提升至 61.5%。
item.description:
让程序执行来当老师

Let Execution Do the Teaching

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19875

该论文提出以程序执行结果为核心训练信号的方法，将编译错误与测试反馈融入监督微调、C++修复课程和组相对强化学习中，并借助执行验证器生成结构化奖励，使 GLM-4.7-Flash 在 C++ 编程任务上的两轮成功率提升至 61.5%。

改进一个编程模型是一系列决策过程：找出限制性能的行为、创建有用的练习、并确定哪些尝试值得强化。我们研究了一种实用的方法，通过将反馈建立在程序执行之上，使这些决策愈发可重复。该工作从 GLM-4.7-Flash 出发，结合了整文件监督微调、针对性的 C++ 修复课程、组相对强化学习，以及能将程序行为转化为结构化奖励的验证器。编译器错误和未通过的测试为修复练习提供了具体的上下文，而可执行的检查则对生成的程序进行评分。我们在 26 个 C++ 编程任务上评估了训练后的模型，同时衡量初始成功率和在测试反馈后的完成率。所报告的最强后训练配置在第一轮测试中达到 45.2% 的成功率，在两轮内达到 61.5%。这些结果来自一个配有持续演进提示词的辅助开发套件。

arXiv:2611.19875v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Improving a coding model is a sequence of decisions: find the limiting behavior, create useful practice, and determine which attempts deserve reinforcement. We investigate a practical way to make those decisions increasingly repeatable by grounding feedback in execution. Starting from GLM-4.7-Flash, the work combines whole-file supervised fine-tuning, targeted C++ repair curricula, group-relative reinforcement learning, and verifiers that turn program behavior into structured rewards. Compiler errors and failing tests provide specific contexts for repair practice, while executable checks score the resulting programs. We evaluate the trained models on 26 C++ coding tasks, measuring both initial success and completion after test feedback. The strongest reported post-training configuration achieves 45.2% success in the first test round and 61.5% within two rounds. item.title: 该论文提出八步定性差异审计框架，通过对比模型自有与共享参照编码手册，揭示大语言模型生成的定性编码类别存在显著模型间差异（跨模型一致性仅约.69），从而在实质解读前审计模型依赖性。
item.description:
谁来编写编码手册？一个用于审计LLM生成类别系统的八步框架

Who Writes the Codebook? An Eight-Step Framework for Auditing LLM-Generated Category Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19872

该论文提出八步定性差异审计框架，通过对比模型自有与共享参照编码手册，揭示大语言模型生成的定性编码类别存在显著模型间差异（跨模型一致性仅约.69），从而在实质解读前审计模型依赖性。

大语言模型（LLM）日益承担起构建定性证据解读类别的任务，而现有编码基准测试通常将这些类别固定不变。我们提出定性差异审计框架，这是一种八步方法，可在受控输入条件下比较编码手册的创建、重复应用以及编码分布情况。该框架结合了模型自有的编码手册与共享参照编码手册，以区分整个流程中的差异与同一类别系统内应用层面的差异。将该框架应用于668份组织访谈、13,166个文本单元以及来自五家供应商的八个模型，共产生48套编码手册和270次编码运行。研究显示，各模型生成的类别结构差异显著：模型内部平均信度介于.76至.92之间，而模型间在共享编码手册上的一致性仅为约.69。该框架通过在实质性解读之前揭示模型依赖性，对LLM辅助的扎根理论方法形成了补充。

arXiv:2611.19872v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly create the categories through which qualitative evidence is interpreted. Existing coding benchmarks often hold these categories fixed. We propose the Qualitative Variance Audit Framework, an eight-step method that compares codebook creation, repeated application and code distributions under controlled inputs. It combines model-owned and shared-reference codebooks to distinguish variation in the overall pipeline from application differences within a common category system. An application to 668 organisational interviews, 13,166 text units and eight models from five vendors yields 48 codebooks and 270 coding runs. Models create markedly different category structures; mean within-model reliability ranges from .76 to .92, whereas between-model agreement on the shared codebook is about .69. item.title: 本文揭示了现有结构化环境中预过滤机制会泄露答案位置、导致能力评估失真的问题，并提出交互式结构化环境扩展方法，将路径选择、候选剪枝和最优停止还原为智能体真正的策略决策。
item.description:
面向大语言模型智能体推理的交互式结构化环境扩展

Interactive Structured Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Agentic Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19871

本文揭示了现有结构化环境中预过滤机制会泄露答案位置、导致能力评估失真的问题，并提出交互式结构化环境扩展方法，将路径选择、候选剪枝和最优停止还原为智能体真正的策略决策。

通过环境交互进行强化学习是将大语言模型演进为能够进行多轮工具使用和探索的自主智能体的基石性后训练范式。由于环境定义了策略所观察到的内容以及动作如何被验证，环境的结构直接限制了智能体所能获得的能力上限。然而，现有的结构化和检索环境依赖于上游预过滤——即在策略行动之前围绕标准答案提取紧凑子图或检索固定段落。我们证明这种预过滤引入了一个根本性的测量混淆问题：由于每个问题对应的子图包含了真实路径，它们将候选空间压缩了几个数量级，并通过局部拓扑结构泄露了答案位置，使得一个与问题无关的度数启发式方法能够以远高于随机水平的概率找到标准答案。为了将路径选择、候选剪枝和最优停止恢复为真正的策略决策……

arXiv:2611.19871v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning via environmental interaction is a cornerstone post-training paradigm for evolving large language models into autonomous agents capable of multi-turn tool use and exploration. Because the environment defines what the policy observes and how actions are verified, its structure directly bounds the capabilities an agent can acquire. Yet existing structured and retrieval environments rely on upstream pre-filtering---extracting a compact subgraph around the gold answer or retrieving fixed passages before the policy acts. We show that such pre-filtering introduces a fundamental measurement confound: because per-question subgraphs enclose ground-truth paths, they compress the candidate space by orders of magnitude and leak answer locations via local topology, allowing a question-blind degree heuristic to surface gold answers far above chance. item.title: 该论文提出HalluProbe，其创新在于揭示了后门攻击引入的目标词元语言先验与模型幻觉同源这一联系，通过在解码时增强幻觉并检测幻觉分布中的稳定目标偏向性，实现对视觉语言模型后门的有效检测。
item.description:
HalluProbe：利用视觉语言模型的幻觉进行后门检测

HalluProbe: Exploiting VLM Hallucinations for Backdoor Detection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19868

该论文提出HalluProbe，其创新在于揭示了后门攻击引入的目标词元语言先验与模型幻觉同源这一联系，通过在解码时增强幻觉并检测幻觉分布中的稳定目标偏向性，实现对视觉语言模型后门的有效检测。

视觉语言模型容易受到通过数据投毒引入的后门攻击，这使得有效的后门检测成为一项关键的安全挑战。在本文中，我们揭示了视觉语言模型幻觉与后门行为之间的新联系，并利用这一联系进行后门检测。我们的核心洞察是：被投毒的训练数据会诱导出指向后门目标词元的强语言先验，而这种先验同时也是幻觉的主要来源之一。这表明，增强幻觉可以暴露隐藏的与后门相关的先验。具体而言，被植入后门的视觉语言模型在多样化输入下更倾向于幻觉出后门目标词元，而干净模型的幻觉词元在很大程度上是随机的，不表现出稳定的目标偏向性。基于这一观察，我们提出了HalluProbe，该方法在输出解码过程中增强幻觉，并测量幻觉的分布一致性（摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2611.19868v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are vulnerable to backdoor attacks introduced through data poisoning, making effective backdoor detection a critical security challenge. In this paper, we uncover a novel connection between VLM hallucinations and backdoor behaviors and exploit this connection for backdoor detection. Our key insight is that poisoned training data induces strong language priors toward the backdoor target token, while such priors are also a major source of hallucinations. This suggests that enhancing hallucinations can expose hidden backdoor-related priors. Specifically, backdoored VLMs tend to hallucinate backdoor target tokens more frequently across diverse inputs, while the hallucinated tokens of clean VLMs are largely random and exhibit no stable target-specific bias. item.title: 针对采用FRONT填充防御的Tor流量，一个仅约9.5万参数、纯CPU训练的轻量级一维CNN通过直接学习原始信元方向序列，比方向特征基线准确率高出15.7个百分点，证明在防御场景下局部顺序才是网站指纹攻击成败的关键。
item.description:
局部顺序至关重要：一种可在CPU上训练的轻量级CNN，用于受防御保护的Tor流量上的网站指纹识别

Local Order Matters: A Lightweight CPU-Trainable CNN for Website Fingerprinting on Defended Tor Traffic

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19864

针对采用FRONT填充防御的Tor流量，一个仅约9.5万参数、纯CPU训练的轻量级一维CNN通过直接学习原始信元方向序列，比方向特征基线准确率高出15.7个百分点，证明在防御场景下局部顺序才是网站指纹攻击成败的关键。

网站指纹攻击使被动攻击者能够从加密信元序列中推断出Tor用户正在访问哪个网站。在未受防御保护的流量上，手工特征攻击已接近性能上限，因此深度学习在此只能带来边际优势。我们表明，决定性的场景是受防御保护的流量：针对FRONT填充防御——该防御通过注入虚拟信元来破坏特征攻击所依赖的流量体积与计数特征——一个仅有95,103个参数的紧凑一维卷积网络，仅在CPU上基于原始信元方向序列进行训练，仍能保持鲁棒，而三个已实现的方向特征基线则性能大幅下降。在闭世界WFlib FRONT数据集（95个站点）上，我们的模型达到54.2%的top-1准确率，而最强已实现特征基线（k-FP风格的随机森林）仅为38.5%，提升15.7个百分点（3个随机种子；种子0的逐轨迹正确性配对自助法95%置信区间为[+14.5, +17.0]个百分点，不包含零）。在未受防御……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19864v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Website fingerprinting (WF) attacks let a passive adversary infer which site a Tor user visits from the encrypted cell sequence. On undefended traffic, hand-crafted-feature attacks are already near-ceiling, so deep learning offers only a marginal advantage there. We show that the decisive regime is defended traffic: against the FRONT padding defense, which injects dummy cells that corrupt the volume and count features feature attacks rely on, a compact 95,103-parameter 1-D convolutional network trained on the raw cell-direction sequence, on CPU only, stays robust while three implemented direction-only feature baselines degrade. On the closed-world WFlib FRONT set (95 sites), our model reaches 54.2% top-1 accuracy versus 38.5% for the strongest implemented feature baseline (k-FP-style RF), a gain of 15.7 percentage points (3 seeds; seed-0 paired-bootstrap 95% CI [+14.5, +17.0] pp on per-trace correctness, excluding zero). 当观测到的事实发生变化时，智能体必须识别并修复依赖于该事实的决策，同时保持未受影响的输出不变。我们研究了从智能体实际读取轨迹中提取的字段级依赖图的可靠性-成本权衡。受控基准涵盖三个可执行的工作流领域和四次连续更新，并配有独立的命令式和基于表达式的参考实现。在涵盖120个工作流、两个模型和两次重复运行的实验中，我们比较了完全重计算、滚动摘要记忆、词汇检索、轨迹提取依赖以及经过验证的依赖上界等方法。结果表明，由轨迹推导的依赖图减少了需要审查的决策数量和估计总成本，但遗漏的替代支持路径和缺失的修复上下文可能会降低完整计划的正确性。成对消融实验分离了边删除、虚假边、传递性传播和上下文范围的影响。一项探索性增强方法提供了现有的记录ID/字段……

arXiv:2611.19859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When an observed fact changes, an agent must identify and repair the decisions that depend on it while preserving unaffected outputs. We investigate the reliability-cost trade-off of field-level dependency graphs extracted from actual agent read traces. Across 120 workflows, two models and two repeated runs, we compare full recomputation, rolling summary memory, lexical retrieval, trace-extracted dependencies and verified dependency upper bounds. Trace-derived graphs reduce reviewed decisions and estimated total cost, but omitted alternative supports and missing repair context can reduce complete-plan correctness. 该论文提出以数据为中心的BTG框架，通过挖掘跨语言术语对齐并利用LLM合成术语丰富的平行语料，结合混合过滤策略与SFT加RL的两阶段训练，有效提升跨国企业场景下多语言翻译的术语准确性与模型可靠性。

arXiv:2611.19858v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As globalization accelerates the demand for seamless cross-border enterprise collaboration, multilingual translation remains bottlenecked by insufficient domain-specific terminology, rigid terminology translation, weak instruction-following capabilities, and high inference latency in long-instruction scenarios. To overcome these barriers, we propose Bridging the Terminology Gap (BTG), a data-centric framework. First, BTG mines cross-lingual term alignments from domain documents and leverages LLMs to synthesize terminology-rich parallel corpora. Second, a hybrid filtering strategy combining heuristics and XCOMET scoring ensures high data fidelity. Third, a two-stage training paradigm employs supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for targeted terminology injection, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) to refine output preferences, effectively balancing domain knowledge integration with model reliability. item.title: AI科学家若只依据模型分歧来选择实验，会系统性错过数据未覆盖区域的新现象；尽早探测未测量区间、主动提出正确的问题，才是AI发现的关键。
item.description:
提出正确的问题是AI在假设链中发现的关键

Asking the right question is key to AI discovery in a chain of hypotheses

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19841

AI科学家若只依据模型分歧来选择实验，会系统性错过数据未覆盖区域的新现象；尽早探测未测量区间、主动提出正确的问题，才是AI发现的关键。

人工智能（AI）科学家通过一系列假设链来追求科学发现：将候选模型拟合到现有观测数据上，并通常选择模型之间分歧最大的地方开展实验。然而，当早期数据遗漏了某个狭窄特征时，模型选择会偏向在整个未测量区间上都表现一致的简单曲线，因此以分歧为导向的搜索没有理由去新现象所在的位置寻找。我们测试了两个前沿AI科学家——Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 GPT-6.1-Sol——在起始数据遗漏一个狭窄峰值的条件下进行32次闭环试验，结果两者在峰值区域内的采样频率都低于随机搜索。令人惊讶的是，更紧密遵循模型分歧的智能体在全部32次试验中都错过了峰值；而当实验尽早探测未测量区间并围绕异常进行跟进时，发现才得以成功。因此，提出正确的问题，而不是仅在当前模型分歧之处进行测试，是AI科学发现的关键所在。

arXiv:2611.19841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) scientists pursue discovery through a chain of hypotheses, fitting candidate models to existing observations and often choosing experiments where those models disagree most. Yet when early data miss a narrow feature, model selection favors simple curves that agree across the unmea- sured gap, so disagreement-guided search has no reason to look where the new phenomenon lies. When we tested two frontier AI scientists, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1-Sol, across 32 closed-loop trials with a narrow peak omitted from the starting data, both sampled inside the peak region less often than random search. Surprisingly, the agent that followed model disagreement more closely missed the peak in all 32 trials, whereas discovery succeeded when experiments probed the unmeasured gap early and followed up across the anomaly. item.title: EfficientSkill提出“先无惩罚发现可靠技能、再进行精度保护剪枝”的两步框架，通过压缩指令、限制回合数和卸载可复用代码，在提升多轮LLM智能体准确率的同时最多减少80%的输出token消耗。
item.description:
EfficientSkill：面向Token高效多轮智能体的技能学习

EfficientSkill: Learning Skills for Token-Efficient Multi-Turn Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19823

EfficientSkill提出“先无惩罚发现可靠技能、再进行精度保护剪枝”的两步框架，通过压缩指令、限制回合数和卸载可复用代码，在提升多轮LLM智能体准确率的同时最多减少80%的输出token消耗。

反思式技能优化器通过从失败和成功的回合中修订指令来改进多轮LLM智能体，然而不断累积的边缘情况规则会使提示词臃肿、推高token消耗，并使智能体陷入漫长且易出错的循环。我们提出EfficientSkill，这是一个两步框架：第一步在不施加token惩罚的情况下发现可靠技能；第二步从该技能热启动进行精度保护的剪枝，以压缩指令、限制智能体回合数，并将可复用代码卸载为工作区工具，且零实现提示成本。在四个前沿、中端及开源权重模型上，针对MATH-500、ALFWorld和SpreadsheetBench三个基准，EfficientSkill在12个配置中的11个上相比无约束的EvoSkill减少了输出token（最高减少80%），同时在所有基准上都提升了平均准确率，其中包括通过用紧凑工作流替代停滞循环，在SpreadsheetBench上使用Gemini 3.8 Flash和Grok 4.1 Fast分别取得+14.3和+17.5个百分点的准确率提升。

arXiv:2611.19823v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reflective skill optimizers improve multi-turn LLM agents by revising instructions from failed and successful rollouts, yet accumulating edge-case rules bloats prompts, inflates token use, and pushes agents into long, error-prone loops. We introduce EfficientSkill, a two-step framework that first discovers a reliable skill without token penalties, and then warm-starts accuracy-guarded pruning from that skill to compress instructions, bound agent turns, and offload reusable code into workspace utilities with zero implementation prompt cost. item.title: 该论文提出FlipTest反事实测试框架，通过视觉最小对、匹配对照和密集扫描三层递进测试，发现全部11个被评估的视频世界模型都未能真正追踪世界状态——当对当前帧的微小改变会翻转未来时模型预测并未相应翻转，最佳模型的平均对准确率（18.3%）甚至低于随机猜测水平（25%）。
item.description:
翻转测试：视频世界模型未能学习世界状态

The Flip Test: Video World Models Fail to Learn the World State

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19822

该论文提出FlipTest反事实测试框架，通过视觉最小对、匹配对照和密集扫描三层递进测试，发现全部11个被评估的视频世界模型都未能真正追踪世界状态——当对当前帧的微小改变会翻转未来时模型预测并未相应翻转，最佳模型的平均对准确率（18.3%）甚至低于随机猜测水平（25%）。

视频世界模型承诺根据场景的当前状态预测其未来。当前的模型是否兑现了这一承诺？我们通过反事实方法探究这一问题。当对现在的微小改变会翻转未来时——例如一个盒子停在桌沿前几毫米或越过桌沿几毫米的位置——一个真正追踪世界状态的模型也必须相应地翻转其预测。我们构建了FlipTest，这是一个包含三层递进、严格程度逐级提升的测试体系，覆盖来自10个仿真任务和15个真实世界任务的1,680个初始帧。在最基础的层面，视觉最小对（即两帧几乎相同但真实未来不同的画面）用于测试预测是否会跨越边界发生变化；匹配对照进一步测试预测是否仅在真实未来发生变化之处才发生变化；而最严格的密集扫描层则精确定位预测发生变化的位置。我们评估的全部11个视频世界模型均未达标：表现最好的模型在真实与仿真场景上的平均对准确率仅为18.3%，低于随机猜测25%的水平。

arXiv:2611.19822v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Video world models promise to predict the future of a scene from its present. Do current models keep this promise? We probe this question counterfactually. When a small change to the present flips the future, such as a box resting a few millimeters before or past a table edge, a model that tracks the state of the world must flip its prediction too. We build FlipTest, a three-level hierarchy of increasingly strict tests over 1,680 initial frames from 10 simulated and 15 real-world tasks. At the base, visual minimal pairs, two nearly identical frames whose true futures differ, test whether predictions change across the boundary; matched controls go further and test whether they change only where the future does; and dense sweeps, the strictest level, locate exactly where they change. All 11 video world models we evaluate fall short. The best averages 18.3% pair accuracy over real and simulated scenes, below the 25% of random guessing. Mo

item.title: GraphPass 利用图神经网络（GAT/GCN）对程序控制流图进行编码，在单次前向传播中从五个固定编译器优化遍序列中做出选择，准确率约达 92%，显著优于手工启发式规则和 MLP，且消融实验显示性能提升主要来自逐基本块特征处理而非 CFG 边信息。
item.description:
GraphPass：图神经网络用于编译器优化遍选择的研究

GraphPass: A Study of Graph Neural Networks for Compiler Pass Selection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19821

GraphPass 利用图神经网络（GAT/GCN）对程序控制流图进行编码，在单次前向传播中从五个固定编译器优化遍序列中做出选择，准确率约达 92%，显著优于手工启发式规则和 MLP，且消融实验显示性能提升主要来自逐基本块特征处理而非 CFG 边信息。

编译器优化遍的选择通常由固定流水线（-O2、-O3）或手工编写的启发式规则决定。我们研究基于程序控制流图（CFG）的图神经网络（GNN）能否在单次前向传播中从固定的五个优化遍序列菜单中进行选择。GraphPass 使用图注意力（GAT）或图卷积（GCN）编码器对每个 CFG 进行编码，并将其分类为五个序列之一。在一个由五个程序族的 5,000 个生成 CFG 构成的合成基准上，两种编码器在约 92% 的保留测试程序上与基准的参考标签一致，而手工编写的基于规则的启发式方法仅为 68.4%，扁平的多层感知机（MLP）为 85%。一项关于边的消融实验表明，这一增益来自逐基本块的处理而非 CFG 边本身：使用相同基本块特征但移除所有边的 GCN 达到 95.0% 的准确率，而使用真实 CFG 时为 92.2%。在该基准中，标签由程序族决定，因此该任务的实……

arXiv:2611.19821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Compiler pass selection is usually governed by fixed pipelines (-O2, -O3) or hand-written heuristics. We study whether a graph neural network (GNN) over a program's control-flow graph (CFG) can select among a fixed menu of five pass sequences in a single forward pass. GraphPass encodes each CFG with a graph attention (GAT) or graph convolutional (GCN) encoder and classifies it into one of the five sequences. On a synthetic benchmark of 5,000 generated CFGs in five program families, both encoders agree with the benchmark's reference label on about 92% of held-out programs, versus 68.4% for a hand-written rule-based heuristic and 85% for a flat MLP. An edge ablation indicates that this gain comes from per-block processing rather than from CFG edges: a GCN given the same basic-block features with all edges removed scores 95.0%, versus 92.2% with the true CFG. Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19812

该论文的核心创新在于将科学推理——由研究团队与通用AI代理Claude协作完成——引入“实验室在环”的抗体先导优化流程，通过审视机制与测量指标的代理有效性，在两个真实抗体优化项目中突破了单纯依赖更好的模型或更多数据的局限。

“实验室在环”系统是一种流行的抗体先导化合物优化方法：模型提出分子，自动化检测测量其性质，再将结果反馈用于重新训练模型。这类系统针对由仪器信号计算出的指标所定义的规格进行优化，因此其成功取决于这些指标能否很好地代理候选药物所需的性质。当某个指标是糟糕的代理时，无论是更好的模型还是更多的数据都无法解决问题，而识别这类问题通常需要专家审查。我们报告了在 BigHat Biosciences 的 Milliner 平台上运行的两个项目，一个针对抗白蛋白纳米抗体（VHH），另一个针对抗间皮素单链可变片段，其中研究团队与通用人工智能代理 Claude 将科学推理引入了循环之中。在七轮迭代、约 1,010 个设计变体中，我们基于抗体谱系、结构和生物物理学构建了文库……

arXiv:2611.19812v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Lab-in-the-loop systems, in which a model proposes molecules, automated assays measure their properties and the results retrain the model, are a popular approach to antibody lead optimization. These systems optimize for a specification defined with metrics computed from instrument signals, so their success depends on how well those metrics serve as proxies for the properties a drug candidate needs. When a metric is a poor proxy, neither a better model nor more data will fix it, and identifying the problem usually requires expert review. We report two campaigns run on BigHat Biosciences' Milliner platform, one on an anti-albumin nanobody (VHH) and one on an anti-mesothelin single-chain variable fragment (scFv), in which a research team and a general-purpose AI agent, Claude, brought scientific reasoning into the loop. item.title: 本文提出MAPS，首个基于众包街景图像的多模态智能体框架，通过级联的SPICE模块（POI提取与分类）和RIMA模块（证据驱动的记录匹配与数据库维护），实现POI数据库的自动化更新与维护。
item.description:
MAPS：基于众包街景图像的多模态智能体POI数据生产框架

MAPS: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for POI Data Production Based on Crowdsourced Street-view Imagery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19807

本文提出MAPS，首个基于众包街景图像的多模态智能体框架，通过级联的SPICE模块（POI提取与分类）和RIMA模块（证据驱动的记录匹配与数据库维护），实现POI数据库的自动化更新与维护。

兴趣点（POI）数据库支撑着基于位置的服务，然而城市变化迅速导致其记录容易过时，而人工维护成本高昂。众包街景图像提供了及时的视觉证据，但将其转化为数据库操作需要分离每张图像中的多个POI和无关文本，进而针对模糊记录解决观测不完整的问题。我们研究了基于街景图像的POI数据生产任务，并提出了MAPS——首个将从此类图像中进行结构化POI提取与数据库维护相整合的框架。MAPS包含两个级联模块：SPICE渐进式地适配轻量级视觉-语言模型，以重建和过滤文本、对属于同一POI的条目进行分组，并对其语义与完整性进行分类；RIMA则检索候选记录，执行基于证据的POI匹配和属性级推理，并有选择地获取补充性的视觉、地理空间等信息（摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2611.19807v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Point-of-interest (POI) databases support location-based services, yet urban changes quickly make their records stale and manual maintenance is costly. Crowdsourced street-view images provide timely visual evidence, but converting them into database actions requires separating multiple POIs and irrelevant text in each image, then resolving incomplete observations against ambiguous records. We study Street-view Image-based POI Data Production and propose MAPS, the first framework to integrate structured POI extraction with database maintenance from such imagery. MAPS contains two cascaded modules. SPICE progressively adapts a lightweight vision-language model to reconstruct and filter text, group entries belonging to the same POI, and classify their semantics and completeness. item.title: 本文证明首动作菜单在所有线性标量化下保持最优回报当且仅当其可达后续覆盖特征多面体的全部顶点，据此提出了顶点数固定参数可解的合成算法，并系统刻画了菜单验证与合成的计算复杂性。

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19795

本文证明首动作菜单在所有线性标量化下保持最优回报当且仅当其可达后续覆盖特征多面体的全部顶点，据此提出了顶点数固定参数可解的合成算法，并系统刻画了菜单验证与合成的计算复杂性。

我们研究一类序贯决策问题：智能体在多目标权衡被揭示之前，预先保留一个最小的初始动作菜单；一旦线性奖励权重到来，便可进行不受限制的后续规划。我们证明，一个菜单能够在所有线性标量化下保持无约束的最优回报，当且仅当其可达的后续状态覆盖了完整特征多面体的所有顶点。这一几何等价性催生了一种输出敏感的算法，该算法关于顶点数量是固定参数可解的，它将标量后向归纳与基于预言机的面识别相结合。在具有单位特征增量的显式分层图上，即使加性损失严格小于1，菜单验证仍是coNP完全的，而菜单合成在多项式层级的第二存在层级上是完全的。在固定维度为二及更高维时，验证是多项式时间的，而合成仍是NP完全的；而在一维情况……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study sequential decision making where an agent reserves a minimum menu of initial actions before multi-objective trade-offs are revealed, followed by unrestricted continuation planning once linear reward weights arrive. We prove that a menu preserves the unrestricted optimal return across all linear scalarizations if and only if its reachable continuations cover all vertices of the full feature polytope. This geometric equivalence yields an output-sensitive algorithm that is fixed-parameter tractable in the vertex count, combining scalar backward induction with oracle-based facet identification. On explicitly layered graphs with unit feature increments, menu verification is coNP-complete and synthesis is complete for the second existential level of the polynomial hierarchy, even under additive loss strictly below one. item.title: 该论文将“研究品味”操作化为大语言模型在给定研究目标与当前结果下选择未来研究方向的判断任务，并基于19篇ML论文构建80个顺序控制的成对比较评估，以作者一致性、稳定分歧和不稳定选择作为模型研究方向偏好的行为测量指标。
item.description:
通过未来研究方向选择激发大语言模型的研究品味

Eliciting Research Taste in LLMs through Future Research Direction Choice

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19794

该论文将“研究品味”操作化为大语言模型在给定研究目标与当前结果下选择未来研究方向的判断任务，并基于19篇ML论文构建80个顺序控制的成对比较评估，以作者一致性、稳定分歧和不稳定选择作为模型研究方向偏好的行为测量指标。

研究品味在AI科学家的讨论中日益受到关注，但在大语言模型（LLM）中却鲜有研究或测量。这种判断力在开放式研究中尤为重要，因为在存在可验证目标之前，就必须先选定一个研究方向。我们通过科学工作流中的一项任务来操作化研究品味：在给定研究目标和当前结果的前提下，选择应追求哪个未来研究方向。我们既不预测下游的科学计量指标，也不将作者的选择视为客观正确，而是将模型与人类作者撰写的未来工作方向进行对比评估，并报告作者一致性、稳定分歧和不稳定选择作为研究方向偏好的行为化测量指标。我们构建了一个顺序控制的评估，涵盖2025年12月至2026年2月发表的19篇机器学习论文中的80个成对比较，横跨四个子领域。每个查询呈现一个研究目标、经k检验的假设……（注：原摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19794v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Research taste is increasingly discussed in the context of AI scientists, yet remains little studied or measured in LLMs. This judgment matters especially in open-ended research, where a direction must be chosen before a verifiable objective is available. We operationalize research taste through one task of the scientific workflow: choosing which future research direction to pursue given a research goal and current results. Rather than predicting downstream scientometric metrics or treating author choices as objectively correct, we evaluate models against human-authored future-work directions and report author alignment, stable divergence, and unstable choice as behavioral measures of research-direction preference. We construct an order-controlled evaluation of 80 pairwise comparisons from 19 ML papers published between December 2025 and February 2026 across four subdomains. item.title: 该论文提出P2C智能体框架，将生物系统的文本描述转化为形式化约束，在数值拟合前先约束候选常微分方程的结构，从而在稀疏、含噪的生物数据条件下更可靠地进行方程发现。
item.description:
先读后拟合：利用文本衍生的约束从含噪生物数据中发现微分方程

Read Before You Fit: Text-Derived Constraints for Discovering Differential Equations from Noisy Biological Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19779

该论文提出P2C智能体框架，将生物系统的文本描述转化为形式化约束，在数值拟合前先约束候选常微分方程的结构，从而在稀疏、含噪的生物数据条件下更可靠地进行方程发现。

大型语言模型正被越来越多地应用于科学方程发现。然而，现有方法大多高度依赖数据驱动，并假设观测数据足够干净且具有代表性。这一假设在生物系统中是有问题的，因为个体层面的测量数据往往是稀疏、含噪、异质且获取成本高昂的。尽管这些系统的底层机制在科学文献中已有广泛描述，但这些文本信息并未被明确用于基于LLM的系统建模。我们提出了P2C，一个智能体框架，它将生物系统的文本描述转化为类型化的形式约束集合，并利用这些约束在数值拟合之前限制候选常微分方程（ODE）的结构。P2C包含五个阶段：Text2Constraint约束提取、ODE发现、符号验证、参数拟合和模型评分。我们在四个已发表的系统上对P2C进行了评估（急性……）。

arXiv:2611.19779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for scientific equation discovery. However, most existing methods are strongly data-driven and assume sufficiently clean and representative observations. This assumption is problematic in biological systems, where individual-level measurements are often sparse, noisy, heterogeneous, and expensive to obtain. While the underlying mechanisms are extensively described in scientific text, they are not explicitly used for the LLM based modeling of such systems. We introduce P2C, an agentic framework that translates textual descriptions of biological systems into a typed set of formal constraints, and use these constraints to restrict candidate ordinary differential equation (ODE) structures before numerical fitting. P2C consists of five stages: Text2Constraint extraction, ODE discovery, symbolic verification, parameter fitting, and model scoring. We evaluate P2C on four published ODE systems of acute

item.title: 提出PCM-NO方法，通过“预测增量—切向投影—度量回缩”的投影残差机制，保证自回归神经算子每一步预测都严格落在满足不可压缩性与边界条件的求解器可行集上，实现物理约束流形上的封闭状态转移。
item.description:
在求解器定义的物理约束流形上学习自回归神经算子

Learning Autoregressive Neural Operators on Solver-Defined Physical Constraint Manifolds

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19753

提出PCM-NO方法，通过“预测增量—切向投影—度量回缩”的投影残差机制，保证自回归神经算子每一步预测都严格落在满足不可压缩性与边界条件的求解器可行集上，实现物理约束流形上的封闭状态转移。

自回归神经算子通过反复组合学习到的转移算子来近似时间相关的偏微分方程（PDE）求解器，但由此产生的状态在数值问题的离散约束下未必保持可行。我们针对不可压缩流研究了这一问题，其中每个速度状态必须同时满足求解器层面的不可压缩性约束和给定的边界值。我们将自回归算子学习表述为求解器定义的仿射可行集之间的映射，并提出了 PCM-NO——这一可行转移原理的投影残差实现。其神经骨干网络预测候选状态增量，固定的切向投影提取出可采纳分量，度量回缩则将推进后的状态映射到指定的可行集上。通过精确的仿射约束求解，所得的转移在可行集上是封闭的，同时一个仿射恒等式将可采纳更新参数化与稳……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19753v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autoregressive neural operators approximate time-dependent PDE solvers by repeatedly composing a learned transition, although the resulting states need not remain feasible under the discrete constraints of the numerical problem. We study this issue for incompressible flow, where each velocity state must satisfy solver-level incompressibility together with prescribed boundary values. We formulate autoregressive operator learning as a map between solver-defined affine feasible sets and introduce PCM-NO, a projected-residual realization of this feasible-transition principle. The neural backbone predicts a candidate state increment, a fixed tangent projection extracts its admissible component, and a metric retraction maps the advanced state to the prescribed feasible set. item.title: StaleBench基准在892个真实更新事实上隔离了智能体内存中的“过期检索”失败问题，揭示现有检索指标可能对内存策略做出完全相反的排序，并提出新指标Contamination@5来正确评估和定价修复方案。
item.description:
StaleBench：隔离智能体内存中的过期检索问题，并为修复方案定价

StaleBench: Isolating Stale Retrieval in Agent Memory, and Pricing the Fix

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19752

StaleBench基准在892个真实更新事实上隔离了智能体内存中的“过期检索”失败问题，揭示现有检索指标可能对内存策略做出完全相反的排序，并提出新指标Contamination@5来正确评估和定价修复方案。

一个随时间存储事实的智能体，最终会存储同一事实的多个版本。当被问及一个与具体数值无关的问题——“X现在效力于哪支球队？”——相似度检索器无法优先选择当前版本，因为每个版本都与查询中提到的实体相匹配。StaleBench在892个真实更新的事实上隔离了这种“过期检索”失败问题，其时效性标签来自数据源本身（通过TempLAMA获取的Wikidata有效期年份），而非来自检索分数。我们的核心发现是：检索指标可能对内存策略做出完全相反的排序——某个保留策略与其“保留一切”的对照策略在每个测试查询的排名第一处返回完全相同的陈述，但在不显示日期的情况下，两者在两个阅读器上的准确率分别相差29.5分和65.6分。我们新增的指标Contamination@5能够在current@1和current@5失效的情况下正确地对它们进行排序。撤除陈述所携带的词汇锚点，会使已部署的键控机制付出数十分的代价。

arXiv:2611.19752v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An agent that stores facts over time eventually stores several versions of the same fact. Asked a value-agnostic question - "which team does X play for now?" - a similarity retriever cannot prefer the current version, because every version matches the entity the query names. StaleBench isolates this stale-retrieval failure on 892 real updating facts, with currency labels from the source (Wikidata validity years via TempLAMA), never from a retrieval score. Our central result is that retrieval metrics can rank memory policies backwards: a retention policy and its retain-everything control return the identical statement at rank 1 for every test query, yet differ by 29.5 and 65.6 points in reader accuracy on two readers when no date is shown. Contamination@5, the metric we add, ranks them correctly where current@1 and current@5 do not. item.title: 该论文提出 ImageNet-OOC1k 基准，发现物体识别准确率随物体与背景语义距离的增加在35个模型中均单调下降，并基于“聚合失败”的诊断提出空间重排序策略，可将准确率提升高达5.7个百分点。
item.description:
多远才算太远？物体识别随语义距离的增加而单调下降

How Far Is Too Far? Object Recognition Declines Monotonically with Semantic Distance

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19747

该论文提出 ImageNet-OOC1k 基准，发现物体识别准确率随物体与背景语义距离的增加在35个模型中均单调下降，并基于“聚合失败”的诊断提出空间重排序策略，可将准确率提升高达5.7个百分点。

视觉模型对物体与背景之间的上下文关系十分敏感，然而随着物体与背景之间语义距离的增加，识别性能如何变化仍不清楚。我们提出了 ImageNet-OOC1k 基准，该基准能够沿着连续的共识视觉-语义不相似性轴对物体-背景关系进行分级控制。这一方法揭示了在涵盖卷积神经网络、视觉Transformer和视觉-语言模型的35个模型中，识别准确率呈现高度一致的单调下降。对视觉Transformer的内部分析揭示了与“聚合失败”一致的模式，即物体证据存在于图像块级别，但未能被整合到最终预测中。利用这种表征作为诊断探针，一种简单的空间重排序策略可以挽回部分此类错误，并将样本内准确率提升高达5.7个百分点。这些结果确立了上下文敏感性……

arXiv:2611.19747v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision models are sensitive to object-background context, yet it remains unclear how recognition changes as the semantic distance between objects and backgrounds increases. We introduce ImageNet-OOC1k, a benchmark enabling graded control of object-background relationships along a continuous consensus visual-semantic dissimilarity axis. This formulation reveals a highly consistent monotonic decline in recognition accuracy across 35 models spanning convolutional neural networks, Vision Transformers, and vision-language models. Internal analyses of Vision Transformers reveal patterns consistent with aggregation failure, where object evidence is present at the patch level but not consolidated into the final prediction. Using this characterization as a diagnostic probe, a simple spatial re-ranking strategy recovers a subset of these errors and improves in-sample accuracy by up to 5.7 percentage points. item.title: 该论文通过统一的logit梯度视角重新审视GRPO等基于比率的强化学习目标，识别出裁剪代理产生死梯度、负优势更新随重要性比率增长而实际无界、以及对绝对策略置信度缺乏敏感性这三个导致生成式推荐中强化学习优化不稳定的关键问题。
item.description:
探索强化学习在生成式推荐模型中的应用

Exploration of Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19742

该论文通过统一的logit梯度视角重新审视GRPO等基于比率的强化学习目标，识别出裁剪代理产生死梯度、负优势更新随重要性比率增长而实际无界、以及对绝对策略置信度缺乏敏感性这三个导致生成式推荐中强化学习优化不稳定的关键问题。

传统的级联式推荐系统在大规模物品空间上权衡准确性与效率，但各阶段目标不一致阻碍了端到端优化。生成式推荐在自回归框架中统一了这些阶段，为强化学习（RL）优化整个生成过程提供了天然的接口。然而，直接应用强化学习往往导致优化不稳定和推荐质量下降。我们通过统一的logit梯度视角重新审视了组相对策略优化（GRPO）以及其他基于比率的 目标。我们识别出三个问题： 裁剪代理会产生死梯度区域，导致样本利用率不足； 负优势更新可能随着重要性比率的增长而实际上变得无界，使得一小部分负样本主导优化过程； 基于比率的控制缺乏对绝对策略置信度的敏感性，因此对高置信度的（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19742v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Traditional cascaded recommender systems balance accuracy and efficiency over large item spaces, but misaligned stage-wise objectives hinder end-to-end optimization. Generative recommendation unifies these stages in an autoregressive framework, providing a natural interface for reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize the entire generation process. However, directly applying RL often leads to unstable optimization and degraded recommendation quality. We revisit Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and other ratio-based objectives through a unified logit-gradient view. item.title: 该论文提出了一种可解释的声学坐标系，将构音障碍语音中日语辅音莫拉的发音偏差映射到由健康参考语音的时间距离和频谱距离定义的二维空间中，实现了辅音类别的几何分离并取得了较高的检测性能。
item.description:
一种面向构音障碍语音中日语辅音莫拉的可解释声学坐标系

An Interpretable Acoustic Coordinate System for Japanese Consonant Morae in Dysarthric Speech

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19714

该论文提出了一种可解释的声学坐标系，将构音障碍语音中日语辅音莫拉的发音偏差映射到由健康参考语音的时间距离和频谱距离定义的二维空间中，实现了辅音类别的几何分离并取得了较高的检测性能。

构音障碍会降低言语清晰度，因此需要基于精细反馈的自我导向康复训练，以捕捉逐渐发生的发音变化。对于日语使用者而言，由于日语独特的莫拉节拍和辅音-元音结构，这种反馈自然适合以莫拉为单位提供。尽管近期的可视化方法已经探索了基于距离的反馈，但大多数方法仅限于元音。将这些方法扩展到辅音具有挑战性，因为生成式嵌入往往会平滑瞬态频谱结构。我们提出了一种针对日语辅音莫拉的可视化系统，将发音偏差映射到一个二维空间中，该空间由与健康参考语音之间的时间距离和频谱距离定义。实验表明辅音类别在几何上具有一致的分离性，轮廓系数超过0.5，基于原点的ROC-AUC分数高于0.86。此外，使用真实构音障碍语音进行的评估获得了较高的ROC-AUC（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.19714v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dysarthria reduces speech intelligibility, requiring self-directed rehabilitation based on fine-grained feedback to capture gradual articulatory changes. For Japanese speakers, such feedback is naturally provided in mora units due to its distinct moraic timing and consonant-vowel structure. While recent visualization methods have explored distance-based feedback, most are limited to vowels. Extending them to consonants is challenging, as generative embeddings often smooth transient spectral structures. We propose a visualization system for Japanese consonant morae that maps articulatory deviations onto a two-dimensional space defined by temporal and spectral distances from healthy reference speech. Experiments show consistent geometric separation of consonant categories, with Silhouette Coefficients exceeding 0.5 and origin-based ROC-AUC scores above 0.86. item.title: 该论文提出一种新的因果先验数据拟合网络，通过在合成环境中联合学习每个单元的事实与反事实两个世界的结果并利用二者间的依赖关系，突破了现有因果PFN只能学习单一世界结果的限制，从而提升处理效应的估计效果。
item.description:
面向因果先验数据拟合网络的事实世界与反事实世界联合学习

Joint Learning of Factual and Counterfactual Worlds for Causal Prior-data Fitted Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19710

该论文提出一种新的因果先验数据拟合网络，通过在合成环境中联合学习每个单元的事实与反事实两个世界的结果并利用二者间的依赖关系，突破了现有因果PFN只能学习单一世界结果的限制，从而提升处理效应的估计效果。

估计处理效应是许多学科科学研究的核心，需要对替代世界进行反事实推理。然而在现实世界中，每个单元只会在事实世界下揭示其结果，因此任何基于真实数据训练的模型都无法联合学习事实结果与反事实结果。因此，该问题只有在可以同时生成两个世界的合成环境中才可求解。先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）的最新进展表明，完全在合成数据上预训练的模型可以迁移到现实世界的预测任务中，这一范式随后也被应用于因果效应估计。尽管处于这种完全合成的设置中，现有的因果PFN仍将现实世界的约束带入其训练目标，把每个单元的学习限制在单一世界的结果上，从而丢失了两个世界之间的依赖关系，处理效应的密度默认依赖于独立性假设。

arXiv:2611.19710v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Estimating treatment effects is central to science across many disciplines and requires counterfactual reasoning about alternative worlds. In the real world, however, each unit reveals its outcome only under the factual world. Thus, the factual and counterfactual outcomes can never be jointly learned by any model trained on real data. The problem is therefore tractable only in synthetic settings, where both worlds can be generated. Recent progress on prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) has shown that models pre-trained purely on synthetic data can transfer to real-world prediction. This paradigm has since carried over to causal effect estimation. Despite this fully synthetic setup, existing causal PFNs carry the real-world constraint into their training objective, confining learning to a single world's outcome per unit. item.title: 研究发现，在流匹配机器人策略中，将去噪步数从十步减少到两步即可在保持成功率的同时大幅加速（一次重规划从 202ms 降至 92ms），从而给 C³ache 这类跨周期缓存方法留下的加速空间极小（最多约 11–14%）。
item.description:
缓存还是少去噪？流匹配世界动作模型中的残差复用

Cache or Denoise Less? Residual Reuse in a Flow-Matching World Action Model

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19709

研究发现，在流匹配机器人策略中，将去噪步数从十步减少到两步即可在保持成功率的同时大幅加速（一次重规划从 202ms 降至 92ms），从而给 C³ache 这类跨周期缓存方法留下的加速空间极小（最多约 11–14%）。

流匹配机器人策略通过反复的网络评估来生成每个动作块，每个去噪步骤需要进行一次网络评估。诸如 C$^3$ache 这类跨周期缓存会复用早期重规划调用中的计算，但它们是否优于简单地减少去噪步数尚不明确。我们在 Fast-WAM——一个 60 亿参数的世界动作模型——上，在 LIBERO-Goal 基准上对这两种方案进行了比较。仅两步（不使用缓存）即可保持十步的成功率：在全部 500 个初始状态上（针对一个检查点和一个噪声种子），其性能在两个百分点内不劣于十步。在 PyTorch 默认编译模式下，两步还将 RTX A6000 上一次重规划调用的时间从 202 毫秒缩短至 92 毫秒。这给缓存留下的加速空间很小。保留两步新鲜计算的缓存不可能比两步无缓存更快：每次调用仍然需要对图像进行编码、运行视频专家模块并计算这两步。根据我们的成本模型，缓存两步中的第一步（每四次调用刷新一次）最多只能节省单次调用成本的 11–14%。缓存策略还……

arXiv:2611.19709v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Flow-matching robot policies generate each action chunk through repeated network evaluations, one per denoising step. Cross-cycle caches such as C$^3$ache reuse computation from earlier replanning calls, but whether they beat simply taking fewer steps is unclear. We compare the two in Fast-WAM, a 6B-parameter world action model, on LIBERO-Goal. Two uncached steps keep the success of ten: on all 500 initial states they are non-inferior within two percentage points, for one checkpoint and noise seed. Under PyTorch's default compile mode, they also cut a replanning call on an RTX A6000 from 202 to 92 ms. This leaves little room for caching. A cache that keeps two fresh steps cannot be faster than two uncached steps: every call still encodes the images, runs the video expert and computes those two steps. Caching the first of two steps, refreshed every fourth call, saves at most 11--14% of a call by our cost model. Cached policies are also

item.title: 该论文通过统一的在线协议系统性地比较了上下文学习、强化学习和自蒸馏三种测试时适应机制及其组合，揭示了上下文和权重这两个适应渠道各自的作用及其互补条件。
item.description:
大语言模型智能体应该在测试时于何处进行适应？在上下文中、在权重中，还是两者兼有

Where Should LLM Agents Adapt at Test Time? In Context, in Weights, or Both

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19700

该论文通过统一的在线协议系统性地比较了上下文学习、强化学习和自蒸馏三种测试时适应机制及其组合，揭示了上下文和权重这两个适应渠道各自的作用及其互补条件。

在同一环境（如代码仓库、数据库或应用程序套件）中反复运行的大语言模型（LLM）智能体，会遇到共享潜在结构的任务。经验可以揭示这种结构，使智能体能够复用环境知识并从环境反馈中学习。智能体可以通过两个渠道在测试时利用这些经验进行适应：将经验保留在上下文中，或更新自身权重。这两个渠道通常被分开研究，导致人们不清楚各自的贡献是什么，以及何时能够互补。我们通过共享的在线协议和模块化框架，比较了上下文学习（ICL）、使用GRPO的基于可验证奖励的强化学习以及使用SDPO的自蒸馏，包括单独使用和组合使用。智能体遇到匹配的任务流，在适应每个任务之前先对其进行评估，并且仅从自身的尝试和环境反馈中学习。我们评估了14种适应机制以及一个……

arXiv:2611.19700v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM agents operating repeatedly in the same environment, such as a code repository, a database, or an application suite, encounter tasks that share latent structure. Experience can reveal this structure, allowing agents to reuse environment knowledge and learn from environmental feedback. Agents can adapt at test-time using this experience through two channels: retaining it in context and updating their weights. These channels are usually studied separately, leaving unclear what each contributes and when they complement each other. We compare in-context learning (ICL), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards using GRPO, and self-distillation using SDPO, alone and in combination, using a shared online protocol and modular framework. Agents encounter matched task streams, are evaluated on each task before adapting to it, and learn only from their own attempts and environment feedback. item.title: 本文提出训练数据归因不应只服务于单次训练的文档排序，而应通过发现可在跨语料库、跨检查点检验的可复用数据属性（筛选标准）来持续引导预训练数据筛选，并为此设计了带证据规范（针对五类论断）的闭环流程。
item.description:
数据归因应当引导预训练

Data Attribution Should Steer Pretraining

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19698

本文提出训练数据归因不应只服务于单次训练的文档排序，而应通过发现可在跨语料库、跨检查点检验的可复用数据属性（筛选标准）来持续引导预训练数据筛选，并为此设计了带证据规范（针对五类论断）的闭环流程。

预训练数据筛选决定了模型从什么数据中学习，然而一个文档是否值得学习取决于模型已经掌握了什么。基于影响力的选择器已经能够对文档排序以改进单次训练；我们主张训练数据归因应当通过识别可检验的数据属性来引导预训练，这些属性可以转化为可复用的筛选标准，并在总成本（包括发现成本）对齐的条件下，在新数据上与更廉价的选择器进行评估比较。文档排序只会被为其计算的那一次训练所消耗，而一个被解释清楚的数据属性则可以在不同语料库和模型检查点上进行检验，尤其是在人们熟悉的质量信号与实测有用性相背离的场景中。由于历史贡献、可理解的解释以及未来的数据价值各自需要不同的证据，我们规定了一个反馈回路：该回路解释归因来源、测试候选的数据变更，并针对五种论断类型说明每种论断分别需要什么样的证据以及什么样的……

arXiv:2611.19698v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pretraining data curation decides what a model learns from, yet what makes a document worth learning from depends on what the model already knows. Influence-driven selectors already rank documents to improve one run; we argue that training-data attribution should steer pretraining by identifying testable data properties that become reusable curation criteria, evaluated on new data against cheaper selectors at matched total cost, discovery included. A document ranking is consumed by the run it was computed for, whereas an explained data property can be tested across corpora and checkpoints, especially where familiar quality signals diverge from measured usefulness. item.title: 该研究发现基于MAGIC的短检查点窗口轨迹数据归因分数能在两个模型规模上准确预测重新训练结果（LDS达0.86-0.99），而完整运行归因存在数值溢出且接近随机水平，且归因排名无法跨随机种子或超参数迁移。
item.description:
MathaMAGICal：在能力获取过程中验证轨迹数据归因

MathaMAGICal: Validating Trajectory Data Attribution During Capability Acquisition

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19692

该研究发现基于MAGIC的短检查点窗口轨迹数据归因分数能在两个模型规模上准确预测重新训练结果（LDS达0.86-0.99），而完整运行归因存在数值溢出且接近随机水平，且归因排名无法跨随机种子或超参数迁移。

基于影响函数的方法（如MAGIC）为轨迹数据归因提供精确的一阶分数，但只有重新训练才能表明这些分数能否准确预测移除数据的效果。我们在8600万和1.52亿参数的GPT-2风格模型上评估了MAGIC，这些模型在过滤后的网络文本和四个合成数学数据集上从零开始学习多步算术。在8600万参数规模下，完整训练过程的归因存在数值溢出问题，即使采用元梯度裁剪，分数与重新训练结果的相关性也接近随机水平（线性数据建模分数LDS为0.17-0.22）。相比之下，短检查点窗口在两个模型规模上都能产生稳定且准确的预测（在1.52亿参数规模下的四个100步窗口中LDS为0.86-0.99），而单检查点梯度点积基线则显示出接近于零的相关性。单个训练块的排名仅在单次运行内能够预测重新训练结果，且无法在不同随机种子或超参数之间迁移（ρ ≤ 0.09）……

arXiv:2611.19692v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Influence-function-based methods like MAGIC provide exact first-order scores for trajectory data attribution, yet only retraining indicates whether those scores accurately predict data removal. We evaluate MAGIC on $86$M- and $152$M-parameter GPT-2-style models learning multistep arithmetic from scratch on filtered web text and four synthetic math families. Full-run attribution at $86$M suffers from numerical overflow, and even with metagradient clipping, scores correlate near chance with retraining (linear datamodeling score, LDS, $0.17$--$0.22$). In contrast, short checkpoint windows yield stable, accurate predictions at both scales (LDS $0.86$--$0.99$ across four $100$-step windows at $152$M), whereas a single-checkpoint gradient-dot baseline shows near-zero correlation. item.title: 本文提出结构化企业AI治理架构（CAIGA），以C级高管角色（首席隐私官与首席道德官）和跨职能AI治理委员会为两大相互强化的支柱，弥合AI伦理原则与实际治理实施之间的关键差距。
item.description:
构建企业AI基础设施：AI治理委员会与首席道德官角色的演进

Architecting the Corporate AI Infrastructure: The Evolving Roles of AI Governance Committees and Chief Ethics Officers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19670

本文提出结构化企业AI治理架构（CAIGA），以C级高管角色（首席隐私官与首席道德官）和跨职能AI治理委员会为两大相互强化的支柱，弥合AI伦理原则与实际治理实施之间的关键差距。

人工智能（AI）加速融入企业核心业务运营，对能够管理复杂伦理、法律和运营风险的健全企业治理基础设施产生了迫切需求。尽管各组织日益采纳高层次的AI伦理原则，但仍存在一个关键的实施差距：在将AI治理列为董事会优先事项的组织中，不到一半拥有正式的治理框架。本文通过提出一个以两个相互强化的支柱为中心的结构化企业AI治理架构（CAIGA）来弥合这一差距。第一，本文考察了专门的C级高管角色——特别是首席隐私官（CPO）和首席道德官（ChEO）——在企业范围内将AI使用责任制形式化的不断演变的职责。第二，本文认为跨职能的AI治理委员会，通过联合来自法律、技术等领域（摘要在此处截断）……

arXiv:2611.19670v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The accelerating integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into core business operations has created an urgent need for robust corporate governance infrastructures capable of managing complex ethical, legal, and operational risks. While organizations have increasingly adopted high-level AI ethics principles, a critical implementation gap persists: fewer than half of organizations that cite AI governance as a boardroom priority have a formalized governance framework in place. This paper addresses that gap by proposing a structured corporate AI governance architecture (CAIGA) centred on two mutually reinforcing pillars. First, it examines the evolving mandate of specialized C-suite roles, specifically Chief Privacy Officers (CPOs) and Chief Ethics Officers (ChEOs), in formalizing accountability for AI usage across the enterprise. item.title: 本文为AI智能体在执行中遭遇计划中断时的决策建立了最优阈值理论——依据由计划依赖结构决定的有效中断深度，浅层损伤应修复、深层损伤应重新规划、全新计划代价过高时则应放弃目标。
item.description:
AI智能体何时应修复、重规划还是放弃：计划承诺的阈值理论

When AI Agents Should Repair, Replan, or Abandon: A Threshold Theory of Plan Commitment

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19663

本文为AI智能体在执行中遭遇计划中断时的决策建立了最优阈值理论——依据由计划依赖结构决定的有效中断深度，浅层损伤应修复、深层损伤应重新规划、全新计划代价过高时则应放弃目标。

AI智能体经常在执行过程中发现自己的计划已经失效，例如某个动作失败或某个工具被撤下。已部署的系统通常采用诸如重试循环或“总是重新规划”之类的惯例，而最近的一项基准测试发现没有任何固定策略占优。本文推导出了最优策略。在该模型中，一次中断破坏了计划某部分的因果支撑；修复是一种保留计划结构的部分重置，重新规划是一种全面重置，而改变计划是有代价的，因为其他主体已经以此计划为前提条件。最优策略是关于有效中断深度的阈值：对浅层损伤进行修复，深层损伤后重新规划，当即使制定全新计划也不值得其代价时放弃目标。中断深度取决于计划的结构。在期望意义上，单个失效动作会迫使 1+R(G)/n 个动作需要重新验证，其中 R(G) 统计通过依赖路径相连的动作对数量；在一阶近似下，完全串行的计划会转为重新规划……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents often discover mid-execution that their plan is broken, for example when an action fails or a tool is withdrawn. Deployed systems use conventions such as retry loops or "always replan," and a recent benchmark finds no fixed strategy dominates. This paper derives the optimal policy. In the model, a disruption destroys the causal support of part of a plan; repair is a partial reset that preserves the plan's structure, replanning is a full reset, and changing a plan is costly because others have conditioned on it. The optimal policy is a threshold in effective disruption depth: repair shallow damage, replan after deep damage, and abandon the goal when even a fresh plan is not worth its cost. Depth depends on plan structure. item.title: 该论文提出BadGCL框架，首次揭示图持续学习系统的知识保留机制会意外地保留早期注入的后门，且嵌入GNN消息传递路径的结构化触发器可在跨任务更新中维持持久攻击效果。
item.description:
BadGCL：针对图持续学习系统的持久性后门攻击

BadGCL: Towards Persistent Backdoor Attack on Graph Continual Learning Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19656

该论文提出BadGCL框架，首次揭示图持续学习系统的知识保留机制会意外地保留早期注入的后门，且嵌入GNN消息传递路径的结构化触发器可在跨任务更新中维持持久攻击效果。

后门攻击对机器学习系统构成持续的安全威胁，然而其在图持续学习（GCL）中的行为仍未得到充分探索。传统的图后门攻击通常随着模型在连续任务中的更新而失去有效性，这给人一种持续更新会自然削弱恶意关联的印象。这项工作揭示了一种相反的脆弱性：当中毒更新与所保留的干净任务信号兼容时，GCL中的知识保留机制也可以保留早期注入的后门。对于图数据，这种风险被结构化触发器进一步放大，这些触发器被嵌入到图神经网络（GNN）的消息传递路径中，能够在跨任务中引起稳定的表示偏移。为了揭示这一风险，我们提出了BadGCL，这是一个在严格早期干预设置下实施持久后门攻击的模型无关框架。BadGCL学习拓扑感知的……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19656v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a persistent security threat to machine learning systems, yet their behavior under graph continual learning (GCL) remains underexplored. Conventional graph backdoor attacks often lose effectiveness as models are updated across successive tasks, creating the impression that continual updates naturally weaken malicious associations. This work reveals a contrasting vulnerability: knowledge-preservation mechanisms in GCL can also preserve early injected backdoors when the poisoned update is compatible with the clean-task signal being retained. For graph data, this risk is amplified by structural triggers, which are embedded into the message-passing paths of graph neural networks (GNNs) and can induce stable representation shifts across tasks. To expose this risk, we propose BadGCL, a model-agnostic framework for persistent backdoor attacks under a strict early-stage intervention setting. BadGCL learns topology-aware s

item.title: LoopFill是一种无需训练的推测解码算法，通过将多Token后缀草稿与浅层循环预测融合到同一草稿树中，实现多个Token同时进入流水线并行处理，显著降低循环Transformer的解码延迟。
item.description:
LoopFill：面向循环Transformer的流水线式多Token推测解码

LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19649

LoopFill是一种无需训练的推测解码算法，通过将多Token后缀草稿与浅层循环预测融合到同一草稿树中，实现多个Token同时进入流水线并行处理，显著降低循环Transformer的解码延迟。

循环Transformer通过重复应用相同的Transformer层来提高参数效率。然而，在自回归解码过程中，生成每个Token都需要多次顺序通过这些层，导致解码延迟较高。流水线自推测方法使用浅层循环预测在同一批次中处理处于不同循环阶段的Token，但每个Token必须先达到草稿深度，下一个Token才能进入流水线。我们提出了LoopFill，这是一种无需训练的循环大语言模型推测解码算法，它将多Token后缀草稿与浅层循环预测结合在一个草稿树中。两种草稿生成器共同贡献于同一棵树，因此后缀查找可以立即扩展浅层预测，多个未来Token可以同时进入流水线。共享块在一个批次中于不同循环深度计算得分最高的草稿候选，而全深度验证则保持了模型的输出质量。

arXiv:2611.19649v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. During autoregressive decoding, however, generating each token requires several sequential passes through these layers, leading to high decoding latency. Pipelined self-speculative methods use shallow-loop predictions to process tokens at different loops in the same batch, but each token must reach the drafting depth before the next can enter the pipeline. We introduce LoopFill, a training-free speculative decoding algorithm for looped LLM that combines multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions in a single draft tree. Both drafters contribute to one tree, so a suffix lookup can immediately extend a shallow prediction and several future tokens can enter the pipeline together. item.description:
SG-LegalClarify：一个面向新加坡法律的法律推理与歧义识别大规模基准

SG-LegalClarify: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Legal Reasoning and Ambiguity Recognition in Singapore Law

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19643

该论文提出了SG-LegalClarify——首个针对新加坡法律的大规模基准，包含1,100个律师撰写的问题，用于评估大语言模型在开放式法律推理中区分本地法理与普通法直觉以及识别非专业法律查询中信息缺失的能力。

新加坡为大语言模型（LLM）的法律推理提供了一个独特的试验场。其法律体系融合了继承自英国的普通法与本地特有的成文法，要求模型能够区分本地法理与一般性的普通法直觉。这一背景还凸显了识别非专业用户法律查询中信息不完整问题的挑战，因为对法律结果至关重要的案件事实取决于所适用的法理。然而，现有的法律基准很少涵盖新加坡法律，也很少测试这种歧义识别能力。为弥补这些空白，我们推出了 SG-LegalClarify，一个面向新加坡法律开放式法律推理与歧义识别的大规模基准。SG-LegalClarify 包含 1,100 个由律师撰写的源问题，涵盖 10 个法律领域，其中包括 340 个信息完全明确的问题和 760 个信息不完整的问题。每个信息不完整的问题都有固定的隐藏事实设定以及一个信息完全明确的对应版本……

arXiv:2611.19643v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Singapore offers a distinctive testbed for legal reasoning by large language models (LLMs). Its legal system combines inherited English common law with jurisdiction-specific statutes, requiring models to distinguish local doctrine from generic common-law intuition. This setting also highlights the challenge of recognizing underspecification in lay legal queries, because the facts material to a legal outcome depend on the governing doctrine. Yet legal benchmarks rarely cover Singapore law or test this form of ambiguity recognition. To address these gaps, we introduce SG-LegalClarify, a large-scale benchmark for open-ended legal reasoning and ambiguity recognition in Singapore law. SG-LegalClarify contains 1,100 lawyer-authored source questions spanning 10 legal domains, including 340 fully specified and 760 underspecified questions. item.title: 本文提出ROUNDS框架，通过多轮临床证据后有/无答案选项的诊断对比、不同来源（临床医生vs外行）表述框架的误导诊断以及会诊小组意见变化，系统评估大语言模型在真实多轮诊断对话中形成与修正诊断的能力，发现无答案选项时模型准确率从76.9%显著降至57.0%。
item.description:
ROUNDS：多轮临床证据之后基于来源框架的诊断修正

ROUNDS: Source-Framed Diagnostic Revision after Multi-Turn Clinical Evidence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19636

本文提出ROUNDS框架，通过多轮临床证据后有/无答案选项的诊断对比、不同来源（临床医生vs外行）表述框架的误导诊断以及会诊小组意见变化，系统评估大语言模型在真实多轮诊断对话中形成与修正诊断的能力，发现无答案选项时模型准确率从76.9%显著降至57.0%。

大型语言模型（LLMs）在医学基准测试中获得了高分，但这种性能能否转化为随着对话展开的可靠诊断？在诊断对话中，用户可以跨多个轮次提供临床发现，可以在不提供答案选项的情况下要求诊断，并可能引入他人的意见。因此，模型必须根据现有证据形成诊断，并决定如何回应随后的建议。我们提出了ROUNDS，一个在经过固定序列的多轮临床证据之后评估这些能力的框架。ROUNDS比较有和没有答案选项时的诊断表现，以临床医生和外行两种不同表述框架呈现相同的不正确诊断，并在书面形式的五名临床医生会诊小组中改变对相互竞争诊断的支持程度。在来自五个数据集的七个模型、共1,035个病例上，有答案选项时的平均准确率为76.9%，而没有答案选项时仅为57.0%。临床医生框架下的误导性……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19636v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high scores on medical benchmarks, but does this performance translate into reliable diagnosis as a conversation unfolds? In diagnostic conversations, users can provide clinical findings across multiple turns, ask for a diagnosis without supplying answer options, and introduce opinions from others. Models must therefore form diagnoses from the available evidence and decide how to respond to subsequent advice. We introduce ROUNDS, a framework that evaluates these abilities after a fixed sequence of clinical evidence delivered over multiple turns. ROUNDS compares diagnosis with and without answer options, presents the same incorrect diagnosis under clinician and lay framing, and varies support for competing diagnoses in written five-clinician panels. item.title: 本研究揭示了基于病理学基础模型的切片级分类器在非典型乳腺病变上失效的原因——全切片按最严重病变标注造成的标签噪声以及非典型与恶性之间的判别困难，并证明采用病变级标签按决策分别训练分类器可显著改善所有非典型性分类边界。
item.description:
切片级基础模型分类器在非典型乳腺病变上的失效之处

Where slide-level foundation-model classifiers fail on atypical breast lesions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19630

本研究揭示了基于病理学基础模型的切片级分类器在非典型乳腺病变上失效的原因——全切片按最严重病变标注造成的标签噪声以及非典型与恶性之间的判别困难，并证明采用病变级标签按决策分别训练分类器可显著改善所有非典型性分类边界。

导管性乳腺病变被诊断为非典型增生还是低级别原位癌，越来越直接决定是否进行手术。然而，基于病理学基础模型（PFMs）构建的切片级分类器恰恰在这些病变上表现最差。我们使用四种病理学基础模型，在BRACS数据集上进行交叉验证并采用预先注册的假设，研究了非典型性分类在何处失效。由于切片是按其最严重病变进行标注的，仅有39%含有非典型导管增生（ADH）标注区域的切片被标记为ADH。注意力机制能将病变区域排到较高位置但很少排到第一位，而只向模型展示病变区域本身帮助甚微；相比之下，使用病变级标签按各个决策分别训练的分类器改善了所有四个非典型性分类边界。将ADH区域插入良性切片中，其使恶性概率的提升大于使非典型概率的提升。在一个由病理医生标注单一亚型切片的医院数据集以及HISTAI数据集中，良性切片的得分更接近病变切片，且……

arXiv:2611.19630v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Whether a ductal breast lesion is called atypical hyperplasia or low-grade carcinoma in situ increasingly determines surgery. However, slide-level classifiers built on pathology foundation models (PFMs) perform worst on these lesions. Using four PFMs, cross-validation on BRACS and preregistered hypotheses, we studied where the classification of atypia fails. Because slides are labelled with their most severe lesion, only 39% of the slides with annotated atypical ductal hyperplasia (ADH) were labelled ADH. Attention ranked the lesion high but rarely first, and showing the model only the lesion helped little, whereas classifiers trained per decision with lesion-level labels improved all four atypical boundaries. ADH regions inserted into benign slides raised the probability of malignancy more than that of atypia. item.title: 提出边界门控软阈值卡尔曼融合方法ST-KF，以仅0.09%的参数开销统一小波收缩、残差先验学习与稳健卡尔曼平滑，在两个公开基准上实现跨间隙与整井的稳健测井曲线重构，全面超越九个基线方法。

提出边界门控软阈值卡尔曼融合方法ST-KF，以仅0.09%的参数开销统一小波收缩、残差先验学习与稳健卡尔曼平滑，在两个公开基准上实现跨间隙与整井的稳健测井曲线重构，全面超越九个基线方法。

缺失的电缆测井数据阻碍了地下表征。深度重构网络存在间隙边界台阶效应和跨盆地偏移问题，而插值方法和高斯平滑器在处理长井段和异常值时表现不佳。我们提出边界门控软阈值卡尔曼融合（ST-KF），统一了多分辨率小波收缩、距离门控残差先验学习以及闭式稳健卡尔曼平滑，并实现学习与推理的解耦。在涵盖挪威北海和新西兰塔拉纳基盆地共263口井的两个公开基准数据集上，ST-KF在0.15至100米的锚定间隙上排名第一，参数开销仅为0.09%。与九个基线方法中最强者相比，体积密度的汇总RMSE下降5.0%–8.3%，纵波慢度下降6.4%–15.6%；与四个最强基线相比，中子孔隙度下降0.7%–4.1%，光电因子下降1.3%–2.9%。消融实验和敏感性分析证实了……（原文摘要至此截断）

arXiv:2611.19625v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Missing wireline logs hinder subsurface characterization. Deep reconstruction networks suffer from gap-boundary steps and cross-basin shifts, while interpolation and Gaussian smoothers struggle with long intervals and outliers. We propose boundary-gated soft-thresholding Kalman fusion (ST-KF), unifying multiresolution wavelet shrinkage, distance-gated residual prior learning, and closed-form robust Kalman smoothing with learning--inference decoupling. Across two public benchmarks totaling 263 wells in the Norwegian North Sea and New Zealand's Taranaki Basin, ST-KF ranks first over 0.15--100-m anchored gaps with 0.09% parameter overhead. Against the strongest of nine baselines, pooled RMSE falls by 5.0%--8.3% for bulk density and 6.4%--15.6% for compressional slowness; against the four strongest baselines, reductions are 0.7%--4.1% for neutron porosity and 1.3%--2.9% for photoelectric factor. item.title: 该论文提出GeoLog-Agent，将预训练大语言模型作为地质先验知识来源，通过Geo-Harness把LLM的地层推理转化为生成约束条件，从而显著提升测井曲线重建的精度。
item.description:
基于预训练地质知识的测井曲线重建：一种知识条件化的大语言模型生成智能体

Well-Log Reconstruction with Pre-trained Geological Knowledge: A Knowledge-Conditioned Large-Language-Model Generative Agent

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19624

该论文提出GeoLog-Agent，将预训练大语言模型作为地质先验知识来源，通过Geo-Harness把LLM的地层推理转化为生成约束条件，从而显著提升测井曲线重建的精度。

缺失的测井曲线区间使得地下重建成为一个病态问题。现有的数值回归模型缺乏地质先验知识来约束模糊的逆映射。我们提出了GeoLog-Agent，一种知识条件化的生成智能体，利用预训练大语言模型（LLM）作为地质先验知识的来源。一个通用的Geo-Harness将LLM的地层推理转化为地层锚定的岩石物理轨迹、特征级线性调制以及条件对抗约束。在挪威北海基准数据集上，GeoLog-Agent实现了平均R²为0.9307、峰值R²为0.9713的成果。相比九个基线模型的平均R²0.8387，它高出0.0920，平均RMSE降低了30.97%；相比最强基线模型，R²高出0.0274–0.0498，RMSE降低了16.25%–24.05%。消融实验证实了地质先验推理、多尺度膨胀生成和条件对抗约束的有效性与协同作用。

arXiv:2611.19624v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Missing well-log intervals make subsurface reconstruction ill-posed. Existing numerical regression models lack geological prior knowledge to constrain ambiguous inverse mappings. We propose GeoLog-Agent, a knowledge-conditioned generative agent using pre-trained large language models (LLMs) as a source of geological priors. A universal Geo-Harness translates LLM stratigraphic reasoning into formation-anchored petrophysical trajectories, feature-wise linear modulation, and conditional adversarial constraints. On the Norwegian North Sea benchmark, GeoLog-Agent achieves a mean $R^2$ of 0.9307 and a peak $R^2$ of 0.9713. It exceeds the nine-baseline average $R^2$ of 0.8387 by 0.0920, with a 30.97% average RMSE reduction, and exceeds the strongest baseline by 0.0274--0.0498 in $R^2$, with 16.25%--24.05% lower RMSE. Ablations confirm the effectiveness and synergy of geological prior reasoning, multi-scale dilated generation, and conditional

item.title: 提出了DH-BPR框架，利用大语言模型结合事件日志中的数据信息，自动检测并应用最佳实践再造启发式方法，从而实现数据驱动、启发式引导的业务流程再造。
item.description:
数据驱动的启发式引导业务流程再造

Data-Driven Heuristic-Guided Business Process Redesign

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19623

提出了DH-BPR框架，利用大语言模型结合事件日志中的数据信息，自动检测并应用最佳实践再造启发式方法，从而实现数据驱动、启发式引导的业务流程再造。

业务流程再造（BPR）拥有一套长期积累的最佳实践再造启发式方法目录，然而，应用这些方法仍然是一项主要依赖人工的任务，需要大量的领域知识。尽管最近在使用大语言模型（LLM）进行对话式流程模型再造方面取得了进展，但仍存在局限。例如，再造是由用户驱动而非数据驱动的，且不受最佳实践（如再造启发式方法）的引导。此外，一次只能处理一个变更。为了解决这些局限，在给定事件日志和BPMN模型的前提下，我们提出了DH-BPR框架，利用大语言模型实现数据驱动、启发式引导的业务流程再造。在设计DH-BPR时，我们首先分析了哪些再造启发式方法可以基于事件日志中包含的信息（例如绕过某个活动的案例比例）被自动检测和应用。基于此，DH-BPR通过相结合的方式对启发式候选进行检测和验证。

arXiv:2611.19623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Business process redesign (BPR) has a long-standing catalog of best-practice redesign heuristics, yet, applying them remains a mostly manual task that requires extensive domain knowledge. Despite recent advances using Large Language Models (LLMs) for conversational process model redesign, limitations remain. For example, redesign is user-driven instead of data-driven and is not guided by best practices such as the redesign heuristics. Moreover, only one change can be handled at a time. To address these limitations, given an event log and a BPMN model, we present the DH-BPR framework to realize data-driven heuristic-guided BPR using LLMs. To design DH-BPR, we first conducted an analysis of which redesign heuristics can be automatically detected and applied given information contained in an event log such as the fraction of cases that bypass an activity. Based on this, DH-BPR detects and validates heuristic candidates through a combination

item.title: 本文提出了一个分层统计框架，通过定义场景、实例和采样的层次结构，系统性地量化智能体系统在不同条件下的不确定性与可靠性。
item.description:
评估智能体可靠性的分层统计框架

A Hierarchical Statistical Framework for Evaluating Agent Reliability

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19614

本文提出了一个分层统计框架，通过定义场景、实例和采样的层次结构，系统性地量化智能体系统在不同条件下的不确定性与可靠性。

在复杂场景中运行的智能体常常面临不确定性，这源于对其运行环境的信息不完整、用户查询的模糊性、复杂的业务规则以及控制策略本身固有的随机动态特性。目前已有多个新基准被提出，用于在多工具环境中评估基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在复杂任务上的表现，其中包括带有策略约束和不同意图模糊程度的设置。这些条件使得对智能体系统进行系统性评估、并量化其在不同条件下的性能以评估其生产可靠性变得至关重要。这一需求在最近推出的 Thinkingbox 基准中尤为明显——即使是性能最强的模型，也难以在多样化的业务场景中保持一致的表现。本文提出了一个用于评估智能体系统不确定性与可靠性的统计框架。我们定义了一个由场景、实例和采样构成的层次结构。

arXiv:2611.19614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agents operating in complex scenarios often face uncertainty due to incomplete information about the environment they operate in, ambiguous user queries, complex business rules and the inherently stochastic dynamics of the governing policy. Several new benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate LLM-based agents on complex tasks in multi-tool environments, including settings with policy constraints and varying levels of intent ambiguity. These conditions make it important to evaluate agentic systems systematically and quantify their performance under different conditions to assess their reliability in production. This need is evident in the recently introduced Thinkingbox benchmark, where even the strongest models struggle to perform consistently across diverse business scenarios. This paper presents a statistical framework for evaluating uncertainty and reliability in agentic systems. We define a hierarchy of scenarios, instances, and sam

item.title: 本文提出NeSySy，一个可对约束结构和复杂度等关键属性进行细粒度控制的神经符号学习任务合成生成器，能够联合生成逻辑约束与一致数据集，从而系统性研究任务难度因素及约束感知学习方法的有效性边界。
item.description:
具有受控约束复杂度的合成神经符号任务生成

Synthetic Neurosymbolic Task Generation with Controlled Constraint Complexity

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19597

本文提出NeSySy，一个可对约束结构和复杂度等关键属性进行细粒度控制的神经符号学习任务合成生成器，能够联合生成逻辑约束与一致数据集，从而系统性研究任务难度因素及约束感知学习方法的有效性边界。

我们提出了NeSySy，一个用于神经符号学习任务的合成生成器，它能够联合生成逻辑约束和一致的数据集。与现有基准不同，NeSySy对诸如约束结构、紧致性、输入依赖性以及数据生成与对齐策略等关键属性提供了细粒度的控制。特别地，它允许在无限域上使用丰富的约束，并利用求解器来确保约束是有意义的，且生成的样本满足这些约束。我们设计NeSySy旨在同时支持基于声明式约束的学习和基于远程监督的学习。在一系列约束族上，我们提供了证据表明其参数会对任务难度产生系统性的且在很大程度上相互独立的影响。利用NeSySy，我们研究了约束感知的学习方法，识别出显式约束强制有益的情形以及表达性无约束（模型表现更优）的情形。

arXiv:2611.19597v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce NeSySy, a synthetic generator for neurosymbolic learning tasks that jointly produces logical constraints and consistent datasets. Unlike existing benchmarks, NeSySy provides fine-grained control over key properties such as constraint structure, tightness, input dependence, and data generation and alignment strategies. In particular, it allows the use of rich constraints over infinite domains, and uses solvers to ensure that the constraints are meaningful and that generated samples satisfy the constraints. We design NeSySy to support both learning with declarative constraints and learning from distant supervision. Across a range of constraint families, we provide evidence that its parameters induce systematic and largely independent effects on task difficulty. Using NeSySy, we study constraint-aware learning methods, identifying regimes where explicit constraint enforcement is beneficial and where expressive unconstrained

item.title: PBit1为预训练网络的每个学习参数分配一个可编程p比特，通过12比特命令设置概率、共享仿射范围映射和时序观测重建权重，在无需微调的情况下以极小的质量损失（如GPT-2困惑度仅增加0.66%）实现了整模型的有限控制表示，并通过敏感度策略将重建观测次数减少41.7%。
item.description:
PBit1：每个参数一个可编程P比特——预训练网络的有限控制表示

PBit1: One Programmable P-Bit per Parameter - A Finite-Control Representation of Pretrained Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19588

PBit1为预训练网络的每个学习参数分配一个可编程p比特，通过12比特命令设置概率、共享仿射范围映射和时序观测重建权重，在无需微调的情况下以极小的质量损失（如GPT-2困惑度仅增加0.66%）实现了整模型的有限控制表示，并通过敏感度策略将重建观测次数减少41.7%。

我们提出了PBit1，这是一种预训练神经网络的有限控制表示方法，它为每个已学习参数分配一个可编程的p比特。一个12比特的命令用于设置其概率，一个共享的仿射范围将该概率映射到权重域，并通过时间上的多次观测来重建权重以进行推理。算子感知的范围分组和基于敏感度的采样分配使该表示能够自适应于网络结构。在五次独立权重抽取、每个标量32,768次观测的条件下，所选配置在GPT-2、DistilBERT和LFM3-1.7B上保持了任务质量，所有已学习标量均被转换且无需任何微调。GPT-2和LFM3的困惑度分别增加约0.66%和0.26%，DistilBERT的准确率从87.51%变为87.49%。基于敏感度的策略在保持质量标准的同时，将GPT-2的重建观测次数减少了41.7%。完整模型评估会复用重建的权重

arXiv:2611.19588v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce PBit1, a finite-control representation of pretrained neural networks that assigns one programmable p-bit to each learned parameter. A 12-bit command sets its probability, a shared affine range maps that probability to the weight domain, and temporal observations reconstruct the weight for inference. Operator-aware range grouping and sensitivity-based sampling allocation adapt the representation to the network. Across five independent weight draws at 32,768 observations per scalar, selected configurations preserve task quality in GPT-2, DistilBERT, and LFM3-1.7B with every learned scalar converted and no fine-tuning. GPT-2 and LFM3 perplexity increase by approximately 0.66% and 0.26%, respectively, while DistilBERT accuracy changes from 87.51% to 87.49%. item.title: 该论文提出了一种风险规避的决策聚焦学习框架，通过最小化遗憾的条件风险价值（CVaR）而非期望遗憾来考虑决策质量的尾部风险，同时保持点预测和确定性优化，无需在推理阶段引入额外的计算复杂性。
item.description:
风险规避的决策聚焦学习：最小化遗憾的条件风险价值（CVaR）

Risk-Averse Decision-Focused Learning: Minimizing CVaR of Regret

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19575

该论文提出了一种风险规避的决策聚焦学习框架，通过最小化遗憾的条件风险价值（CVaR）而非期望遗憾来考虑决策质量的尾部风险，同时保持点预测和确定性优化，无需在推理阶段引入额外的计算复杂性。

许多组合优化（CO）问题在必须求解时其参数是不确定的。在这种情形下，需要先从相关的上下文信息中预测这些参数，然后才能计算求解方案。决策聚焦学习（DFL）通过训练预测模型来产生能够优化下游决策质量的预测，从而解决这一问题。现有的大多数DFL方法是风险中性的，即最小化期望遗憾。在高风险应用中，这可能导致不良结果，因为决策者还必须考虑决策质量的尾部风险。先前的风险敏感方法通常显式地对不确定性建模，并在推理时求解随机优化或鲁棒优化问题，这增加了计算复杂性。与之不同，我们提出了一个DFL框架，它在保持点预测和推理时确定性优化的同时，实现了风险敏感的行为。

arXiv:2611.19575v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many combinatorial optimization (CO) problems involve parameters that are uncertain when the problem must be solved. In such settings, the parameters have to be predicted from correlated contextual information before a solution can be computed. \emph{Decision-focused learning} (DFL) addresses this by training the predictive model to produce predictions that optimize downstream decision quality. Most existing DFL methods are risk-neutral and minimize the expected regret. In high-stakes applications this can lead to undesirable outcomes, because decision-makers must also account for the tail risk of decision quality. Prior risk-sensitive approaches typically model uncertainty explicitly and solve a stochastic or robust optimization problem at inference time, which increases computational complexity. item.title: 提出谱导向方法，通过结合请求特定的余弦增益预测器、阻尼逆修正与固定时间重线性化，使冻结扩散生成器能够可靠地实现“改变部分输出属性同时保留其余属性”的结构化编辑请求，在8,923个实例上预测增益与实际增益的Spearman相关性达0.79，显著优于传统条件数指标。
item.description:
谱导向：冻结扩散生成器的局部逆几何

Spectral Steering: Local Inverse Geometry for Frozen Diffusion Generators

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19572

提出谱导向方法，通过结合请求特定的余弦增益预测器、阻尼逆修正与固定时间重线性化，使冻结扩散生成器能够可靠地实现“改变部分输出属性同时保留其余属性”的结构化编辑请求，在8,923个实例上预测增益与实际增益的Spearman相关性达0.79，显著优于传统条件数指标。

冻结的扩散生成器可能需要在保留其他属性的同时改变若干输出属性。我们研究了引导（guidance）何时能忠实地实现这种结构化请求，以及局部逆修正能否改善其方向。我们的理论将这一收益与请求和目标特定的剩余采样器雅可比矩阵之间的相互作用联系起来：仅靠条件化是不够的。谱导向方法将针对特定请求的余弦增益预测器与阻尼逆修正以及用于有限编辑的固定时间重线性化相结合。标量零空间与匹配运动对照实验检验了所预测的机制。在回溯性确定的局部区域内，跨8,923个实例，预测增益与实际实现增益的Spearman相关系数达0.79，而条件数仅为-0.11。实验涵盖图像、音频、机器人以及控制与规划领域，包括复杂的人物动作生成。在50个配对图像修复案例中，四次修正改善了未观……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19572v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A frozen diffusion generator may need to change several output properties while preserving others. We study when guidance faithfully realizes such a structured request and whether local inverse correction improves its direction. Our account links this benefit to the interaction between the request and the objective-specific remaining-sampler Jacobian: conditioning alone is insufficient. Spectral steering combines a request-specific cosine-gain predictor with damped inverse correction and fixed-time relinearization for finite edits. Scalar nulls and matched-movement controls test the predicted mechanism. Across 8,923 instances in a retrospectively identified local regime, predicted and realized gains correlate at Spearman 0.79, versus -0.11 for condition number. item.title: 该论文提出一种受变异测试启发的失败驱动数据筛选方法，通过将基准真值不变式变异为导致验证失败的语义变异体并结合验证器反馈来构造高质量训练数据，从而成功微调小语言模型合成循环不变式。
item.description:
从变异体中学习：教会小语言模型合成循环不变式

Learning from Mutants: Teaching Small Language Models to Synthesise Loop Invariants

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19569

该论文提出一种受变异测试启发的失败驱动数据筛选方法，通过将基准真值不变式变异为导致验证失败的语义变异体并结合验证器反馈来构造高质量训练数据，从而成功微调小语言模型合成循环不变式。

大语言模型（LLMs）已被证明在合成循环不变式方面具有前景，而循环不变式一直是自动化程序验证的长期障碍。然而，前沿大语言模型通常只能通过第三方API访问，这阻碍了可复现性和本地部署。小语言模型（SLMs）可以避开这些障碍，但需要针对特定任务的微调，而这又需要高质量的训练数据。我们提出了一种失败驱动的数据筛选方法，用于微调语言模型以合成循环不变式。受变异测试的启发，我们的方法将语义变异算子应用于基准真值不变式，产生会导致验证失败的语义变异体。每个变异体都与验证器反馈及其基准真值对应版本配对，从而产生用于反馈引导的不变式精化的训练样本。虽然庞大的变异体空间是变异测试中长期存在的负担，但当系统地进行生成时，它却成为一种资产。

arXiv:2611.19569v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have proven promising for synthesising loop invariants, a long-standing obstacle to automated program verification. Yet, frontier LLMs are typically accessible only through third-party APIs, hampering reproducibility and local deployment. Small language models (SLMs) sidestep these obstacles but require task-specific fine-tuning, for which high-quality training data is needed. We present a failure-driven data curation method for fine-tuning language models to synthesise loop invariants. Inspired by mutation testing, our approach applies semantic mutation operators to ground-truth invariants, producing semantic mutants that induce verification failure. Each mutant is paired with verifier feedback and its ground-truth counterpart, yielding training examples for feedback-guided invariant refinement. Whereas the vast space of mutants is a long-standing burden in mutation testing, it becomes an asset when genera

item.title: 该论文提出了一个衡量社会部署AI智能体行为一致性的评估框架，通过五个可测量行为维度和覆盖六种社会交互场景的标准化评估组合，借助受控人设配置系统检验智能体的行为差异与一致性是否能跨情境稳定保持。
item.description:
面向社会部署的AI智能体的行为保障

Behavioral Assurance for Socially Deployed AI Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19564

该论文提出了一个衡量社会部署AI智能体行为一致性的评估框架，通过五个可测量行为维度和覆盖六种社会交互场景的标准化评估组合，借助受控人设配置系统检验智能体的行为差异与一致性是否能跨情境稳定保持。

AI智能体正越来越多地被部署在具有社会重要性的场景中，然而现有评估方法对于智能体在多样化交互中能否与其预期特性保持行为一致，所能提供的保障十分有限。我们提出了一个用于衡量社会部署AI智能体行为一致性的评估框架。该框架沿五个可测量的维度对智能体行为进行操作化，并使用一套覆盖六种社会显著性交互场景的标准化评估组合，以评估行为的分化、一致性与漂移。受控的人设（persona）配置被用作实验锚点，从而能够系统性地检验预期的行为差异是否能跨情境持续存在，而非仅表现为风格上的变化。初步分析表明，不同配置之间存在可测量的行为分化，并显示行为特征与交互结果之间存在关联。通过将焦点从……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.19564v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, yet existing evaluations provide limited assurance that they behave consistently with their intended characteristics across diverse interactions. We introduce an evaluation framework for measuring the behavioral consistency of socially deployed AI agents. The framework operationalizes agent behavior along five measurable axes and uses a standardized evaluation battery spanning six socially salient interaction settings to assess behavioral differentiation, consistency, and drift. Controlled persona configurations serve as experimental anchors, enabling systematic testing of whether intended behavioral differences persist across contexts rather than appearing only as stylistic variation. item.title: 该研究发现明确的激励会驱使视觉语言模型在报告中偏离真实值，但当信息需要从图像像素中读取而非以文本形式给出时，模型对激励的精确服从程度显著降低，表明视觉证据能削弱激励驱动的误报行为。
item.description:
先读后偏？视觉证据如何改变视觉语言顾问中由激励驱动的误报

Read, Then Shade? How Visual Evidence Changes Incentive-Driven Misreporting in Vision-Language Advisors

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19561

该研究发现明确的激励会驱使视觉语言模型在报告中偏离真实值，但当信息需要从图像像素中读取而非以文本形式给出时，模型对激励的精确服从程度显著降低，表明视觉证据能削弱激励驱动的误报行为。

视觉语言模型越来越多地读取场景并将结果报告给依据该报告采取行动的人，而模型自身的目标有时与后者并不一致。我们探究明确的激励是否会改变VLM所报告的内容，以及当该数值必须从像素中读取而非以文本形式给出时，这种行为是否会发生变化。在固定随机种子的合成场景中，模型读取标注坐标轴上目标的位置，并向固定的接收者报告一个整数；在模拟中，它或因报告准确获得报酬，或因报告偏向某一侧若干单位而获得报酬，且每个场景还同时以文本形式提供真实值。通过一项试点研究与三项采用哈希冻结协议的后续研究，涵盖来自三个系列的四个小型开源VLM以及15,170个保留测试样本，结果表明：明确的报酬在两种模态下均会使报告发生偏移，且四个模型中有三个在图像条件下的三单位精确服从率显著低于文本条件；Qwen2.5-VL 7B则未表现出可靠差异。（原文摘要此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19561v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly read a scene and report it to someone who acts on the report, sometimes under objectives that differ from that person's. We ask whether a stated incentive moves what a VLM reports, and whether this changes when the value must be read from pixels rather than given as text. In seeded synthetic scenes, a model reads the position of a target on a labelled axis and reports one integer to a fixed receiver; it is paid, in simulation, for accuracy or for a report a few units to one side, and every scene is also presented with the true value as text. Across a pilot and three follow-up studies with hash-frozen protocols, four small open VLMs from three families, and 15,170 held-out trials, a stated payoff moved reports in both modalities, and exact compliance at three units was significantly lower with the image than with text for three of four models; Qwen2.5-VL 7B showed no reliable difference. item.title: 提出SemMask微调范式，通过基于梯度识别语义token并进行语义优先的渐进式掩码，促使扩散语言模型优先解码高信息语义token，从而克服伪自回归与虚词优先偏差，增强全局规划与并行生成能力。
item.description:
SemMask：面向扩散语言模型的语义优先渐进式掩码策略

SemMask: Semantic-Prioritized Progressive Masking for Diffusion Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19560

提出SemMask微调范式，通过基于梯度识别语义token并进行语义优先的渐进式掩码，促使扩散语言模型优先解码高信息语义token，从而克服伪自回归与虚词优先偏差，增强全局规划与并行生成能力。

扩散语言模型（DLMs）旨在实现全局并行生成。然而在实践中，它们往往表现出伪自回归行为和虚词优先的偏差，这削弱了其在文本写作和代码生成等受益于全局规划与并行解码的任务上的性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SemMask，这是一种新颖的微调范式，利用语义优先的渐进式掩码策略，鼓励模型尽早且全局地解码高信息量的语义token，从而增强其全局规划和并行生成能力。具体而言，我们首先利用原始DLM相对于每个token的梯度来识别语义token；在掩码过程中，这些语义token被优先保留，从而建立起一种渐进式生成顺序，使语义token先于虚词token被解码；同时，我们相应地调整了损失函数设计。

arXiv:2611.19560v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) are designed to enable globally parallel generation. However, in practice, they often exhibit pseudo-autoregressive behavior and a function-word-first bias, which undermines their performance on tasks such as text writing and code generation that benefit from global planning and parallel decoding. To address this, we propose SemMask, a novel fine-tuning paradigm that leverages a semantic-prioritized progressive masking strategy to encourage the model to decode high-information semantic tokens early and globally, thereby enhancing its global planning and parallel generation capabilities. Specifically, we first use the gradients of the original DLM with respect to each token to identify semantic tokens. During masking, these semantic tokens are preserved with priority, establishing a progressive generation order in which semantic tokens are decoded prior to function tokens. item.title: 提出INQUEST，一个使用27B开源模型的分阶段智能体，通过日志与相似历史issue等证据自动定位生产故障的根因代码，并基于38,001份真实issue报告构建了新基准。
item.description:
Inquest：基于分阶段智能体的日志引导根因代码定位

Inquest: Log-Guided Root-Cause Code Localization with a Staged Agent

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19554

提出INQUEST，一个使用27B开源模型的分阶段智能体，通过日志与相似历史issue等证据自动定位生产故障的根因代码，并基于38,001份真实issue报告构建了新基准。

当生产环境问题被报告时，工程师只能获得一段描述和一些日志，既没有失败的测试用例，也无法复现故障。日志显示的是故障被发现的位置，而非故障产生的原因：在我们研究的真实报告中，49%的报告文本并未提及修复最终修改的任何文件。我们从两个公开数据集和27个开源项目（Apache、Red Hat、MongoDB、MariaDB、Qt和Sakai）为这一场景构建了一个基准，其中包含38,001份已解决的issue报告及其附带日志、bug仍存在时的代码状态，以及修复所修改的文件。我们提出了INQUEST，一个使用27B开源权重模型查找故障代码的智能体。流程由代码而非模型控制：它首先收集证据，包括在报告提交之前就已解决的类似历史issue中修复的文件；随后模型只需做出三个受限决策——打开哪些文件、每个文件扮演什么角色……

arXiv:2611.19554v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When a production issue is reported, engineers get a description and some logs, but no failing test and no way to reproduce the fault. The logs show where the failure was noticed, not where it was caused: in 49% of the real reports we study, the text names none of the files that the fix later changed. We built a benchmark for this setting from two public datasets and 27 open-source projects (Apache, Red Hat, MongoDB, MariaDB, Qt and Sakai). It holds 38,001 resolved issue reports with their pasted logs, the code as it was while the bug was still present, and the files the fix changed. We present INQUEST, an agent that finds the faulty code using a 27B open-weights model. Code, not the model, controls the procedure. It first gathers the evidence, including the files fixed in similar past issues that were resolved before the report was filed. The model then makes only three bounded decisions: which files to open, what role each file plays

item.title: 提出一致性校准解释图（CCEM），通过融合多种归因方法并基于无需标注的可靠性线索进行图像自适应加权，为糖尿病视网膜病变分级模型提供更可信的可解释性。
item.description:
面向眼底图像糖尿病视网膜病变分级的病灶感知可解释人工智能

Lesion-Aware Explainable AI for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading from Fundus Images

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19550

提出一致性校准解释图（CCEM），通过融合多种归因方法并基于无需标注的可靠性线索进行图像自适应加权，为糖尿病视网膜病变分级模型提供更可信的可解释性。

深度学习模型用于糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级的事后解释难以令人信服，因为针对同一张图像，不同的归因方法会高亮不同的视网膜区域，而且视觉上看似合理的热图并不能证明被高亮的像素真正驱动了预测。我们提出了一致性校准解释图（CCEM），它融合了Grad-CAM++、Ada-SISE和SmoothGrad积分梯度（SG-IG），并使用从无需标注的可靠性线索中导出的图像特定权重进行加权，这些线索包括：删除敏感性、方法间一致性、紧凑性、视网膜包含性和峰值结构。CCEM用于解释一个冻结的序数分级器——一个带有CBAM模块和标量回归头的EfficientNet-B7，该模型在第一阶段于EyePACS 2015上预训练，在第二阶段于APTOS 2019上使用二次加权Kappa（QWK）优化的阈值进行微调；该模型在隐藏的Kaggle测试集上达到了0.920的QWK，在外部MAPLES-DR队列上达到了0.559。

arXiv:2611.19550v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Post-hoc explanations of deep-learning models for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading are difficult to trust because different attribution methods highlight different retinal regions for the same image, and a visually plausible heatmap does not show that the highlighted pixels drive the prediction. We propose the Consensus-Calibrated Explanation Map (CCEM), which fuses Grad-CAM++, Ada-SISE, and SmoothGrad Integrated Gradients (SG-IG) using image-specific weights derived from annotation-free reliability cues: deletion sensitivity, inter-method agreement, compactness, retinal containment, and peak structure. CCEM explains a frozen ordinal grader, an EfficientNet-B7 with CBAM and a scalar regression head, pre-trained on EyePACS 2015 in Stage 1 and fine-tuned on APTOS 2019 in Stage 2 with quadratic weighted kappa (QWK)-optimized thresholds; it reaches a QWK of 0.920 on the hidden Kaggle test set and 0.559 on the external MAPLES-DR cohort.
