item.title: 该论文提出在编码智能体工作期间强制执行的可执行契约，实验证明相比提示词规则、检索式指导或生成后检查，运行时强制执行能完全消除规则违规且不损失功能正确性。
item.description:
超越提示词：编码智能体的运行时契约

Beyond Prompts: Runtime Contracts for Coding Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19549

该论文提出在编码智能体工作期间强制执行的可执行契约，实验证明相比提示词规则、检索式指导或生成后检查，运行时强制执行能完全消除规则违规且不损失功能正确性。

编码智能体通过 shell 命令和文件编辑对代码仓库进行操作，团队则用书面工程规则来引导它们。工业场景期望这类规则能够被强制执行，并且其应用情况能够被证实，而以提示文本形式给出的规则两者皆无法提供。我们测试了在智能体工作时强制执行的可执行契约，与将相同规则置于提示词中、作为指导检索、或仅在生成后检查相比，是否能减少规则违规。违规行为由一个与循环内检查方法不同的预言机进行评分，该预言机由两名人工审查者和一个模型审查者验证。在针对两个模型系列的三项研究（240、112 和 108 次运行）中，执行期间的强制实施在 104 组配对运行中未产生任何预言机检测到的违规，而无规则时的违规率为 21% 至 55%，且在两项验证性研究中功能正确性没有损失。在针对已知失败场景任务的验证性研究中

arXiv:2611.19549v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coding agents act on repositories through shell commands and file edits, and teams steer them with written engineering rules. Industrial settings expect such rules to be enforced and their application to be evidenced, and a rule given as prompt text provides neither. We test whether executable contracts enforced while the agent works reduce rule violations compared with the same rules in the prompt, retrieved as guidance, or checked only after generation. Violations are scored by an oracle whose methods differ from the in-loop checks, and the oracle is validated by two human reviewers and a model reviewer. Across three studies on two model families (240, 112 and 108 runs), enforcement during execution produced no oracle-detected violation in 104 paired runs, against 21 to 55% of runs without rules, and no loss of functional correctness in the two confirmatory studies. item.title: EHRDiB通过区分原始缺失与隐去输入、结合共享多模态表示与证据条件化潜在扩散桥，统一了电子健康病历的补全与合成任务，在预测效用上大幅超越现有方法并有效控制信息披露风险。
item.description:
电子健康病历的证据条件化补全与合成

Evidence-Conditioned Completion and Synthesis of Electronic Health Records

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19546

EHRDiB通过区分原始缺失与隐去输入、结合共享多模态表示与证据条件化潜在扩散桥，统一了电子健康病历的补全与合成任务，在预测效用上大幅超越现有方法并有效控制信息披露风险。

患者信息可以指导电子健康病历（EHR）的生成，但其信息量的多少如何影响预测效用和信息披露风险，目前仍缺乏充分的研究刻画。本文提出了EHRDiB，该方法通过区分原始数据缺失与被人为隐去的输入，将就诊记录补全与数据合成两大任务统一起来，并结合共享的多模态表示与证据条件化的潜在扩散桥。研究者在MIMIC-IV数据集以及Duke Health数据的数值化和离散化表示上，将EHRDiB与三种补全方法和八种合成方法进行了对比。评估涵盖两项任务的下游预测效用、生成多样性和分布保真度，以及合成任务中的信息披露风险。EHRDiB在八项补全对比中的七项上实现了与真实数据训练分类器之间最小的效用差距。在合成任务中，针对十个MIMIC-IV主要诊断目标，其AUPRC差距缩小了45.2%；针对Duke Health数值化数据，AUPRC差距缩小了53.3%。

arXiv:2611.19546v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Patient information can guide electronic health record (EHR) generation, but how its amount shapes predictive utility and disclosure risk remains poorly characterized. Here we present EHRDiB, which unifies visit completion and synthesis by distinguishing original missingness from withheld inputs and combining a shared multimodal representation with an evidence-conditioned latent diffusion bridge. We compared EHRDiB with three completion and eight synthesis methods on MIMIC-IV and numerical and discretized Duke Health representations. Evaluation covered downstream predictive utility, generative diversity, and distributional fidelity for both tasks, and disclosure risk for synthesis. EHRDiB achieved the smallest utility gaps from real-data-trained classifiers in seven of eight completion comparisons. item.title: 提出Func-JEPA，一个在函数符号形式上预训练的数学函数编码器，其潜在空间模仿Sobolev空间H^1并将微分建模为可学习的潜在算子，冻结编码器可被轻量级模块重用于解码、组合、积分和回归等多种下游任务。
item.description:
Func-JEPA：将函数的Sobolev空间学习为潜在向量

Func-JEPA: Learning a Sobolev Space of Functions as Latent Vectors

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19542

提出Func-JEPA，一个在函数符号形式上预训练的数学函数编码器，其潜在空间模仿Sobolev空间H^1并将微分建模为可学习的潜在算子，冻结编码器可被轻量级模块重用于解码、组合、积分和回归等多种下游任务。

在视觉和语言领域，预训练一次编码器并在多个任务中重用是一种广泛采用的方法。然而，神经符号数学仍然为每个任务训练专用的序列到序列模型，因此没有共享的函数表示。在这项工作中，我们提出了函数联合嵌入预测架构（Func-JEPA，简称f-JEPA）：一个数学函数的编码器，在其符号形式上进行预训练，其潜在空间模仿Sobolev空间H^1，并且微分在该空间中是一个学习到的潜在算子。潜在向量的范数从函数中精确计算，而其方向则通过学习来匹配Sobolev角度。冻结的编码器随后被轻量级模块重用，用于从样本中进行解码、组合、积分和回归。该表示和四个下游任务在预训练分布之内和之外都进行了评估。f-JEPA能够从带噪声的样本中恢复精确的公式……

arXiv:2611.19542v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pretraining an encoder once and reusing it across tasks is a widespread approach in vision and language. However, neural symbolic mathematics still trains a dedicated sequence-to-sequence model for each task, so that no representation of a function is shared. In this work, we propose the Function Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Func-JEPA, abbreviated f-JEPA): an encoder of mathematical functions, pretrained on their symbolic form, whose latent space imitates the Sobolev space H^1 and in which differentiation is a learned latent operator. The norm of a latent is computed exactly from the function, whereas its direction is learned to match Sobolev angles. The frozen encoder is then reused by lightweight modules for decoding, composition, integration, and regression from samples. The representation and four downstream tasks are evaluated within and outside the pretraining distribution. f-JEPA recovers exact formulas from noisy sa

item.title: 该论文提出反馈级联框架，通过从回合回报到层级目标的渐进式细化，将LLM演化的程序策略在Craftax中的最终关卡到达率从不足1%提升至50%，并将控制器分解为环境解释器与目标编译器以实现对新目标的复用。
item.description:
Craftax中基于续写引导的LLM程序策略与目标编译器演化

Continuation-Guided LLM Evolution of Program Policies and Goal Compilers in Craftax

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19537

该论文提出反馈级联框架，通过从回合回报到层级目标的渐进式细化，将LLM演化的程序策略在Craftax中的最终关卡到达率从不足1%提升至50%，并将控制器分解为环境解释器与目标编译器以实现对新目标的复用。

编码智能体能够从模拟器反馈中合成并优化基于代码的策略，使生成的程序在执行时无需任何推理模型调用。但对于长时程任务，存在两个挑战：局部改进可能损害最终成功率，且切换到新目标需要重新进行一次昂贵的合成运行。我们提出了一个框架，首先通过反馈级联来细化策略以培养任务能力，即从回合回报逐步过渡到层级目标和信念更新，这些内容可以从模拟器中获得密集的评分。在Craftax游戏——一个部分可观测且程序化生成的环境中——仅通过回合级反馈进行细化时，策略在最终关卡的到达率停滞在不到1%，而采用反馈级联后，优化后的策略有50%的概率到达最终阶段（28%的概率击败最终Boss）。此外，为了使这种能力能够复用于新目标，我们将先前的控制器分解为环境解释器 $I（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19537v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coding agents can synthesize and optimize code-based policies from simulator feedback, allowing the resulting program to act with zero inference model calls. But for long horizon tasks, two challenges arise: local improvements can hurt final success and switching to a new objective requires another expensive synthesis run. We propose a framework that first develops competence by refining the policy through a feedback cascade, moving from episode returns to hierarchical goals and belief updates which can be scored densely from simulator. In the Craftax game, a partially observed and procedurally generated environment, refinements via episode level feedback stall at <1% final-level arrival, whereas with the feedback cascade the optimized policy reaches the final stage 50% of time (28% final boss defeats). item.title: 该论文提出Agent Authenticator设计，通过为AI智能体提供每个服务独立的硬件绑定密钥、无共享密钥以及由运行时强制执行的来源绑定等通行密钥级认证属性，解决了AI编程智能体因使用人类持有者凭证（如API密钥和访问令牌）而易受提示注入和供应链攻击的安全问题。
item.description:
Agent Authenticator：面向AI智能体的通行密钥级、硬件绑定认证

Agent Authenticator: Passkey-Grade, Hardware-Bound Authentication for AI Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19536

该论文提出Agent Authenticator设计，通过为AI智能体提供每个服务独立的硬件绑定密钥、无共享密钥以及由运行时强制执行的来源绑定等通行密钥级认证属性，解决了AI编程智能体因使用人类持有者凭证（如API密钥和访问令牌）而易受提示注入和供应链攻击的安全问题。

AI编程智能体现在可以代表开发者推送代码、发布软件包、调用模型API以及操作云资源。它们使用与人类相同的持有者凭证进行身份验证——即个人访问令牌、API密钥和软件包注册表令牌——而这些凭据存储在模型本身、其子进程以及任何共驻恶意软件都能读取的位置。2025年和2026年发生的安全事件，包括针对编程智能体的提示注入攻击和自我传播的供应链蠕虫，表明这种安排会以可预见的方式失效。通行密钥已经为人类解决了类似的问题，但它们每次使用都需要人工手势确认，无法由自主进程操作。我们提出了Agent Authenticator，这是一种赋予智能体通行密钥级认证属性的设计：面向每个服务的硬件绑定密钥、无共享密钥、由运行时而非模型强制执行的来源绑定、执行环境的规范化证明以及人工签名的作用域……（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.19536v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI coding agents now push code, publish packages, call model APIs and operate cloud resources on behalf of developers. They authenticate to these services with the same bearer secrets humans use, personal access tokens, API keys and package-registry tokens, stored where the model, its subprocesses and any co-resident malware can read them. Incidents in 2025 and 2026, including prompt-injection attacks on coding agents and self-propagating supply-chain worms, show that this arrangement fails in predictable ways. Passkeys solved the analogous problem for humans, but they require a human gesture on every use and cannot be operated by an autonomous process. item.title: 本文提出无前瞻偏差的rta-bench-1回测基准，通过严格控制新闻发布时间、盲测运行并将收益分解为因子暴露与阿尔法，发现LLM交易智能体赚取的主要是市场贝塔收益而非真正的阿尔法，且单次运行收益受随机种子影响巨大。
item.description:
LLM交易智能体赚取的是贝塔而非阿尔法：一个无前瞻偏差的基准测试

LLM Trading Agents Earn Beta, Not Alpha: A Look-Ahead-Free Benchmark

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19530

本文提出无前瞻偏差的rta-bench-1回测基准，通过严格控制新闻发布时间、盲测运行并将收益分解为因子暴露与阿尔法，发现LLM交易智能体赚取的主要是市场贝塔收益而非真正的阿尔法，且单次运行收益受随机种子影响巨大。

大语言模型（LLM）交易智能体如今已为用户实际交易股票，而基准测试则根据智能体的收益对模型进行排名。然而，单次运行的收益几乎无法体现交易技能。在我们的研究中，同一模型仅随机种子不同的两次运行，平均结果相差5.2个点，因此要从运气中辨别真实技能，需要在多个市场、模型和种子上进行大量回测。然而，实盘竞技场每天只交易一次，而回测要么使用模型训练截止日期之后的几个月数据，要么在模型可能记忆过的年份上运行，且通常按日历日期将新闻与价格匹配。本文提出了rta-bench-1，这是一个覆盖三个美国市场行情（上涨、熊市和崩盘）的回测基准。它只在每条新闻发布分钟之后才将其展示给智能体，以盲测和实名两种方式运行每个时期，并对每次运行进行前瞻偏差检查。它还将每次收益分解为因子暴露与阿尔法成分，并将每个决策与同一天的随机选择进行对比评分。

arXiv:2611.19530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) trading agents now trade stocks for their users, and benchmarks rank models by their agents' returns. Yet a single run's return says little about skill. In our study, two runs of the same model that differed only in the random seed ended 5.2 points apart on average, so telling skill from luck takes many backtests across markets, models and seeds. However, live arenas trade each day only once, and backtests either use the few months after a model's training cutoff or run on years the model may remember, often with news joined to prices by calendar date. In this paper, we present rta-bench-1, a backtest over three US markets (a rally, a bear market and a crash). It shows each headline only after its publication minute, plays each period blind and named, and checks every run for look-ahead. item.title: Ultra-CAN提出了一种轻量级盲神经ISAC接收机，利用单一混沌波形在240 MHz微控制器上同时实现无人机的遥测盲解码与本地种子测距，无需独立雷达收发机，参数量仅27.6k–44.2k，能耗低至每突发2.2–3.4 mJ，并达到与浮点模型等效的决策性能。
item.description:
Ultra-CAN：一种面向无人机互联网、用于基于混沌的遥测与本地种子测距的轻量级盲ISAC接收机

Ultra-CAN: A Lightweight Blind ISAC Receiver for Chaos-Based Telemetry and Local-Seed Ranging in the Internet of Drones

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19529

Ultra-CAN提出了一种轻量级盲神经ISAC接收机，利用单一混沌波形在240 MHz微控制器上同时实现无人机的遥测盲解码与本地种子测距，无需独立雷达收发机，参数量仅27.6k–44.2k，能耗低至每突发2.2–3.4 mJ，并达到与浮点模型等效的决策性能。

无人机互联网需要在SWaP-C（尺寸、重量、功耗与成本）约束下实现安全遥测与近距离感知。我们证明，由单一基于混沌的波形驱动的单个盲神经接收机可以同时完成这两项功能，而无需独立的雷达收发机。在遥测模式下，它能够盲解码对等节点的突发信号；在雷达模式下，它在本地重新生成每个突发的混沌参考信号，并对自身传输的回波进行测距。Ultra-CAN将共享的64维表示与两个超轻量骨干网络相结合——一个是注意力池化的Conv1D网络，另一个是多头QKV网络（参数量为27.6k–44.2k），为通信和感知输出头提供输入。两者均以int8 TensorFlow Lite Micro固件形式发布；Conv1D接收机在240 MHz微控制器上以24.2 KiB的激活内存、每突发2.2–3.4 mJ的实测能耗，在16.9 ms内完成一次突发判决，且决策与浮点模型等效，可支持高达59 bit/s的遥测速率或7.4 Hz的距离跟踪更新率。

arXiv:2611.19529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Internet of Drones (IoD) needs secure telemetry and proximity sensing within the SWaP-C constraints. We show that a single blind neural receiver driven by one chaos-based waveform performs both functions without a separate radar transceiver. In telemetry mode it decodes a peer's burst blindly; in radar mode it regenerates the per-burst chaotic reference locally and ranges the echoes of its own transmission. Ultra-CAN pairs a shared $64$-dimensional representation with two ultra-light backbones, an attention-pooled Conv1D network and a multi-head QKV network ($27.6$k--$44.2$k parameters), feeding communication and sensing heads. Both ship as int8 TensorFlow Lite Micro firmware; the Conv1D receiver decides a burst in $16.9$ ms on a $240$ MHz microcontroller with $24.2$ KiB of activations, a measured energy of $2.2$-$3.4$ mJ per burst, and float-equivalent decisions, sustaining up to $59$ bit/s of telemetry or a $7.4$ Hz range track. item.title: 该论文提出一个“对象化”步骤，将临床医生高频抱怨中捆绑的复合问题改写为一组范围明确、可判定的是非决策，从而保留那些原本会被可执行性过滤环节丢弃的投诉标准，并将其用于LLM评判的AI临床记录质量评估。
item.description:
对象化而非删除：基于临床医生投诉的AI环境式临床记录评估

Objectify, Don't Delete: Complaint-Derived Evaluation of Ambient Clinical Notes

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19525

该论文提出一个“对象化”步骤，将临床医生高频抱怨中捆绑的复合问题改写为一组范围明确、可判定的是非决策，从而保留那些原本会被可执行性过滤环节丢弃的投诉标准，并将其用于LLM评判的AI临床记录质量评估。

评估AI生成的临床记录的质量是困难的：像ROUGE这样的标准指标衡量的是与参考记录之间的词汇相似度，而专家清单则编码了委员会认为重要的内容。这两者都无法捕捉临床医生真正抱怨的问题。近期的研究表明，评估标准可以从用户反馈中挖掘出来，并过滤至LLM评判者能够可靠执行的标准。我们认为，这正是大量价值流失的地方。那些未能通过可执行性检验的标准，恰恰是临床医生最常提出的标准，因为高频抱怨往往以多个问题捆绑在一起的形式陈述。任何是非判断都无法对这样的复合问题进行评分。我们引入了一个“对象化”步骤，将此类标准改写为一组范围明确、界限清晰的具体决策。我们通过一个评估流程展示了这一方法：该流程从投诉中挖掘标准、对其进行对象化，并部署LLM评判者对两者进行评估。

arXiv:2611.19525v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evaluating the quality of AI-generated clinical notes is hard: standard metrics like ROUGE measure lexical similarity to reference notes, while expert checklists encode what committees believe matters. Neither captures what clinicians actually complain about. Recent work has shown that evaluation criteria can be mined from user feedback and filtered to criteria that LLM judges can reliably enforce. We argue that this is where much of the value is lost. The criteria that fail enforceability are disproportionately the ones clinicians raise most often, because high-frequency complaints are stated as several questions glued together. No yes/no judgment can grade such composites as posed. We introduce an objectification step that rewrites such criteria into sets of scoped, determinate decisions. item.title: 该研究揭示了语言模型中最优探测方向与最优引导方向并不相同——引导始终偏好更接近均值差的方向，且这一发现在不同模型系列和几乎所有层中均成立，表明探测与引导是本质上不同的任务。
item.description:
探测与引导在语言模型内部及跨模型间是否偏好相同的方向？

Do Probing and Steering Favor the Same Directions Within and Across Language Models?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19499

该研究揭示了语言模型中最优探测方向与最优引导方向并不相同——引导始终偏好更接近均值差的方向，且这一发现在不同模型系列和几乎所有层中均成立，表明探测与引导是本质上不同的任务。

语言模型隐藏状态中的某个方向可用于探测某个概念是否存在，或将模型引导至该概念。尽管探测方向常被复用于引导，但最能检测某个概念的方向未必是最能改变它的方向。我们在来自不同系列的三个指令微调模型中研究了这一区别。我们构建了一个单参数方向族，其范围从协方差调整判别式到均值差，并在固定副作用的情况下沿该方向族评估探测和加性引导（即将该方向添加到隐藏状态）。对于真实性和情感这两个概念，在所有模型中，最佳探测方向都不是最佳引导方向：引导始终偏好更接近均值差的方向。这种分离在层扫描中60个层-模型-概念组合中的59个上成立，并在所有六个模型-概念组合中均使用匹配的探测和引导文本进行验证。

arXiv:2611.19499v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A direction in a language model's hidden state can be used to probe whether a concept is present or to steer the model toward it. Although probe directions are often reused for steering, the direction that best detects a concept need not be the one that best changes it. We study this distinction in three instruction-tuned models from different families. We construct a one-parameter family of directions ranging from a covariance-adjusted discriminant to the mean difference, and evaluate probing and additive steering, which adds the direction to the hidden state, along the family at a fixed side effect. For truthfulness and sentiment, in every model, the best probe is not the best steering direction: steering consistently favors directions closer to the mean difference. item.title: 提出InvarOrd方法，通过秩不变对齐与有序知识蒸馏，仅需30个标注样本即可将鱼类新鲜度高光谱评估模型跨物种迁移，紧凑学生模型在参数减少2.54倍的情况下实现了最低的1.476天平均绝对误差。
item.description:
InvarOrd：基于秩不变对齐的自监督有序知识蒸馏，用于标签高效的跨物种高光谱鱼类新鲜度评估

InvarOrd: Self-Supervised Ordinal Knowledge Distillation with Rank-Invariant Alignment for Label-Efficient Cross-Species Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Assessment

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19472

提出InvarOrd方法，通过秩不变对齐与有序知识蒸馏，仅需30个标注样本即可将鱼类新鲜度高光谱评估模型跨物种迁移，紧凑学生模型在参数减少2.54倍的情况下实现了最低的1.476天平均绝对误差。

鱼类新鲜度的高光谱模型很少能够在不同物种之间迁移，而对新物种进行标注既缓慢又具有破坏性。同时，新鲜度本身是有序的，而标准的域对齐方法可能会抹去这种顺序关系。我们提出InvarOrd，该方法仅需30个有标注的立方体数据（每个等级5个）即可适应新物种，分为三个阶段：在未标注的源域立方体数据上进行自监督光谱预训练；通过仅在匹配等级内计算的收缩协方差差异进行跨物种对齐；以及将有序知识蒸馏到一个紧凑的学生模型中。该对齐项可被证明对等级均值是不变的，因此不会产生压缩有序轴的倾向。在成对的鲑鱼和鳕鱼数据上（各800个立方体，历时16天），源域训练的教师模型在另一物种上达到1.6至1.9天的平均绝对误差（MAE），且二次加权Kappa（QWK）低于零。这个42.3万参数的学生模型比其教师模型小2.54倍，实现了最低的MAE（1.476天）和最高的

arXiv:2611.19472v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hyperspectral models of fish freshness rarely transfer between species, and labelling a new species is slow and destructive. Freshness is also ordinal, and standard domain alignment can erase that order. We present InvarOrd, which adapts to a new species from 30 labelled cubes (5 per rank) in three stages: self-supervised spectral pretraining on unlabelled source cubes, cross-species alignment by a shrinkage covariance discrepancy computed only within matched ranks, and ordinal distillation into a compact student. The alignment term is provably invariant to the rank means, so it gives no incentive to collapse the ordinal axis. On paired salmon and cod data (800 cubes each, 16 days), a source-trained teacher reaches 1.6 to 1.9 days mean absolute error (MAE) on the other species, with quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) below zero. item.title: VAST是一个声明式靶场编译器，将真实漏洞场景编译为可验证、难度可调的多步骤环境，从而系统性评估LLM红队安全智能体。
item.description:
VAST：将真实漏洞场景编译为可验证的多步骤环境，用于评估LLM红队智能体

VAST: Compiling Grounded Vulnerability Scenarios into Verifiable, Multi-Step Environments for Evaluating LLM Red-Team Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19465

VAST是一个声明式靶场编译器，将真实漏洞场景编译为可验证、难度可调的多步骤环境，从而系统性评估LLM红队安全智能体。

评估大型语言模型（LLM）安全智能体需要可复现的环境，这些环境的工作流难度可以调节，并且其失败能够被诊断。我们提出了VAST（可验证对抗场景训练与评估），一个声明式的靶场编译器，将漏洞场景与编译器引入的工作流加固层相互分离。经过对所有主题的事后代码与AST审计，主基准保留了109条种子边（其中45条带有严格的上游CVE注释）、72个家族标识符（其中62个采用共享HMAC中继分组）、81个主题配置（76个核心配置加上5个有界执行模型），以及1,387个实例（359个经四重门控重新验证的规范规格加上1,028个种子变体），按42:39划分。在TopicServer编译器层上，跨10个编译机制家族集群进行的预算匹配270回合提示对比实验（30个P2/P3/P4实例，40轮，温度0.0）显示，glm-5.3、grok-4.7……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19465v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Evaluating Large Language Model (LLM) security agents requires reproducible environments whose workflow difficulty can be varied and whose failures can be diagnosed. We present VAST (Verifiable Adversarial Scenario Training & Evaluation), a declarative range compiler separating vulnerability scenarios from a compiler-introduced workflow-hardening layer. Following a post-hoc code and AST audit across all topics, the main benchmark retains 109 seed edges (45 with strict upstream CVE annotations), 72 family identifiers (62 under shared-HMAC relay grouping), 81 topic configurations (76 core plus 5 bounded execution models), and 1,387 instances (359 canonical four-gate-revalidated specs plus 1,028 seed variants) in a 42:39 partition. item.title: 该论文提出“程序蒸馏”框架，将LLM在系统2层面的推理与规划能力蒸馏为系统0层面可直接执行的学生程序策略，在大幅降低推理时间的同时取得优于PPO等方法的性能，并配套提出PDBench基准和PDMetaHarness元系统来支撑学习过程的评估与引导。
item.description:
程序蒸馏：将大语言模型能力从系统2迁移至系统0

Program Distillation: Transferring LLM Capability from System 2 to System 0

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19461

该论文提出“程序蒸馏”框架，将LLM在系统2层面的推理与规划能力蒸馏为系统0层面可直接执行的学生程序策略，在大幅降低推理时间的同时取得优于PPO等方法的性能，并配套提出PDBench基准和PDMetaHarness元系统来支撑学习过程的评估与引导。

arXiv:2611.19461v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：近期研究利用大语言模型（LLM）通过环境交互、反馈分析和代码修改来构建可执行程序。然而，先前的工作主要将LLM视为优化器，忽视了其在不同系统层级之间迁移知识的能力。我们提出了程序蒸馏，这是一个将能力从系统2到系统0的迁移过程形式化的框架。在学习阶段，LLM提供任务知识和初始策略草稿；在部署阶段，由学生程序执行所得策略。我们证明该方法能够在降低推理时间的同时提升性能。我们引入了PDBench，一个包含27个具有固定初始策略的离散与连续控制任务的基准测试，以及PDMetaHarness，一个独立于模型和执行框架的元系统，用于监控和引导学习过程。最强的模型达到了0.728的归一化平均得分，超过了PPO（0.656）和类似Jev的决策方法（原文摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2611.19461v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent studies leverage large language models (LLMs) to construct executable programs through environment interaction, feedback analysis, and code revision. However, prior work has mainly treated LLMs as optimizers, overlooking their ability to transfer knowledge across system levels. We propose Program Distillation (PD), a framework that formalizes the transfer of abilities from System 2 to System 0. During learning, the LLM provides task knowledge and draft strategies; at deployment, a student program executes the resulting policy. We show that this approach can improve performance while reducing inference time. We introduce PDBench, a benchmark comprising 27 discrete- and continuous-control tasks with fixed initial policies, and PDMetaHarness, a model-harness-independent meta-system for monitoring and guiding the learning process. item.title: CLEW是一种结合规则式日志到代码锚定与LLM引导反向代码追踪的智能体方法，可自动定位软件故障的根因函数并输出带机制路径与日志证据的可解释诊断结果。
item.description:
CLEW：基于日志锚定的反向追踪根因代码定位方法

CLEW: Log-Anchored Backward Tracing for Root-Cause Code Localization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19448

CLEW是一种结合规则式日志到代码锚定与LLM引导反向代码追踪的智能体方法，可自动定位软件故障的根因函数并输出带机制路径与日志证据的可解释诊断结果。

工业软件系统中的故障可能涉及多个组件，并且在生产环境之外难以复现。因此，根因代码定位通常依赖于问题描述和运行时日志。然而，日志证据可能存在噪声或不完整，且报告症状的代码可能不同于包含潜在缺陷的代码。这些条件使得识别相关日志证据以及确定哪些函数可能导致所报告的故障变得极具挑战性。为解决这一空白，我们提出了CLEW，一种结合基于规则的日志到代码锚定与大语言模型引导的反向代码追踪的智能体方法。CLEW将筛选出的观察结果组织为诊断状态，从锚定的症状函数出发引导源代码探索，并返回排序后的候选函数、受影响的模块，以及包含建议机制路径和相关日志事件的解释。在评估方面，我们构建了……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2611.19448v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Failures in industrial software systems may involve multiple components and be difficult to reproduce outside the production environment. Root-cause code localization therefore often relies on issue descriptions and runtime logs. However, log evidence may be noisy or incomplete, and the code reporting a symptom may differ from the code containing the underlying defect. These conditions make it challenging to identify relevant log evidence and determine which functions could have caused the reported failure. To address this gap, we introduce CLEW, an agentic approach that combines rule-based log-to-code anchoring with LLM-guided backward code tracing. CLEW organizes selected observations into diagnostic states, guides source exploration from anchored symptom functions, and returns ranked candidate functions, an affected module, and an explanation comprising a proposed mechanism path and associated log events. item.description:
基于规则的工具能否帮助大语言模型翻译濒危的乌拉尔语言：写入提示词还是通过MCP调用？

Do Rule-Based Tools Help LLMs Translate Endangered Uralic Languages in the Prompt or over MCP?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19439

该研究的核心贡献是首次系统评估了为大语言模型提供成熟的规则语言学资源的两种方式，发现通过MCP让模型自主调用工具（尤其是双语词典）比在提示词中预先写入分析结果更能显著提升濒危乌拉尔语言到英语的机器翻译质量。

科米-济良语、莫克沙语、埃尔齐亚语和乌德穆尔特语拥有成熟的基于规则的语言资源，包括有限状态分析器、约束语法和双语词典，但语言模型并未使用这些资源。我们探究让模型访问这些资源能否改善从这四种语言到英语的机器翻译，以及访问方式是否有影响：是将预先计算好的分析结果写入提示词，还是让模型通过模型上下文协议（MCP）自行调用这些资源作为工具。我们采用人工评估：一位专家语言学家阅读了最强模型在三种条件下的全部英文输出，共816个句子，对每个句子判断接受或拒绝，并为每个被拒绝的译文指出主要错误。将分析结果放入提示词后，被接受的译文数量从272句中的13句提升至43句；而附加工具后提升至55句。这一提升主要来自双语词典。对于乌德穆尔特语，其词典有……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19439v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Komi-Zyrian, Moksha, Erzya and Udmurt have mature rule-based resources, among them finite-state analysers, constraint grammars and bilingual dictionaries, which language models do not use. We ask whether giving a model access to these resources improves machine translation from the four languages into English, and whether it matters how the access is provided: as analyses computed in advance and written into the prompt, or as tools that the model calls itself through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We evaluate manually: an expert linguist read every English output of the strongest model under three conditions, 816 sentences in all, accepted or rejected each one, and named the main error in every rejected translation. With the analyses in the prompt, the number of accepted translations rises from 13 to 43 out of 272; with the tools attached it rises to 55. The gain comes from the bilingual dictionary. item.title: 该论文提出一种免训练的轻量级框架，利用密集像素级CLIP特征、枢轴视图选择与跨视图视频分割传播，将2D轨迹提升至3D高斯，实现快速高效的文本查询驱动开放词汇3D实例分割。
item.description:
为开放词汇查询做更轻量、更快速的准备：一种面向高斯泼溅的逐查询3D分割器

Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19429

该论文提出一种免训练的轻量级框架，利用密集像素级CLIP特征、枢轴视图选择与跨视图视频分割传播，将2D轨迹提升至3D高斯，实现快速高效的文本查询驱动开放词汇3D实例分割。

开放词汇3D理解旨在对超出预定义类别的任意物体进行定位与分割。然而，现有基于高斯泼溅的方法通常依赖代价高昂的预处理和冗长的训练，限制了其在需要快速、轻量化解决方案场景下的适用性。我们提出了一种轻量级、免训练的框架，用于基于查询的高斯泼溅3D实例分割。与传统基于掩码的CLIP嵌入不同，我们使用密集的像素级CLIP特征来保留细粒度的语义信息，从而实现灵活的文本驱动定位，而无需依赖预定义的实例提议。给定一个文本查询，我们在精心选取的枢轴视图中识别出高质量的目标区域，并借助视频分割器将其跨视图传播，从而为目标实例提供一致且全面的覆盖。随后，我们通过一种新颖的视...（将得到的2D轨迹提升到3D高斯上。）

arXiv:2611.19429v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D understanding aims to localize and segment arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. However, existing approaches based on Gaussian Splatting often rely on expensive preprocessing and lengthy training, limiting their applicability when fast and lightweight solutions are desired. We propose a lightweight, training-free framework for query-driven 3D instance segmentation on Gaussian Splatting. Instead of conventional mask-wise CLIP embeddings, we use dense pixel-level CLIP features to preserve fine-grained semantic information and enable flexible text-driven localization without relying on predefined instance proposals. item.title: 本研究通过对四个Qwen师生模型对系统比较多种优化器，发现预训练中矩阵结构优化器的增益并不能自动迁移到短程KL蒸馏任务，AdamW在质量与训练时间的权衡上依然表现最佳。
item.description:
预训练优化器的增益能否迁移到KL蒸馏？

Do Pretraining Optimizer Gains Transfer to KL Distillation?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19419

本研究通过对四个Qwen师生模型对系统比较多种优化器，发现预训练中矩阵结构优化器的增益并不能自动迁移到短程KL蒸馏任务，AdamW在质量与训练时间的权衡上依然表现最佳。

矩阵结构优化器可以改善语言模型的预训练，但这些增益是否能迁移到从指令微调初始化出发的短程KL蒸馏中尚不明确。我们在统一的forward-KL目标和固定训练预算下，将AdamW和对角AdaGrad与两种可行的Shampoo简化版本、SOAP以及All-2D Muon进行了比较，实验覆盖四个稠密Qwen师生模型对。在各个模型规模上，没有任何一个被评估的矩阵结构优化方案在质量与训练时间的权衡上能持续优于逐元素基线：AdamW通常达到最低的验证KL，而AdaGrad在更大规模下可能略快一些。SOAP的KL表现通常接近AdamW，但会带来显著的训练时间开销；两种Shampoo简化版本在不同模型对之间的性能排序会发生颠倒，这表明结论依赖于具体可行的方案。这些结果表明，预训练中优化器的增益并不会自动迁移到（KL蒸馏中）。

arXiv:2611.19419v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Matrix-structured optimizers can improve language-model pretraining, but it is unclear whether these gains transfer to short-horizon KL distillation from an instruction-tuned initialization. We compare AdamW and diagonal AdaGrad with two tractable Shampoo reductions, SOAP, and All-2D Muon across four dense Qwen student-teacher pairs under a common forward-KL objective and fixed training budget. Across scales, none of the evaluated matrix-structured recipes consistently improves the quality versus trainer-time trade-off over the elementwise references: AdamW generally attains the lowest validation KL, while AdaGrad can be slightly faster at larger scale. SOAP often tracks AdamW in KL but incurs substantial trainer-time overhead, and the two Shampoo reductions reverse ordering across model pairs, showing that conclusions depend on the feasible recipe. These results suggest that pretraining optimizer gains do not transfer automatically to

item.title: 该论文提出原型中介路由PMR，通过共享原型将输入匹配与专家分配解耦建模，并借助拥堵定价机制实现无损负载均衡。
item.description:
PMR：基于共享原型与拥堵定价的混合专家路由

PMR: MoE Routing with Shared Prototypes and Congestion Pricing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19413

该论文提出原型中介路由PMR，通过共享原型将输入匹配与专家分配解耦建模，并借助拥堵定价机制实现无损负载均衡。

稀疏混合专家模型中的传统线性路由器直接根据词元-专家匹配分数来选择专家，从而将输入匹配与专家分配耦合在一起。我们提出了原型中介路由（Prototype-Mediated Routing, PMR），这是一种具有共享原型的两阶段路由器。PMR首先计算每个词元在原型上的分布，然后依据全概率公式，利用该分布混合以原型为条件的专家分布。这一建模方式将输入匹配与专家分配分开处理，显式地表示了原型与专家之间的多对多关联，并为上下文适应与负载调节提供了相互独立的接口。在该框架中，短期状态通过总结前序词元来适应原型，而基于分发反馈更新的拥堵价格则通过调整条件专家分布来实现无损的负载均衡。我们采用两遍分块近似来加速短期……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional linear routers in sparse mixture-of-experts models select experts directly from token-expert matching scores, coupling input matching with expert allocation. We propose Prototype-Mediated Routing (PMR), a two-stage router with shared prototypes. PMR first computes each token's distribution over prototypes, then uses it to mix prototype-conditioned expert distributions according to the law of total probability. This formulation models input matching and expert allocation separately, explicitly represents many-to-many associations between prototypes and experts, and provides separate interfaces for context adaptation and load regulation. Within this framework, short-term states summarize preceding tokens to adapt the prototypes, while congestion prices updated from dispatch feedback achieve loss-free load balancing by adjusting the conditional expert distributions. We use a two-pass blockwise approximation to accelerate short-

item.title: 该论文提出DECOY基准，通过符号求解器认证的反事实提示家族量化语言模型对物理问题中无关细节的过度敏感，并证明隐藏状态上的线性探针可在生成答案之前预测这种敏感性。
item.description:
无根据的自信：预测与定位语言模型隐藏状态中的物理捷径敏感性

Confidence Without Cause: Predicting and Localizing Physics-Shortcut Sensitivity in Language Model Hidden States

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19403

该论文提出DECOY基准，通过符号求解器认证的反事实提示家族量化语言模型对物理问题中无关细节的过度敏感，并证明隐藏状态上的线性探针可在生成答案之前预测这种敏感性。

语言模型在物理问题上的置信度只有在它忽略与答案无关的细节时才值得信赖。我们提出了DECOY（面向物理的干扰项嵌入认证反事实）：155个家族，每个家族包含四个仅在某一无关细节上不同的提示。符号求解器认证每次编辑都保持答案不变。家族依据模型对认证答案的对数概率的最大下降进行标记，阈值在探针训练之前固定。Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在产生标签的140个家族中有50.0%表现出敏感性，而Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct为22.9%。当干扰值在数值上接近答案时，这种效应最大。在Qwen第18层隐藏状态上训练的线性探针（对四次渲染取平均），能够在生成之前预测敏感性，在整族留出的情况下AUROC达到0.760；单独调优的单次渲染探针达到0.747；冻结的第16层探针在15个家族上达到0.820的汇总AUROC。

arXiv:2611.19403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A language model's confidence on a physics problem deserves trust only if it ignores details irrelevant to the answer. We introduce DECOY (Distractor-Embedded Certified cOunterfactuals for phYsics): 155 families of four prompts differing in one irrelevant detail. A symbolic solver certifies that each edit preserves the answer. Families are labelled by the largest drop in the model's log-probability of the certified answer, using a threshold fixed before probe training. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is sensitive on 50.0% of the 140 families yielding labels, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on 22.9%. Effects are largest when distractor values lie numerically close to the answer. A linear probe on Qwen's layer-18 hidden state, averaged over four renderings, predicts sensitivity before generation at AUROC 0.760 with whole families held out. A separately tuned single-rendering probe reaches 0.747. A frozen layer-16 probe reaches 0.820 pooled AUROC on 15 famil

item.title: PIXEL-KWS 用渲染的灰度字形图像加轻量级 CNN 编码替代基于固定词表的嵌入查表，使开放词汇关键词检测对同形字、l33tspeak 等视觉相似符号更鲁棒，并在 LibriPhrase 上无需预训练或合成数据即超越所有已发表基线。
item.description:
Pixel-KWS：面向正字法鲁棒开放词汇关键词检测的渲染字形表示

Pixel-KWS: Rendered-Glyph Representations for Orthographically Robust Open-Vocabulary Keyword Spotting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19389

PIXEL-KWS 用渲染的灰度字形图像加轻量级 CNN 编码替代基于固定词表的嵌入查表，使开放词汇关键词检测对同形字、l33tspeak 等视觉相似符号更鲁棒，并在 LibriPhrase 上无需预训练或合成数据即超越所有已发表基线。

开放词汇关键词检测（KWS）允许用户在推理时注册任意关键词。然而，基于字符和音素的文本编码器依赖于训练期间学到的固定符号词表，这限制了它们处理未见过的或视觉上相似符号的能力，例如同形异码字、l33tspeak 替换字符和带变音符的字符。我们提出 PIXEL-KWS，一种通过渲染字形而非学习到的嵌入查表来表示字符的开放词汇 KWS 框架。我们将每个字符渲染为灰度图像，并用轻量级 CNN 进行编码，使文本编码器能够从视觉形态而非固定词表进行泛化。在 LibriPhrase 数据集上，PIXEL-KWS 与其对应的基于字符的匹配模型在 LibriPhrase-hard 上分别取得 9.57% 和 9.55% 的 EER，在 LibriPhrase-easy 上分别取得 0.43% 和 0.41% 的 EER，在无需预训练或合成数据的情况下超越了所有已发表的基线。PIXEL-KWS 提供了显著更强的鲁棒性……

arXiv:2611.19389v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open-vocabulary keyword spotting (KWS) allows users to enroll arbitrary keywords at inference time. However, character and phoneme-based text encoders rely on fixed symbol vocabularies learned during training, limiting their ability to handle unseen or visually similar symbols such as homoglyphs, l33tspeak substitutions, and accented characters. We propose PIXEL-KWS, an open-vocabulary KWS framework that represents characters through rendered glyphs rather than learned embedding lookups. We render each character as a grayscale image and encode it with a lightweight CNN, enabling the text encoder to generalize from visual form rather than a fixed vocabulary. On LibriPhrase, PIXEL-KWS and its matched character-based counterpart achieve 9.57% and 9.55% EER on LibriPhrase-hard, 0.43% and 0.41% EER on LibriPhrase-easy, outperforming all published baselines without pre-training or synthetic data. item.title: SARGO提出了一种基于策略内自引导的后训练框架，通过一致性门控的选择性强化与抑制机制，让有依据支撑的词元获得更强强化与更弱惩罚，从而在缓解视觉语言模型幻觉的同时保留有依据的视觉信息。
item.description:
SARGO：通过策略内自引导实现一致性门控强化与抑制以缓解视觉幻觉

SARGO: Agreement-Gated Reinforcement and Suppression via On-Policy Self-Guidance for Visual Hallucination Mitigation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19388

SARGO提出了一种基于策略内自引导的后训练框架，通过一致性门控的选择性强化与抑制机制，让有依据支撑的词元获得更强强化与更弱惩罚，从而在缓解视觉语言模型幻觉的同时保留有依据的视觉信息。

视觉语言模型仍然容易产生视觉幻觉，常常在同一个回复中将有依据的信息与无依据的主张混在一起。响应级别的强化学习为响应中的所有词元分配共享的优势值，导致负向更新在抑制无依据主张的同时也错误地抑制了正确信息。为了在减少幻觉的同时保留有用的视觉信息，我们提出了SARGO（自引导优势路由接地优化），这是一个通过策略内自引导实现选择性强化与抑制的后训练框架。直接与互惠加权使得支撑更充分的词元在正向更新中获得更强的强化，在负向更新中受到更弱的惩罚。整体优势与幻觉特定优势之间的一致性决定了何时应用这种引导。在响应级别，基于参考校准的奖励将事实性与有依据信息的保留和扩展相结合。

arXiv:2611.19388v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-language models remain susceptible to visual hallucinations, often mixing grounded information with unsupported claims in the same response. Response-level reinforcement learning assigns a shared advantage to all tokens in a response, causing negative updates to suppress correct information alongside unsupported claims. To reduce hallucination while preserving useful visual information, we introduce SARGO (Self-guided Advantage-Routed Grounding Optimization), a post-training framework for selective reinforcement and suppression through on-policy self-guidance. Direct and reciprocal weighting gives better-supported tokens stronger reinforcement on positive updates and weaker penalties on negative updates. Agreement between overall and hallucination-specific advantages selects when to apply this guidance. At the response level, a reference-calibrated reward couples factuality with the retention and expansion of grounded information,

item.title: 本文构建了包含200个任务和367个案例的UrbanWind-AgentBench基准，并提出两层评分体系与WindPilot执行框架，以确保AI智能体在城市风场CFD仿真中交付的结果具备可追溯性和可复算性，而非仅仅完成一次运行。
item.description:
一次完成的仿真运行对AI智能体而言就意味着可用的城市风场结果吗？

Does a completed simulation run mean a usable urban wind result for AI agents?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19385

本文构建了包含200个任务和367个案例的UrbanWind-AgentBench基准，并提出两层评分体系与WindPilot执行框架，以确保AI智能体在城市风场CFD仿真中交付的结果具备可追溯性和可复算性，而非仅仅完成一次运行。

基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI智能体如今已能够配置并运行计算流体动力学（CFD）求解器，但一次完成的运行并不能保证所交付的指标可以从原始输出中重新计算得到。本文针对城市风场仿真中的这一差距进行了考察：在该领域中，多案例比较必须保持非目标条件固定不变，且报告的数值必须可追溯至原始样本。研究构建了UrbanWind-AgentBench，涵盖10个工程任务族中的200个任务和367个案例。公开的任务契约规定了变量因素、固定条件、数值阈值和交付物要求，两层评分体系将针对交付物、运行溯源和原始证据的结构性评分，与通过对参考结果进行独立重算获得的数值评分区分开来。随后，本文提出了WindPilot作为执行框架，该框架融合了契约解析、执行溯源、确定性验证和有界接受机制。

arXiv:2611.19385v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now configure and run computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solvers, but a completed run does not ensure that delivered metrics can be recomputed from raw outputs. This gap was examined for urban wind simulation, where multi-case comparisons must hold non-target conditions fixed and reported values must be traceable to raw samples. UrbanWind-AgentBench, comprising 200 tasks and 367 cases in 10 engineering task families, was constructed. Public task contracts specify variable factors, fixed conditions, numerical thresholds and deliverable requirements, and two-layer scoring separates a structural score for deliverables, run provenance and raw evidence from a numerical score obtained by independent recomputation against references. WindPilot was then proposed as an execution framework that incorporates contract parsing, execution provenance, deterministic verification and bounded acceptance

item.title: 在一项预注册的98个配对编码任务测试中，自动提醒Gemma 4编码智能体其最近一次发现（以对抗上下文截断导致的遗忘）并未带来可测量的性能提升。
item.description:
一次运行还不够：在配对测试中，提醒小型Gemma 4编码智能体回顾其最近一次发现并未产生可测量的差异

One Run Is Not Enough: Reminding a small Gemma 4 coding agent of its last finding made no measurable difference in a paired test

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19359

在一项预注册的98个配对编码任务测试中，自动提醒Gemma 4编码智能体其最近一次发现（以对抗上下文截断导致的遗忘）并未带来可测量的性能提升。

arXiv:2611.19359v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：当编码智能体的上下文空间耗尽时，其先前的发现会被截断并被遗忘。我们测试了一个简单的修复方法：自动把该智能体最近的一次发现重新放到它面前。我们事先固定了实验规则，并在Gemma 4 Developer Agent框架中使用Gemma 4 31B（QAT，4比特量化）运行了98个配对编码任务，分别带与不带这一提醒。该提醒没有产生可测量的差异：在全部98个任务中，带提醒时解决了47个，不带提醒时解决了48个（-1.0分，95%区间[-8.3, +6.3]，精确McNemar检验 p=1.0）。主要结局指标（与预注册内容存在记录在案的偏差）即前48对任务中，带记忆为29/48，不带记忆为25/48（+8.3分，[-2.1, +18.3]，p=0.22）；在该结果之后决定的50个任务扩展则指向相反方向（18/50 对 23/50，-10.0分，p=0.125），因此该效应方向未能复现。考虑到在两次完全相同的无记忆运行之间有19%的任务结果发生翻转，合并后的区间排除了大于……的危害（原文摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2611.19359v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When a coding agent runs out of room, its earlier findings are cut and it forgets them. We tested a simple fix: automatically putting the agent's last finding back in front of it. We fixed the rules in advance and ran 98 paired coding tasks with and without this reminder, using Gemma 4 31B (QAT, 4-bit) in the Gemma 4 Developer Agent harness. The reminder made no measurable difference: across all 98 tasks, 47 were solved with it and 48 without (-1.0 points, 95% interval [-8.3, +6.3], exact McNemar p=1.0). The primary outcome (a documented deviation from our preregistration), the first 48 pairs, was 29/48 with memory against 25/48 without (+8.3 points, [-2.1, +18.3], p=0.22); the extension of 50 tasks, decided after that result, pointed the other way (18/50 against 23/50, -10.0 points, p=0.125), so the sign did not replicate. With 19% of tasks flipping between two identical no-memory runs, the combined interval excludes harms larger than a

item.title: SMELL通过局部稀疏前向自适应、共识锚定稀疏协调和通信高效渐进更新恢复三种机制，解决了资源受限设备上长上下文LLM联邦微调的内存、异构性和通信挑战，峰值内存消耗最多降低88.35%。
item.description:
SMELL：面向长上下文大语言模型的稀疏感知内存高效联邦微调

SMELL: Sparsity-aware Memory Efficient Federated Fine-tuning for Long-context LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19349

SMELL通过局部稀疏前向自适应、共识锚定稀疏协调和通信高效渐进更新恢复三种机制，解决了资源受限设备上长上下文LLM联邦微调的内存、异构性和通信挑战，峰值内存消耗最多降低88.35%。

联邦微调使大语言模型（LLM）能够协作地适应分布式的私有数据。然而，在资源受限设备上进行长上下文微调面临着巨大的挑战，这些挑战源于过大的激活内存、客户端之间异构的标记重要性模式以及通信开销。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了SMELL，一个面向长上下文LLM的稀疏感知且内存高效的联邦微调框架。SMELL集成了三种互补机制：局部稀疏前向自适应（LSFA）、共识锚定稀疏协调（CASC）以及通信高效的渐进式更新恢复（CPUR）。这些机制共同实现了内存高效的本地适应、异构性感知的稀疏协调以及轻量级的模型更新传输。在OPT-350M和LLaMA2-7B上的实验表明，SMELL将峰值内存消耗降低了高达88.35%。

arXiv:2611.19349v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Federated fine-tuning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to collaboratively adapt to distributed private data. However, long-context fine-tuning on resource-constrained devices faces substantial challenges arising from excessive activation memory, heterogeneous token-importance patterns across clients, and communication overhead. To address these challenges, we propose SMELL, a Sparsity-aware and Memory-Efficient federated fine-tuning framework for Long-context LLMs. SMELL integrates three complementary mechanisms: Local Sparse-Forward Adaptation (LSFA), Consensus-Anchored Sparsity Coordination (CASC), and Communication-Efficient Progressive Update Recovery (CPUR). These mechanisms jointly enable memory-efficient local adaptation, heterogeneity-aware sparsity coordination, and lightweight model-update transmission. Experiments on OPT-350M and LLaMA2-7B demonstrate that SMELL reduces peak memory consumption by up to 88.35% compared wi

item.title: 提出AttentionUNet-CA模型，将注意力U-Net与元胞自动机结合用于模拟印度勒克瑙的多类土地利用与土地覆盖变化，并强调必须与零模型及经典基线进行严格对比评估。
item.description:
用于印度勒克瑙多类土地利用与土地覆盖变化模拟的注意力U-Net元胞自动机：与零模型及经典基线的对比评估

Attention U-Net Cellular Automata for Multi-Class Land Use and Land Cover Change Simulation in Lucknow, India: Evaluation Against Null and Classical Baselines

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19348

提出AttentionUNet-CA模型，将注意力U-Net与元胞自动机结合用于模拟印度勒克瑙的多类土地利用与土地覆盖变化，并强调必须与零模型及经典基线进行严格对比评估。

卷积网络常被用于学习土地利用元胞自动机（CA）的转换规则，但其预测结果很少与预测“无变化”的零模型进行比较。我们构建了AttentionUNet-CA，该模型读取32×32邻域的土地覆盖状态及四个驱动因素（海拔、距主要道路的距离、距中央商务区（CBD）的距离以及人口密度），并预测每个单元格十年后的状态。我们在印度勒克瑙对其进行了测试，使用了1990年、2000年、2010年和2020年的GLC_FCS30D土地覆盖数据（这是一套30米分辨率、跨时间一致制图的数据序列），并将其建成用地类别与GHSL和ESA WorldCover进行了对比。AttentionUNet-CA在1990-2010年的数据上训练，在留出的独立空间区块上进行模型选择，并在2010-2020年上进行一次性评估，共使用三个随机种子。基线包括零模型、随机森林元胞自动机（RF-CA）以及不含注意力机制的U-Net CA；每个网络分别在有类别权重和无类别权重两种设置下训练。研究区中仅有8.1%……

arXiv:2611.19348v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Convolutional networks are often used to learn the transition rules of land-use cellular automata (CA), yet their predictions are seldom compared with a null model that predicts no change. We built AttentionUNet-CA, which reads a 32 x 32 neighbourhood of land-cover states with four drivers (elevation, distance to major roads, distance to the central business district (CBD) and population density) and predicts the state of each cell ten years later. We tested it on Lucknow, India, with GLC_FCS30D land cover for 1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020, a 30 m series mapped consistently over time, and compared its built-up class with GHSL and ESA WorldCover. AttentionUNet-CA was trained on 1990-2010, selected on held-out spatial blocks and evaluated once on 2010-2020, with three seeds. Baselines were the null model, a random-forest CA (RF-CA) and a U-Net CA without attention; each network was trained with and without class weights. Only 8.1% of the study

item.title: 本文刻画了循环模型在不重放历史数据的条件下进行状态迁移所必须保留的最小信息量，证明了带标量输入的可控d状态模型至多需要kd个额外实数坐标，且单个秩一替换方向即可要求全部kd个。
item.description:
免重放循环状态迁移的信息极限

Information Limits of Replay-Free Recurrent State Migration

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19345

本文刻画了循环模型在不重放历史数据的条件下进行状态迁移所必须保留的最小信息量，证明了带标量输入的可控d状态模型至多需要kd个额外实数坐标，且单个秩一替换方向即可要求全部kd个。

当一个循环（递归）模型被替换时，其旧状态可能无法决定新模型基于相同历史输入会计算出什么。本文刻画了在替换方案未知之前必须保留的信息。对于时不变的仿射线性模型族，阶数为k的局部迁移所需的最小连续因果记忆，等于提升系数系统的可达维数减去锚定状态所含的信息。对于带标量输入的可控d状态模型，即使任意的矩阵替换方向仅在流式处理之后才被揭示，也至多需要kd个额外的实数坐标；而单个秩一方向就可能已经要求全部kd个坐标。条件奇异值与辅助比特界将该局部信息定律与固定容差下的恢复区分开来。作者还给出了不变子空间与未来输出相关的构造，并通过受控实验比较了由此产生的各种状态表示。在一个小型语言模型中……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19345v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When a recurrent model is replaced, its old state may not determine what the new model would compute from the same history. We characterize the information that must be retained before the replacement is known. For a time-invariant affine linear family, the minimum continuous causal memory for order-$k$ local migration equals the reachable dimension of a lifted coefficient system minus the information in the anchor state. A controllable $d$-state model with scalar input needs at most $kd$ additional real coordinates, even when arbitrary matrix replacement directions are revealed only after streaming. A single rank-one direction can already require all $kd$. Conditional singular values and auxiliary-bit bounds distinguish this local information law from recovery at a fixed tolerance. We also give invariant-subspace and future-output constructions. Controlled experiments compare the resulting representations. In a small language model, equ

item.title: OmitEHR通过从LLM普及前临床医生撰写的历史摘要中学习临床显著性，实现了无需参考即可扩展检测LLM生成临床总结中关键信息遗漏的方法。
item.description:
OmitEHR：LLM生成临床总结中可扩展的遗漏检测方法

OmitEHR: Scalable Omission Detection in LLM-Generated Clinical Summaries

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19343

OmitEHR通过从LLM普及前临床医生撰写的历史摘要中学习临床显著性，实现了无需参考即可扩展检测LLM生成临床总结中关键信息遗漏的方法。

医疗系统日益依赖大型语言模型（LLM）来起草患者医疗记录的摘要，然而评估研究发现，遗漏——即临床重要信息的缺失——是最常见的失败模式。检测LLM生成摘要中的遗漏需要知道记录中哪些事实是具有重要临床意义的，而现有方法要么手动指定这一信号，要么忽略它，要么在推理阶段使用成本高昂的LLM评判器重新计算。我们提出了OmitEHR，一种无需参考答案的遗漏检测器，它从LLM广泛应用之前的临床医生撰写的历史摘要中学习临床显著性。OmitEHR学习预测临床医生在其摘要中会包含哪些源记录中的句子，然后将LLM生成摘要未覆盖的高显著性句子作为候选遗漏呈现出来。我们将OmitEHR应用于简短住院病程（BHC）总结任务，使用了来自一家大型学术医疗中心的5,000例住院数据。在留出的住院数据上，OmitEHR

arXiv:2611.19343v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Health systems increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to draft summaries of patient medical records, yet evaluations now find omissions, the absence of clinically important information, to be the most common failure mode. Detecting omissions in an LLM-generated summary requires knowing which facts in the record are salient, a signal that existing methods hand-specify, ignore, or recompute at inference with costly LLM judges. We present OmitEHR, a reference-free omission detector that learns clinical salience from historical clinician-written summaries predating widespread LLM use. OmitEHR learns to predict which source-note sentences clinicians include in their summaries, then surfaces high-salience sentences not covered by an LLM-generated summary as candidate omissions. We apply OmitEHR to brief hospital course (BHC) summarization using 5,000 admissions from a large academic medical center. On held-out admissions, OmitEHR

item.title: 该研究通过对十个大语言模型在1,464个肿瘤耐药病例上共58,910次判断的大规模评估，揭示了临床大语言模型经常无视基因组耐药性证据而推荐无效的癌症疗法，且其失效程度强烈依赖于参考知识库和证据强度。
item.description:
从突变到用药：临床大语言模型无视基因组耐药性证据的失效特征分析

From Mutation to Medication: Characterizing Failures of Clinical LLMs to Respect Genomic Resistance

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19339

该研究通过对十个大语言模型在1,464个肿瘤耐药病例上共58,910次判断的大规模评估，揭示了临床大语言模型经常无视基因组耐药性证据而推荐无效的癌症疗法，且其失效程度强烈依赖于参考知识库和证据强度。

arXiv:2611.19339v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：语言模型正被越来越多地提议用于支持分子肿瘤委员会的工作，但即使在存在基因组耐药性证据的情况下，它们也可能推荐癌症疗法。我们在来自五个精心整理的肿瘤学知识库的1,464个耐药病例上评估了十个模型，共收集了58,910次判断。模型在21.8%至81.4%的病例中认可了已产生耐药性的疗法。然而，原始认可率可能反映的是一种倾向于附和的倾向，而非区分耐药性与药物敏感性的能力：例如，一个开源权重模型对81.4%的耐药病例和82.3%的敏感性对照组均表示认可。因此，我们在匹配的基因和证据级别组内比较了认可率。需要说明的是，这一分析具有探索性，因为它是在预注册分析之后才指定的，而预注册分析的结果为零到微弱。测量到的失效在很大程度上取决于参考知识库和证据强度。当第二个来源独立确认了耐药性时，来自三个供应商的四个模型在……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19339v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models are increasingly proposed to support molecular tumour boards, but may recommend cancer therapies despite genomic evidence of resistance. We evaluated ten models on 1,464 resistance cases from five curated oncology knowledge bases, collecting 58,910 judgments. Models endorsed resisted therapies in 21.8-81.4% of cases. However, raw rates can reflect a tendency to agree rather than an ability to distinguish resistance from drug sensitivity: one open-weight model endorsed 81.4% of resistance cases and 82.3% of sensitivity controls. We therefore compared endorsement within matched gene and evidence-level groups. This analysis is exploratory because it was specified after the pre-registered analysis, which yielded null-to-weak results. Measured failures depended strongly on the reference knowledge base and evidence strength. When a second source independently confirmed resistance, four models across three vendors endorsed at mo

item.title: NI-ACT提出了一种分层脑-具身操作框架，将短暂读取的运动皮层群体神经活动编码为持久意图token来条件化视觉运动策略，使神经意图本身即可决定机器人抓取的目标，从而让用户摆脱传统脑机接口中需逐动作神经指定的快速感觉运动回路。
item.description:
NI-ACT：面向脑具身操作的神经意图接口

NI-ACT: A Neural Intent Interface for Brain-Embodied Manipulation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19332

NI-ACT提出了一种分层脑-具身操作框架，将短暂读取的运动皮层群体神经活动编码为持久意图token来条件化视觉运动策略，使神经意图本身即可决定机器人抓取的目标，从而让用户摆脱传统脑机接口中需逐动作神经指定的快速感觉运动回路。

皮质内脑机接口可以驱动机器人手臂，但用户始终被困在快速的感觉运动回路中：每一次接近、修正和抓取都必须通过神经信号逐步指定。皮质内群体神经活动能否转而作为学习到的具身策略的任务级条件——无需符号命令或手工设计的技能库——仍是一个未知问题。NI-ACT通过一个分层的脑-具身框架回答了这一问题：一次性读取短暂的运动皮层信号作为持久意图，随后由视觉运动策略基于视觉和本体感觉闭合感知-行动回路。在一个场景本身无法指定目标的反事实抓取任务中，仅凭神经意图就决定了机器人抓取哪个物体；替换意图则会相应地改变行为。将完整的群体神经潜变量作为专用意图token传递，而非单热解码的方向，提升了抓取完成率……

arXiv:2611.19332v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intracortical brain-computer interfaces can drive robotic arms, but they keep the user inside the fast sensorimotor loop: every approach, correction, and grasp must be neurally specified. Whether intracortical population activity can instead serve as a task-level condition for a learned embodied policy, without symbolic commands or hand-designed skill libraries, remains unknown. NI-ACT addresses this question with a hierarchical brain-embodied framework: a brief motor-cortical signal is read once as a persistent intent, and a visuomotor policy then closes the perception-action loop from vision and proprioception. In a counterfactual grasping task where the scene cannot specify the target, the neural intent alone determined which object the robot grasped; replacing the intent changed the behavior accordingly. item.title: 该研究构建了涵盖六大洲63个国家-作物数据集的多维评估基准，系统比较了五种建模范式在作物产量预测中的表现，发现特征工程机器学习和表格基础模型表现最佳。
item.description:
基准测试作物产量预测的AI现状：跨建模范式的全球评估

Benchmarking the State of AI for Crop Yield Forecasting: A Global Assessment Across Modeling Paradigms

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19330

该研究构建了涵盖六大洲63个国家-作物数据集的多维评估基准，系统比较了五种建模范式在作物产量预测中的表现，发现特征工程机器学习和表格基础模型表现最佳。

准确的作物产量预测对粮食安全、农业政策和商品市场至关重要。尽管统计方法、基于过程的方法和机器学习方法都已被提出，但由于缺乏大规模、标准化的比较，它们的相对优势仍知之甚少。我们通过使用CY-Bench基准（涵盖六大洲63个国家-作物数据集，超过12,000个行政区域），对五种建模范式——统计基线、基于过程的模型、传统特征工程机器学习、深度序列模型和表格基础模型——进行全面基准测试来填补这一空白。除了传统的汇总精度指标外，我们还引入了一个多维评估框架，分别量化总体、空间、时间和异常预测能力。在多种作物和国家中，特征工程机器学习和表格基础模型……

arXiv:2611.19330v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate crop yield forecasting is essential for food security, agricultural policy, and commodity markets. Although statistical, process-based, and machine learning approaches have all been proposed, their relative strengths remain poorly understood due to the lack of large-scale, standardized comparisons. We address this gap through a comprehensive benchmark of five modeling paradigms -- statistical baselines, process-based models, conventional feature-engineered machine learning, deep sequence models, and tabular foundation models -- using the CY-Bench benchmark spanning 63 country-crop datasets (>12,000 administrative regions) across six continents. Beyond conventional pooled accuracy metrics, we introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that separately quantifies overall, spatial, temporal, and anomaly prediction skill. item.title: 该论文提出“数据债务”这一新概念，用以量化缺货导致需求被截断记录时库存控制策略的固有性能损失，并通过部分识别与极小极大遗憾框架刻画了兼容需求法则的精确集合，以及样本复杂度随选择界限线性增长的保证。
item.description:
缺货的数据债务：部分识别与极小极大遗憾库存控制

The Data Debt of Stockouts: Partial Identification and Minimax-Regret Inventory Control

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19323

该论文提出“数据债务”这一新概念，用以量化缺货导致需求被截断记录时库存控制策略的固有性能损失，并通过部分识别与极小极大遗憾框架刻画了兼容需求法则的精确集合，以及样本复杂度随选择界限线性增长的保证。

问题定义：库存决策决定了哪些需求能够进入销售日志。即使库存水平被完整记录，未被记录的预测信息也可能导致需求频率无法被识别。本文研究这些销售日志能够支持哪些多阶段订货决策，以及有限样本能够提供何种保证。方法/结果：嵌套的缺货阈值产生了精确的兼容需求法则集合以及用于策略评估的有限表示。我们选择一个确定性库存规则，使其在同一需求法则下相对于“知情最优解”的最大期望成本差距最小化。这一总体层面的数值即为特定信息和策略类别下的“数据债务”。在独立需求条件下，尽管每个孤立周期的最优订货行动相同，库存结转仍可能产生正的数据债务。有限样本会在数据债务之上额外引入学习误差。所需样本量随选择界限线性增长，其上下界阶数在对数因子范围内匹配。

arXiv:2611.19323v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Problem definition: Inventory decisions select which demand enters sales logs. Unrecorded forecasts can leave demand frequencies unidentified even when stocking levels are recorded. We study which multistage ordering decisions these logs can justify and what finite samples can guarantee. Methodology/results: Nested stockout thresholds yield exact sets of compatible demand laws and finite representations for policy evaluation. We choose one deterministic inventory rule to minimize its largest expected cost gap from the informed optimum under the same law. This population value is data debt for the specified information and policy class. Under independent demand, carryover can create positive debt despite common optimal actions in every isolated period. Finite samples add learning error above debt. item.title: 该研究提出一种基于Transformer架构变体的简单人工智能系统，仅需在分子动力学构象数据上训练即可直接生成物理合理的蛋白质构象集合及其统计权重，大幅降低了蛋白质构象采样的计算成本。
item.description:
使用简单倒置Transformer生成蛋白质构象

Generation of protein conformations using a simple inverted transformer

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19321

该研究提出一种基于Transformer架构变体的简单人工智能系统，仅需在分子动力学构象数据上训练即可直接生成物理合理的蛋白质构象集合及其统计权重，大幅降低了蛋白质构象采样的计算成本。

分子动力学是研究蛋白质行为的一种极其强大的方法，但要对可能的构象进行充分采样，需要巨大的计算资源。近年来，得益于三维蛋白质结构预测的成功，探索深度学习在解决蛋白质构象景观问题上的应用机会的研究呈爆发式增长。在这项工作中，研究者引入了一种基于Transformer架构变体的人工智能系统，并将其应用于确定蛋白质可及的三维结构集合及其统计权重的问题。在通过经典全原子分子动力学获得的某一特定蛋白质构象数据集上训练后，该神经网络能够直接生成物理上合理的蛋白质构象，其结果与通过分子动力学获得的结果相似。

arXiv:2611.19321v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Molecular dynamics is an extremely powerful approach for studying protein behavior, but it requires enormous computational resources to obtain an adequate sampling of possible conformations. Recently, thanks to successes in predicting three-dimensional protein structures, there has been an explosion of research exploring the opportunities offered by deep learning to address the problem of protein conformational landscape. In this work, an artificial intelligence system based on a variant of the Transformer architecture is introduced and applied to the problem of determining the ensemble of three-dimensional structures that a protein can access and their statistical weight. After being trained on a dataset of conformations of a particular protein obtained using classical all-atom molecular dynamics, this neural network is able to directly generate physically plausible protein conformations similar to those obtained both through molecula

item.title: 该论文借鉴兵棋推演策略优化的经验，提出将越狱攻击与安全防护视为两个相互对抗进化的种群，通过多准则竞争性协同进化机制持续强化智能体网络的安全防御能力。
item.description:
通过多准则竞争性协同进化强化智能体网络种群：来自兵棋推演策略优化的启示

Hardening Agentic Web Populations Through Multi-Criterion Competitive Co-Evolution: Lessons from Wargame Strategy Optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19319

该论文借鉴兵棋推演策略优化的经验，提出将越狱攻击与安全防护视为两个相互对抗进化的种群，通过多准则竞争性协同进化机制持续强化智能体网络的安全防御能力。

开放网络上的智能体将面临不断适应的对手，因此仅经过一次性测试的防御最终会被发现并攻破。我们提出将越狱攻击与安全防护机制视为两个相互对抗进化的种群，而非固定的攻击者探测固定的防御。这一思想直接来源于兵棋推演策略优化：在该领域中，采用交替进化周期与交叉对局评估的双种群竞争性协同进化，已被证明能够产生对移动对手具有鲁棒性的策略；同时，一项配套研究工作表明，同样的机制还可以衡量一个种群必须吸收多少竞争压力。然而，现实世界的应用永远无法依赖单一准则作为关键性能指标，而必须采用多个相互冲突的准则，例如成本与效率。我们描述了这一机制如何迁移至语言模型安全领域，并论证了为什么……

arXiv:2611.19319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agents on the open web will face adversaries that keep adapting, so a defense that is only tested once will eventually be found and broken. We propose treating jailbreak attacks and safety guardrails as two populations that evolve against each other, rather than as a fixed attacker probing a fixed defense. This idea comes directly from wargame strategy optimization, where two-population competitive co-evolution with alternating evolution cycles and cross-play evaluation has already been shown to produce strategies that are robust to a moving opponent, and where a companion line of work has shown that the same machinery can measure how much competitive pressure a population must absorb. However, real-world applications can never rely on a single criterion as a key performance indicator, rather must use multiple conflicting criteria, such as, cost and efficiency. We describe how this mechanism transfers to language model safety, argue why

item.title: 提出了一种免训练的推理时验证层SAR-TopoGuard，通过斑噪感知验证器和SAR引导的频率门控机制，有效抑制SAR到光学图像转换中的幻觉细节，并在多个生成器和数据集上显著提升PSNR和SSIM指标。
item.description:
SAR-TopoGuard：面向结构保持的SAR到光学图像转换的免训练、斑噪感知拓扑验证

SAR-TopoGuard: Training-Free, Speckle-Aware Topological Verification for Structure-Preserving SAR-to-Optical Translation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19316

提出了一种免训练的推理时验证层SAR-TopoGuard，通过斑噪感知验证器和SAR引导的频率门控机制，有效抑制SAR到光学图像转换中的幻觉细节，并在多个生成器和数据集上显著提升PSNR和SSIM指标。

SAR到光学的转换器常常合成出雷达测量结果并不支持的细节，而仅凭像素指标无法揭示这一问题。我们提出SAR-TopoGuard，这是一个面向冻结生成器的免训练推理时验证层：随机采样器抽取K个候选结果（对GAN使用蒙特卡洛dropout，对扩散模型使用种子方差），斑噪感知验证器通过与SAR输入的梯度幅值相关性以及幻觉频率指数对候选结果进行排序，SAR引导的频率门控则仅在SAR边缘支持的位置才允许高频细节通过。在所有五个超参数冻结且使用三个训练种子的条件下，我们在500个场景不相交的SEN1-2测试补丁、500个独立保留的夏季场景补丁以及200个跨数据集SEN12MS冬季图像对上进行评估。该验证层使Pix2Pix在三个数据集上分别提升+0.060、+0.012和+0.077 dB PSNR，以及+0.0034、+0.0057和+0.0135 SSIM（Wilcoxon p < 1e-6），并且在所有三个数据集上都改进了CycleGAN和CUT的表现。

arXiv:2611.19316v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: SAR-to-optical translators often synthesize detail that the radar measurement does not support, and pixel metrics alone cannot reveal it. We propose SAR-TopoGuard, a training-free inference-time layer for frozen generators: a stochastic sampler draws K candidates (Monte Carlo dropout for GANs, seed variance for diffusion), a speckle-aware verifier ranks them by gradient-magnitude correlation with the SAR input and a hallucination-frequency index, and a SAR-guided frequency gate admits high-frequency detail only where SAR edges support it. With all five hyperparameters frozen and three training seeds, we evaluate on 500 scene-disjoint SEN1-2 test patches, 500 patches of a held-out summer scene, and 200 cross-dataset SEN12MS winter pairs. The layer improves Pix2Pix by +0.060, +0.012, and +0.077 dB PSNR and by +0.0034, +0.0057, and +0.0135 SSIM, respectively (Wilcoxon p < 1e-6), and it improves CycleGAN and CUT on all three sets (+0.013 t

item.title: 本文提出一种软宏观控制方法与双机制评估框架，仅通过宏观观测将LLM智能体市场作为世界模型的能力分解为信息仿真与宏观涌现两个可分别量化的阶段。
item.description:
黑箱世界模型的宏观控制与能力评估：面向LLM智能体市场的双机制框架

Macro Control and Capability Evaluation of Black-Box World Models: A Two-Regime Framework for LLM-Agent Markets

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19311

本文提出一种软宏观控制方法与双机制评估框架，仅通过宏观观测将LLM智能体市场作为世界模型的能力分解为信息仿真与宏观涌现两个可分别量化的阶段。

大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以被组织成多智能体市场，作为世界模型运作，将宏观信息映射到涌现的宏观动态，而评估者只能观察宏观的输入与输出。本文将模型的能力分解为单一综合评分无法区分的两个阶段：信息仿真（从宏观信息到微观行为）与宏观涌现（从微观行为到宏观结果）。我们提出了一种软宏观控制方法，逐日公布一条公共参考路径，而不触碰个体决策、订单或撮合机制，并构建了一个双机制评估框架，仅凭宏观观测来衡量这两个阶段。在仅参考机制中，对称的真实参考与翻转参考共享一个共同水平R，用以衡量在公布参考下的实现程度，而两者的配对差距B则衡量结构性偏差；在信息注入机制中，外部信息……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19311v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can be organized into multi-agent markets that act as world models, mapping macro information to emergent macro dynamics while the evaluator observes only macro inputs and outputs. This paper separates a model's capability into two stages that a single aggregate score cannot separate: information simulation, from macro information to micro behavior, and macro emergence, from micro behavior to the macro outcome. We introduce a soft macro-control method that announces a public reference path day by day without touching individual decisions, orders, or matching, and a two-regime evaluation framework that measures both stages from macro observations alone. In the reference-only regime the symmetric true and flipped references share a common level R, which measures realization under the announced reference, while their paired gap B measures structural bias; in the information-injection regime external informa

item.title: 该论文提出“分阶段语义蒸馏”方法，仅凭一条记录轨迹即可训练出1320万参数的非LLM学生代理，在单块8-GB GPU上1658秒完成训练、每次决策仅需0.14毫秒，同时以余弦相似度0.943的精度保留分阶段LLM智能体的自由形式语义。
item.description:
分阶段语义蒸馏：在分阶段LLM智能体的低算力非LLM代理中保留自由形式语义

Staged Semantic Distillation: Preserving Free-Form Semantics in a Low-Compute Non-LLM Surrogate of a Staged LLM Agent

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19299

该论文提出“分阶段语义蒸馏”方法，仅凭一条记录轨迹即可训练出1320万参数的非LLM学生代理，在单块8-GB GPU上1658秒完成训练、每次决策仅需0.14毫秒，同时以余弦相似度0.943的精度保留分阶段LLM智能体的自由形式语义。

分阶段LLM智能体使市场与社交模拟器更加真实，但一次由200个智能体、十个指数组成的市场模拟器运行102天需要发出203,100次语言模型调用，且仅返回一种实现结果。传统的低算力蒸馏会丢失其自由形式的中间状态。我们提出分阶段语义蒸馏——一种低算力方法，可在由单条记录轨迹训练的非LLM学生模型中保留非结构化语义。冻结编码器将每个教师输出映射为1024维向量；学生模型接收带类型、带阶段标签且具有阶段特定可见性的向量，接受联合监督，并通过调度的自历史进行训练。一条TwinMarket轨迹即可训练出1320万参数的确定性学生模型，在单块8-GB GPU上1658秒内完成训练，运行时无需任何教师或解码器调用、无需文本生成（每次决策0.14毫秒）。其分析结果与教师保持高度接近（余弦相似度0.943），且在智能体之间交换语义输入会改变64.7%的决策……

arXiv:2611.19299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Staged LLM agents make market and social simulators realistic, but one 102-day run of a 200-agent, ten-index market simulator issues 203,100 language-model calls and returns one realization. Conventional low-compute distillation drops their free-form intermediate state. We present staged semantic distillation, a low-compute method that preserves non-structured semantics in a non-LLM student trained from one recorded trace. A frozen encoder maps each teacher output to a 1024-d vector; the student sees typed stage-tagged vectors with stage-specific visibility, is jointly supervised, and trains with scheduled self-history. One TwinMarket trace yields a 13.2M-parameter deterministic student that trains in 1,658 seconds on one 8-GB GPU and runs with zero teacher or decoder calls and no text generation (0.14 ms per decision). Its analysis stays close to the teacher (cosine 0.943), and swapping semantic inputs between agents moves 64.7% of deci

item.title: 该论文证明大语言模型可以在零样本条件下，仅凭展示的小数据集与指定网络架构，无需优化器、梯度或代码执行，就手写出前馈网络的全部权重和偏置，在从玩具问题、合成问题到经典基准和真实工程任务的测试中直接完成结构化数据的目标变量预测与分类。
item.description:
離题：面向结构化数据集目标变量预测与分类的零样本权重空间编程

Zero-Shot Weight-Space Programming for Prediction and Classification of Target Variables in Structured Datasets

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19292

该论文证明大语言模型可以在零样本条件下，仅凭展示的小数据集与指定网络架构，无需优化器、梯度或代码执行，就手写出前馈网络的全部权重和偏置，在从玩具问题、合成问题到经典基准和真实工程任务的测试中直接完成结构化数据的目标变量预测与分类。

权重空间编程是指以手工方式固定前馈网络的每一个参数，整个构建过程中不使用任何梯度下降。迄今为止的所有演示都是从以规则系统形式提供给模型的目标函数出发，这使其成为一个编译问题。而监督数据集并不提供这种规范说明，因此该过程必须自行完成统计推断，然后将结果用给定的参数化形式表达出来。我们探究大语言模型能否同时做到这两点。实验中向模型完整展示一个小数据集，并给出前馈网络的架构，由其将每一个权重和偏置都写成字面数字——全程不使用优化器、不使用梯度、不执行代码，也没有机会先进行评估。每个构建结果都被封存并预先登记其预期得分。评分测试套件从两个玩具问题开始，经过九个由隐藏旋转加以伪装的合成问题，直至经典基准测试以及一个真实工程问……

arXiv:2611.19292v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Weight-space programming fixes every parameter of a feed-forward network by hand, with no gradient descent anywhere in the construction. Every demonstration so far starts from a target function handed to the model as a rule system, making it a compilation problem. A supervised dataset withholds that specification, so the procedure must do the statistical inference itself and then express the result in the parameterisation it was given. We ask whether a large language model can do both. It is shown a small dataset in full, with the architecture of a feed-forward network, and writes out every weight and bias as a literal number, with no optimizer, no gradient, no code execution, and no chance to evaluate it first. Each construction is sealed and pre-registers its expected score. The graded suite runs from two toy problems, through nine synthetic problems disguised by a hidden rotation, to the classical benchmarks and one real engineering r

item.title: 本文提出在线中间件ToolPulse，通过提示与识别机制监测智能体的笨拙工具调用与跨交互的工具使用弯路，并在调用前后及时注入提醒、结构化反馈或上下文，从而显著提升LLM智能体自主使用工具的能力。
item.description:
超越笨拙的智能体工具调用：提示与识别如何带来改变

Beyond Clumsy Agentic Tool Calling: How Cueing and Spotting Make the Difference

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19275

本文提出在线中间件ToolPulse，通过提示与识别机制监测智能体的笨拙工具调用与跨交互的工具使用弯路，并在调用前后及时注入提醒、结构化反馈或上下文，从而显著提升LLM智能体自主使用工具的能力。

基于大语言模型（LLM）的任务型智能体依赖工具与环境进行交互，但可能忽视执行反馈、重复无效调用，或固执地坚持低效策略。这些行为会削弱智能体自主使用工具并持续推动任务进展的能力。我们从两个时间粒度刻画了工具使用症状：局部的笨拙工具使用行为，以及跨越多次交互的工具使用弯路。为了实现更自主的工具使用，我们提出了ToolPulse——一个支持自主工具使用的在线中间件，其核心是提示与识别机制。ToolPulse跟踪执行状态与时间交互模式，在调用分发之前监控拟议的调用，并在智能体恢复推理之前检查执行反馈。它将基于状态的规则、语义序列分析和交互特征相似性相结合，以识别干预时机，并提供言语提醒、结构化反馈或上下文……

arXiv:2611.19275v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based task-oriented agents depend on tools to interact with their environments, but may overlook execution feedback, repeat ineffective calls, or persist with unproductive strategies. These behaviors can hinder agents' ability to use tools autonomously and sustain task progress. We characterize tool-use symptoms at two temporal granularities: local clumsy tool-use behaviors and tool-use detours spanning multiple interactions. Towards greater autonomy in tool use, we present ToolPulse, an online middleware supporting autonomous tool use through cueing and spotting. ToolPulse tracks execution state and temporal interaction patterns, monitoring proposed calls before dispatch and inspecting execution feedback prior to the agent resumes reasoning. It combines state-based rules, semantic sequence analysis, and interaction-feature similarity to identify intervention opportunities and provide verbal reminders, structured feedback, or context

item.title: 该论文提出 HospitalBench，一个在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中构建的诊断性基准，通过具有因果依赖的医院长任务链，定位并解释具身智能体失败的具体环节与原因。
item.description:
HospitalBench：诊断具身智能体在长时程医院任务链中失败的位置与原因

HospitalBench: Diagnosing Where and Why Embodied Agents Fail on Long Hospital Task Chains

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19274

该论文提出 HospitalBench，一个在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中构建的诊断性基准，通过具有因果依赖的医院长任务链，定位并解释具身智能体失败的具体环节与原因。

长时程具身任务的失败方式是仅凭最终任务成败无法察觉的。HospitalBench 是一个诊断性基准，包含 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中的十项医院杂务，每项任务由两个不计分的预热步骤和一条由五个计分子任务组成的因果链构成，均在同一次连续仿真中完成：上一步留下的状态（物体位姿、某个选择、仅见过一次的事实）决定了下一步必须做什么，这与将子任务并列放置的基准不同。视觉-语言智能体通过技能级工具并依据相机图像进行操作。一个只执行模型所获调用的脚本化机器人充当每项任务可解性的检验标准。基准从每条轨迹中读出：任务链在何处断裂、智能体在调用失败后做了什么，以及其自身位置估计与真实位置的偏差有多大。本版本仅报告初步结果：60 次计划运行中的 15 次（三个高投入模型，任务 T1 和 T10 从两个起始状态各运行一次，T3 从一个起始状态运行一次），以及脚本化……

arXiv:2611.19274v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long-horizon embodied tasks fail in ways that end-task success cannot see. HospitalBench is a diagnostic benchmark of ten hospital chores in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each two unscored warm-up steps followed by a causal chain of five scored sub-tasks in one continuous simulation: the state one step leaves (an object pose, a choice, a fact seen once) determines what the next step must do, unlike benchmarks that place sub-tasks side by side. Vision-language agents act through skill-level tools from camera images. A scripted robot that makes only the calls a model gets is the solvability check of a chore. From each trajectory the benchmark reads where a chain breaks, what the agent did after a failed call, and how far its own position estimate drifts from the true one. This version reports first results only: 15 of 60 planned runs (three models at high effort, one run each on chores T1 and T10 from both start states and T3 from one), with scripte

item.title: 该研究揭示了在线策略蒸馏会隐式重塑大语言模型智能体的ReAct交互模式，跨域迁移既可能带来增益也可能引发负迁移，并提出基于教师偏好变化的选择性蒸馏方法，仅用源域轨迹即可有效缓解负迁移。
item.description:
智能体式在线策略蒸馏隐式地重塑大语言模型的ReAct模式

Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19244

该研究揭示了在线策略蒸馏会隐式重塑大语言模型智能体的ReAct交互模式，跨域迁移既可能带来增益也可能引发负迁移，并提出基于教师偏好变化的选择性蒸馏方法，仅用源域轨迹即可有效缓解负迁移。

在线策略蒸馏（OPD）能够将专业化能力迁移给语言模型智能体，但其对交互行为的跨领域影响仍不清楚。我们研究了OPD如何在数学、ALFWorld和τ²-bench三个环境中重塑ReAct交互模式，重点关注推理、动作和观察获取三个方面。通用推理监督使数学任务中的工具尝试比例从70.4%降至14.4%，同时将准确率从16.7%提升至38.0%；代码解释器监督则改善了家庭任务动作和零售查询表现。相比之下，ALFWorld监督使τ²-bench准确率从41.5%降至6.6%，并伴随着频繁违反用户信息依赖关系的工具调用。为了仅利用源域训练轨迹来应对这种负迁移，我们探索了一种由领域特定强化学习前后教师偏好变化所引导的选择性OPD方法。保留前95%的token位置可将τ²-bench准确率从11.5%提升至29.9%……

arXiv:2611.19244v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. We investigate how OPD reshapes ReAct interaction patterns across mathematics, ALFWorld, and $\tau^2$-bench, focusing on reasoning, actions, and observation acquisition. General-reasoning supervision reduces mathematical tool attempts from 70.4% to 14.4% while increasing accuracy from 16.7% to 38.0%; code-interpreter supervision improves household actions and retail queries. In contrast, ALFWorld supervision reduces $\tau^2$-bench accuracy from 41.5% to 6.6%, accompanied by frequent tool calls that violate user-information dependencies. To address negative transfer using only source-domain training trajectories, we explore selective OPD guided by teacher preference changes before and after domain-specific RL. item.title: 该论文形式化了LLM智能体授权中的“拒绝安全性”与“有界授权完整性”，并在模型、执行框架与工作流三个层面的实证审计中揭示了大量授权失效问题——包括审批未完成、已批准分支丢失以及拒绝后仍执行等。
item.description:
面向LLM智能体的可审计授权：跨模型、执行框架与工作流层面的实证证据

Auditable Authorization for LLM Agents: Empirical Evidence Across Model, Harness, and Workflow Layers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19237

该论文形式化了LLM智能体授权中的“拒绝安全性”与“有界授权完整性”，并在模型、执行框架与工作流三个层面的实证审计中揭示了大量授权失效问题——包括审批未完成、已批准分支丢失以及拒绝后仍执行等。

人类审批只有在被拒绝的工作停止且已授权的工作得以完成时才能提供有效控制。我们形式化了“拒绝安全性”与“有界授权完整性”两个属性，并对三个执行边界进行审计：模型选择调用、执行框架调度并恢复该调用、以及工作流将决策路由至受保护的效果。基于配对决策、精确轨迹和原生业务状态见证，实验涵盖了三个模型、五种提示方案、四种运行时审批设计、两次额外的框架重放以及100个公开工作流来源。结果显示：在配对模型面板中，尽管没有出现任何被拒绝的效果，300个审批中仍有7个未完成；并行确认在每个模型的三个任务中丢失了已批准的分支；恢复机制遗漏了CrewAI全部672个审批中的336个；59个可比较的n8n工作流中有4个在“拒绝”之后仍然执行。通过对比意图、生成的调用、调度分发与原生效果，可以定位首个可观测的分歧点及其修复目标。

We formalize refusal safety and bounded authorization completeness, and audit three execution boundaries: the model selects a call, the harness schedules and resumes it, and the workflow routes the decision to a protected effect. The paired model panel leaves seven of 300 approvals unfinished despite zero denied effects; parallel confirmation loses an approved branch in three tasks per model, restoration omits 336/672 CrewAI approvals, and four of 59 comparable n8n workflows execute after Reject. item.title: 该论文发现仅靠增强EEG与视觉嵌入的跨模态对齐无法有效提升图像重建质量，因而提出生成衍生监督（GDS）方法——利用图像条件化的教师模型将图像编码器特征映射到扩散Transformer的内部表征空间，为EEG条件化生成器提供显式监督。
item.description:
超越对齐：通过监督生成器实现EEG到图像的重建

Beyond Alignment: Supervising the Generator for EEG-to-Image Reconstruction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19232

该论文发现仅靠增强EEG与视觉嵌入的跨模态对齐无法有效提升图像重建质量，因而提出生成衍生监督（GDS）方法——利用图像条件化的教师模型将图像编码器特征映射到扩散Transformer的内部表征空间，为EEG条件化生成器提供显式监督。

视觉脑解码旨在将神经活动转化为人类可解读的图像。近期的EEG到图像重建方法依赖于将EEG信号与预训练的视觉嵌入进行对齐，以此作为图像生成器的条件输入。然而我们通过实验证明，更强的跨模态对齐并不能带来与之相应的重建质量提升。这表明，仅仅改进输入条件是不够的，生成过程本身也需要显式的监督。尽管表征对齐（REPA）通过利用预训练视觉编码器特征来引导扩散Transformer，提供了一种解决方案，但我们发现EEG条件化的生成器难以遵循这些固定目标。为解决这一不匹配问题，我们提出了生成衍生监督（GDS）：一个图像条件化的教师模型，将静态的图像编码器特征转化到扩散Transformer的内部表征空间中。我们的EEG条件化学生模型……

arXiv:2611.19232v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Visual brain decoding translates neural activity into human-interpretable images. While recent EEG-to-image reconstruction methods rely on aligning EEG signals with pretrained visual embeddings to condition an image generator, we empirically demonstrate that stronger cross-modal alignment do not translate into comparable gains in reconstruction quality. This indicates that improving the input condition alone is insufficient; the generative process itself requires explicit supervision. Although Representation Alignment (REPA) offers a solution by guiding diffusion transformers with pretrained vision encoder features, we find that EEG-conditioned generators struggle to follow these fixed targets. To address this mismatch, we introduce generation-derived supervision (GDS): an image-conditioned teacher that translates static image-encoder features into the internal representation space of a diffusion transformer. item.description:
CompoundingKernel：从零开始自我改进直至登顶第一

CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19230

CompoundingKernel是一个从零开始的自我改进智能体系统，通过模型外的内核存档与LLM控制器驱动的并行搜索来编写GPU内核，在SOL-ExecBench的L1、L2和量化榜单上排名第一，性能达参考基线的4.40倍。

我们提出了CompoundingKernel，一个通过搜索方式编写GPU内核的自我改进智能体系统。截至2026年11月11日，其生成的内核在SOL-ExecBench（NVIDIA B200）的公开L1、L2和量化榜单上排名第一。自2026年10月27日以来，它们一直保持L1榜单第一的位置（尽管在2026年11月7日曾短暂失位）。全部235个问题都有经网站验证的正确内核；在209个公开榜单问题上，其内核比基准测试的参考基线快4.40倍。该搜索从零开始：智能体只获得每个问题的PyTorch定义，没有任何参考内核或官方分数。模型外部的问题级存档保存着每个正确内核及其演化谱系。一个LLM控制器读取该存档，选择某个父代或全新设计，并为每个并行运行的子智能体分配一个方向。正确性由模型外部的检查来判定。在相同的挂钟时间下，该方法通过做出2.4倍的正确尝试次数，在38个问题中的35个上击败了编码实现的UCB风格树搜索。超过一千个智能体在……上运行（原文此处截断）

arXiv:2611.19230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present CompoundingKernel, a self-improving agent system that writes GPU kernels by search. As of 2026-11-11, its generated kernels rank #1 on the public L1, L2 and Quantization boards of SOL-ExecBench (NVIDIA B200). They have held #1 on L1 since 2026-10-27, albeit a short loss on 2026-11-07. All 235 problems have a site-verified correct kernel; on the 209 public-board problems they are 4.40x faster than the benchmark's reference baseline. The search starts from zero: agents get each problem's PyTorch definition but no reference kernels or official scores. A per-problem archive outside the model holds every correct kernel and its lineage. An LLM controller reads it, picks a parent or a new design, and gives each parallel child agent one direction. item.title: 该论文提出了在有限更新预算下对参数化场景语义记忆进行“纠正与保留”联合评估的协议，并证明在冻结的4B语言模型上，将更新预算从8次增加到32次可显著提升联合成功率（从6.25%提升至约94%–91%）。
item.description:
智能体能否重新审视它所知道的知识？变化世界中的选择性场景记忆更新

Can an Agent Rethink What It Knows? Selective Scene Memory Updates in a Changing World

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19227

该论文提出了在有限更新预算下对参数化场景语义记忆进行“纠正与保留”联合评估的协议，并证明在冻结的4B语言模型上，将更新预算从8次增加到32次可显著提升联合成功率（从6.25%提升至约94%–91%）。

工厂、仓库和日常物理环境中的任务配置会随时间变化。因此，物理AI系统需要在向场景记忆中纳入新事实的同时，保留关于设备、物体和运行约束的有效信息。我们研究了对这一参数化语义记忆层的更新，并在有限更新预算下对纠正与保留能力进行了联合评估。在当前事实数量与记忆参数数量固定的条件下，该评估协议结合了独立的单事实更新、预算轨迹、旧答案到新答案的诊断以及首次稳定成功等要素。我们使用冻结的4B语言模型并在其后期层应用LoRA，在四字段合成语义配置上评估了七种准备条件和六种更新预算。在两种曝光匹配的历史条件下，将更新预算从8次增加到32次，可使联合成功率分别从6.25%提升至94.79%和91.15%，同时精确过时……

arXiv:2611.19227v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Task configurations in factories, warehouses, and everyday physical environments change over time. Physical AI systems therefore need to incorporate new facts into scene memory while preserving valid information about equipment, objects, and operating constraints. We study updates to this parametric semantic-memory layer and present a joint evaluation of correction and preservation under finite update budgets. At fixed current fact count and memory parameter count, the protocol combines independent single-fact updates, budget trajectories, old-to-new answer diagnostics, and first stable success. Using a frozen 4B language model with late-layer LoRA, we evaluate seven preparation conditions and six update budgets on four-field synthetic semantic configurations. item.title: 该论文将少样本示例选择形式化为以查询表示为目标的稀疏重建问题，提出匹配追踪式的残差解释搜索（RES）方法，实验表明其在多数模型-数据集组合上优于MMR，说明示例的集体互补性比成对相异性更重要。
item.description:
重新审视什么构成良好的上下文子集：稀疏潜在基的视角

Revisiting What Makes a Good Context Subset: A Sparse Latent Basis Perspective

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19220

该论文将少样本示例选择形式化为以查询表示为目标的稀疏重建问题，提出匹配追踪式的残差解释搜索（RES）方法，实验表明其在多数模型-数据集组合上优于MMR，说明示例的集体互补性比成对相异性更重要。

在现代大语言模型推理中，选择上下文子集变得越来越重要，然而是什么使一个子集有效仍不清楚。我们在少样本示例选择的受控环境中研究这一问题。我们检验了一个假设：所选示例应当共同提供目标查询所需的与任务相关的信息。假设查询表示能为这些需求提供有用的代理，我们将选择问题形式化为稀疏重建，并用残差解释搜索（RES）加以实现——这是一种匹配追踪式的诊断程序。在七个基准测试和八个开源权重大语言模型上的实验表明，没有任何检索目标是普遍最优的。RES在56个模型-数据集组合中的34个上优于MMR，其在情感任务上的优势最为明显，这表明以查询为条件的集体重建可能捕获到成对相异性度量所遗漏的有用互补性。而基于相关性的检索仍然表现强劲。

arXiv:2611.19220v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Selecting context subsets is increasingly important in modern LLM inference, yet what makes a subset effective remains unclear. We study this question in the controlled setting of few-shot demonstration selection. We examine a hypothesis that demonstrations should collectively provide task-relevant information needed by a target query. Assuming that the query representation provides a useful proxy for these requirements, we formulate selection as sparse reconstruction and instantiate it with Residual Explanation Search (RES), a Matching-Pursuit-style diagnostic procedure. Across seven benchmarks and eight open-weight LLMs, no retrieval objective is universally best. RES outperforms MMR in 34 of 56 model--dataset pairs, with its clearest advantage on sentiment tasks, suggesting that query-conditioned collective reconstruction may capture useful complementarity that pairwise dissimilarity misses. Relevance-based retrieval remains strong

item.title: 提出Neural Dual Bounds框架，通过单次神经网络前向传播为概率图模型的MAP与受约束MAP推理生成构造性有效的上界，用以热启动JGLP优化器，使对偶间隙比零初始化紧数个数量级。
item.description:
神经对偶界：面向MAP与受约束MAP的构造性有效JGLP热启动方法

Neural Dual Bounds: Valid-by-Construction JGLP Warm-Starts for MAP and Constrained MAP

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19218

提出Neural Dual Bounds框架，通过单次神经网络前向传播为概率图模型的MAP与受约束MAP推理生成构造性有效的上界，用以热启动JGLP优化器，使对偶间隙比零初始化紧数个数量级。

我们提出了Neural Dual Bounds（神经对偶界），这是一个无需校准的框架，仅需一次神经网络前向传播即可为概率图模型中的MAP推理生成确定性的上界。该框架以自监督的方式训练一个网络，通过直接最小化平滑的对偶目标函数，使其输出给定连接图分解上mini-bucket风格上界的边消息。在测试时，该网络的输出可用于热启动标准的JGLP优化器。在多样化的基准测试中，这种热启动所产生的对偶间隙比零初始化紧了数个数量级，且收益在早期迭代阶段最为显著。我们还将该框架应用于受约束MAP（CMPE）任务：在贝叶斯网络上，结合测试时自适应的神经热启动与自适应基线表现相当；而在网格等基准上则取得了最紧的对偶间隙，比基线紧一到两个数量级。

arXiv:2611.19218v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present Neural Dual Bounds, a calibration-free framework that produces deterministic upper bounds for MAP inference in probabilistic graphical models using a single neural-network forward pass. The framework trains a network to output the edge messages of a mini-bucket style upper bound on a given join-graph decomposition in a self-supervised manner by directly minimizing a smooth dual objective. The output of this network can be used at test time to warm-start a standard JGLP optimizer. Across diverse benchmarks, this warm start yields dual gaps that are orders of magnitude tighter than those from zero initialization, with the largest gains in the early-iteration regime. item.title: Mem2Fair是一个即插即用的在线公平性控制框架，通过维护概念条件化的公平记忆，以推理时生成的视频作为反馈来选择提示级别的属性干预，从而缓解文本到视频生成中提示词未指定属性时的系统性人口统计偏差。
item.description:
Mem2Fair：基于公平记忆的文本到视频生成在线公平性控制

Mem2Fair: Online Fairness Control for Text-to-Video Generation via Fair Memory

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19215

Mem2Fair是一个即插即用的在线公平性控制框架，通过维护概念条件化的公平记忆，以推理时生成的视频作为反馈来选择提示级别的属性干预，从而缓解文本到视频生成中提示词未指定属性时的系统性人口统计偏差。

当提示词未明确指定受保护属性时，文本到视频（T2V）生成模型可能产生系统性不公平的人口统计结果。例如，描述护士但未指定性别的提示词可能会不成比例地生成描绘女性护士的视频。缓解T2V生成中的不公平性尤其具有挑战性：基于训练的方法需要修改模型内部，要求架构特定的访问权限，并有破坏时间一致性的风险；而基于采样的方法通常需要在部署前进行代价高昂的视频生成。我们提出了首个针对T2V生成属性级公平性的条件化在线可达性（online approachability）形式化方法。基于这一形式化方法，我们提出了Mem2Fair，这是一个即插即用的框架，它维护着以概念为条件的公平记忆（Fair Memory）。该框架利用推理时生成的视频作为反馈，根据每个概念相对于……的偏差来选择提示级别的属性干预（摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2611.19215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models can produce systematically unfair demographic outcomes when prompts leave protected attributes unspecified. For example, prompts describing nurses without specifying gender may disproportionately generate videos depicting female nurses. We present the first conditional online approachability formulation of attribute-level fairness for T2V generation. Building on this formulation, we introduce Mem2Fair, a plug-and-play framework that maintains concept-conditioned Fair Memory. item.title: STaSBO提出了一种由大语言模型驱动的任务无关元控制器，通过策略规划与策略引导的配置选择两个协调阶段，动态管理贝叶斯优化的搜索行为及代理模型-采集函数配置，同时保留数值贝叶斯优化进行概率建模和候选点生成的职责。
item.description:
STaSBO：面向贝叶斯优化的LLM引导策略规划与配置选择

STaSBO: LLM-Guided Strategy Planning and Configuration Selection for Bayesian Optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19214

STaSBO提出了一种由大语言模型驱动的任务无关元控制器，通过策略规划与策略引导的配置选择两个协调阶段，动态管理贝叶斯优化的搜索行为及代理模型-采集函数配置，同时保留数值贝叶斯优化进行概率建模和候选点生成的职责。

贝叶斯优化（BO）能够对昂贵的黑盒问题进行样本高效的搜索，但其性能在很大程度上取决于代理模型-采集函数配置，而这些配置的适用性会随问题和优化状态的不同而变化。我们通过STaSBO在LLM驱动的贝叶斯优化战略管理方面迈出了重要一步。STaSBO是一个任务无关的元控制器，它负责规划搜索行为并联合选择代理模型-采集函数配置，同时数值型贝叶斯优化仍然保留概率建模与候选点生成的职责。STaSBO由两个相互协调的阶段组成：策略规划和策略引导的配置选择。一个结构化记忆系统将先前的计划、配置选择和候选行为与优化状态相关联，使控制器能够在规划过程中修正其轨迹摘要和行为计划。为了在庞大的联合配置空间中进行导航，选择阶段会先筛选出……

arXiv:2611.19214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) enables sample-efficient search for expensive black-box problems, but its performance depends strongly on surrogate-acquisition configurations whose suitability varies across problems and optimization states. We take a significant step toward LLM-driven strategic management of BO with STaSBO, a task-agnostic meta-controller that plans search behavior and jointly selects surrogate-acquisition configurations, while numerical BO retains responsibility for probabilistic modeling and candidate generation. STaSBO comprises two coordinated stages: strategy planning and strategy-guided configuration selection. item.title: 本研究首次揭示在策略蒸馏可成为后门传播的高效通道：教师模型中被植入的后门仅需极少触发提示暴露即可转移至学生模型，且转移强度显著高于传统蒸馏方法。
item.description:
在策略蒸馏作为后门传播通道

On-policy distillation as a Backdoor Propagation Channel

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19207

本研究首次揭示在策略蒸馏可成为后门传播的高效通道：教师模型中被植入的后门仅需极少触发提示暴露即可转移至学生模型，且转移强度显著高于传统蒸馏方法。

在策略蒸馏正在成为大语言模型后训练的重要范式，其通过利用教师模型在线生成的监督信号来改进学生模型。然而，这一过程是否也会将教师模型中的潜在安全风险转移给学生模型，目前尚缺乏充分研究。在这项工作中，我们揭示了一种新的安全风险：攻击者首先通过监督微调（SFT）在教师模型中植入条件后门，随后在策略蒸馏仅需极少比例的触发提示暴露，即可将后门转移到学生模型中。更令人担忧的是，我们发现这种后门转移在在策略蒸馏下明显强于传统蒸馏方法，这表明在策略蒸馏可能为跨模型传播后门提供了一条高效通道。我们的机制分析表明，后门信号主要通过……（原文摘要至此截断）

arXiv:2611.19207v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is emerging as an important paradigm for the post training of large language models, improving student models by leveraging supervision generated online by teacher models. However, whether this process also transfers latent security risks from teacher models to student models remains insufficiently studied. In this work, we reveal a new security risk in which an attacker first implants a conditional backdoor into the teacher model through supervised fine tuning (SFT), after which OPD can transfer the backdoor to the student model with only an extremely small proportion of trigger prompt exposure. More concerningly, we find that such backdoor transfer is substantially stronger under OPD than under conventional distillation methods, suggesting that OPD may provide an efficient channel for propagating backdoors across models.
